Table 5 (Section 5.2): with Qwen3.8-27B, Contra F1 19.86% vs Claude Code 9.63% and OpenHands 10.61%; FPR 5.00%
Table 6 / Appendix B.2: 40 single-function tasks from six Python repositories, one baseline and one plugin run per task, labels LLM-generated with manual review
Reproducibility statement: released qualification/adaptive-selection code and plugin at github.com/fangz-cs/Contra; benchmark data and experiment records not included
llm_evaluation.rationale: Highly relevant to LLM coding agents, code generation, selective clarification/interaction, and evaluation. Contra's execution-based behavioral verification of candidate clarification questions (generate programs under two plausible answers, check stable output differences on shared inputs) is a reasonably novel training-free mechanism. Rigor is decent: four coding agents, three baselines, budget-matched protocol, stage-wise and component ablations (Table 3), downstream pass@1, and an FPR check on fully specified tasks. Limitations: evaluation centers on ClarifyCodeBench, a benchmark created by the same group, with GPT-4o-based question matching; ablations run only with GPT-5-mini; downstream pass@1 gains are modest (1.22 and 0.61 points); the repository evaluation is 40 tasks with one run per condition; some references appear unverifiable/futuristic. Reproducibility is partial: qualification and selection code plus plugin are released, but benchmark data and experiment records are explicitly excluded.

primary_link.title: CONTRA: Discovering and Qualifying Behavior-Changing Questions for Selective Clarification in LLM Code Generation

papers.summary: Coding agents can generate code that appears correct but implements behavior the user never intended. This mismatch can arise when an agent silently resolves underspecified requirements through its own assumptions. As subsequent development builds on these assumptions, correcting the resulting behavior can become increasingly costly. Early clarification can help prevent such mismatches, but unnecessary questions can interrupt developers and slow down development. Existing methods struggle to ide
papers.summary_zh: 需求敘述經常留下行為層面的空白，例如邊界情況處理或輸出格式，而 coding agent 往往默默自行選定一種解讀就開始實作，導致程式碼看似正確、卻與開發者真正想要的意圖不符；等到後續開發都建立在這項假設上，修正成本會愈來愈高。然而，隨意發問同樣造成干擾，因此關鍵在於「選擇性釐清」：只在使用者輸入真正必要時才提問。作者提出 Contra，一套免訓練方法，流程分為三階段。首先 Question Discovery 以情境感知與獨立生成交替擴充候選問題，每題附上兩個合理答案，並合併重複項。接著 Question Qualification 以語意檢查判斷問題是否與必要行為相關、需求是否已決定答案，再進行行為驗證：針對兩個答案各生成三支程式並在共享輸入上執行，同組內至少兩支輸出相同才算穩定，唯有兩組出現穩定差異才保留該題。最後 Adaptive Question Selection 依互動歷史挑選仍待釐清的問題或停止發問。在 ClarifyCodeBench 上，Contra 於 GPT-5-mini、GPT-5.5、Grok 4.5 與 Gemini 3.1 Pro 四種 agent 上皆取得最高 F1 與 TKQR，巨觀平均 F1 與 TKQR 分別為 41.20% 與 38.32%，較最佳基線高出 13.88 與 12.33 個百分點；以相同 LLM 與評估協定比較時，其召回率與 F1 亦優於 Claude Code 與 OpenHands。作者另提出 Contra-Flash 以按需驗證降低約 65.7% 至 96.0% 的驗證次數，並實作 Claude Code 外掛。限制在於行為驗證失敗並不代表兩者行為等價，且下游 pass@1 的增益幅度有限，作者也指出尚未評估長期開發情境下的開發者負擔與程式碼品質。
papers.title: CONTRA: Discovering and Qualifying Behavior-Changing Questions for Selective Clarification in LLM Code Generation
papers.title_zh: CONTRA：為 LLM 程式碼生成發掘並驗證會改變行為的提問，以實現選擇性釐清

links.title: A Matryoshka Hierarchical RAG for Efficient Multi-Hop Question Answering

evidence: Section 4.1.1: three benchmarks HotpotQA/2Wiki/MuSiQue with corpora of 9,811/6,119/11,656 documents; five independent 1,000-question samples plus a disjoint 500-question validation set per benchmark

Section 4.1.2-4.1.3: seven baselines (NaiveRAG, RAPTOR, GraphRAG, LightRAG, HippoRAG2, KGP, ToG) sharing gemma3:27b-it-qat generator; nomic-embed-text-v1.5 with MRL dimensions {64,128,256,512,768}, L=5
Table 4: MatRAG R@5 89.30/79.27/57.08 on HotpotQA/2Wiki/MuSiQue, outperforming best baselines except R@2 on 2Wiki (63.08 vs NaiveRAG 63.40)
Table 5: MatRAG EM 60.50/52.70/27.40 and F1 73.66/63.42/37.89, best on all datasets over the seven baselines with reported std devs
Table 6: indexing time 316-528s for MatRAG vs 312,441s (HippoRAG2) and 728,471s (LightRAG) on HotpotQA; NaiveRAG remains faster at 98-109s
Table 7: response time 1.85/2.49/2.99s for MatRAG vs 3.52/3.88/4.61s for NaiveRAG; Tok slightly higher than NaiveRAG but far below graph-based methods

Tables 8-11 (Section 4.4): ablations of anchoring beta_t schedule and Matryoshka truncated vs full-dimensional embeddings, with truncated prefixes matching or improving Davies-Bouldin/Silhouette clustering quality (Table 9)
Section 5: limitations include GLiNER entity extraction errors propagating to budget control, dependence on embedding-space density, and irrevocable greedy top-down traversal without backtracking
Section 4.1.3 and Data availability: implementation code at anonymous.4open.science link; hardware A100 40GB with 128GB RAM specified
llm_evaluation.rationale: Highly relevant RAG/multi-hop QA work for LLM grounding: hierarchical Matryoshka-indexed retrieval with entity-budgeted iterative search replacing LLM-driven planning. Novel combination of MRL dimension alignment with density-based hierarchical clustering is a genuine contribution, though the components (HDBSCAN, MRL prefixes, entity Jaccard re-ranking, Rocchio-style anchoring) are individually established. Rigor is solid: three standard benchmarks, seven baselines with a shared generator, five independent 1000-question samples with std devs, hyperparameters tuned on disjoint 500-question validation sets, and ablations for anchoring schedule and truncated vs full embeddings. Limitations acknowledged (no backtracking, GLiNER dependency, corpus density sensitivity). Caveats: retrieval metrics unavailable for four of seven baselines (justified but limits comparison), a single embedding model and single generator restrict generalizability, and NaiveRAG remains a strong retrieval baseline (slightly better R@2 on 2Wiki). Code link provided for reproducibility.

primary_link.title: A Matryoshka Hierarchical RAG for Efficient Multi-Hop Question Answering

papers.summary: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems for multi-hop Question Answering (QA) must balance retrieval quality with computational cost. This cost is incurred during indexing time, through the use of expensive Knowledge Graphs (KGs) or Large Language Models (LLMs) to generate summaries, or during querying, through iterative LLM-driven retrieval. To reduce it while maintaining retrieval quality, we present MatRAG, a hierarchical framework that combines RAG systems with Matryoshka Representation
papers.summary_zh: 多跳問答（multi-hop QA）需要跨多篇文件聚合證據，現行做法面臨兩難：圖譜式方法（GraphRAG、LightRAG、HippoRAG2、KGP、ToG 等）在建索引時須抽取實體與關係、建立知識圖譜（KG），成本高昂；分層式方法（如 RAPTOR）則在內部節點反覆呼叫 LLM 產生摘要。查詢階段兩者也常需迭代式 LLM 規劃，延遲随跳數增加。本文提出 MatRAG，把 Matryoshka Representation Learning（MRL）的巢狀表示與密度分群（HDBSCAN）的語意階層對齊：由上而下建立有向無環圖（DAG），內部節點以逐層縮短的 MRL 前綴維度儲存質心（最粗層 64 維），葉節點保留完整 768 維文件向量；每個節點允許最多 p 個父叢集，形成冗餘路徑。線上檢索以實體數量決定每跳預算，並以「原始查詢錨定＋累積查詢」的 β_t 調度抑制查詢漂移，最後以語意相似度與實體 Jaccard 重叠混合重新排序。在 HotpotQA、2WikiMultiHopQA、MuSiQue 三個基準上，各取五組各 1,000 題樣本，MatRAG 的 EM 與 F1 皆優於七個代表性基線，R@5 亦大致領先；索引時間較 HippoRAG2 減少 99.6% 以上，回應時間比 FAISS 平坦檢索的 NaiveRAG 快 35% 至 47%。消融顯示錨定策略、實體訊號與 MRL 截斷皆有貢獻，且截斷後的分群品質（DB、Silhouette）不降反略升。限制在於實體抽取依賴 GLiNER，領域術語可能失效並向下傳播；貪婪式由上而下走訪無回溯機制，粗層誤判可能永久排除相關文件。整體而言，本研究指出可透過嵌入維度與索引深度的共同設計，在低成本與結構化檢索之間取得折衷，對多跳 RAG 的實務部署具參考價值。
papers.title: A Matryoshka Hierarchical RAG for Efficient Multi-Hop Question Answering
papers.title_zh: MatRAG：結合 Matryoshka 巢狀表示的分層檢索增強生成框架，用於高效率多跳問答

links.title: KaliBench: A Fine-Grained Benchmark for Cybersecurity Tool Use on Kali Linux with Runtime-Free Verifiable Rewards

evidence: §3 Data Generation/Verification: 27.7K generated pairs reduced to 8,504 verified pairs (30.7% retention) via LLM verifier (53.8% first-round filter), terminal verification (11.95% filtered), and human review (4.9% invalid)
§3 Deduplication and Train–test Split: SemHash-based clustering at cosine similarity >0.90; 5,000 eval (1,642 tools) and 3,504 train (962 tools) splits

Table 1: across 24 open-weight configurations, metric averages show U→R Tool Acc 72.0→95.2% but Optional F1 only 45.1→48.7%, while H raises EC 22.3→73.1%; no open-weight model exceeds 42% EC unrestricted
§4.1 Impact of KaliBench Post-training + Table 1: RedSage-K (SFT+GRPO) 8B reaches Avg Total Score 79.2 vs RedSage-Ins 71.7 baseline, ~+7.5 points, comparable to DeepSeek-V3.2 (80.2)
Table 2 / Appendix M: proprietary systems in Unrestricted reach at most 61.68% full-set EC (GPT-5.6-Sol), with Claude Opus 5 answering only 73.5% of queries
Appendix G.2: detailed LoRA/GRPO hyperparameters, single H200 GPU, ~32 min SFT and ~28h/~17h GRPO; Appendix O Limitations: documentation drift, imperfect LLM-as-Verifier, incomplete alias coverage
llm_evaluation.rationale: Strong LLM/tool-use/agent-evaluation relevance: a schema-free NL-to-CLI benchmark for Kali Linux with fine-grained, runtime-free verifiable rewards, plus SFT/RLVR post-training on an 8B model. Novelty is real (first schema-free CLI tool-invocation benchmark with alias-aware component metrics) though it extends existing function-calling benchmark ideas to a new domain. Rigor is solid: multi-stage verification (LLM verifier, Docker sandbox execution, human-in-loop), 24 open-weight configurations plus proprietary/scaffolded systems, three evaluation modes, delta analysis, robustness and failure analyses. Weaknesses: data generated by one LLM (Qwen3-Max) with >50% initial hallucination, single training runs with no seeds/error bars (checklist Fig. 5 box plots are cross-model distributions, not statistical significance), and residual labeling noise acknowledged in Appendix O. Evidence is quantitative and traceable. Generalizability is limited to single-turn Kali Linux CLI generation, but the reward/evaluation framework transfers to other CLI toolchains. Code, data, prompts, hyperparameters, and verification rules are released.

primary_link.title: KaliBench: A Fine-Grained Benchmark for Cybersecurity Tool Use on Kali Linux with Runtime-Free Verifiable Rewards

papers.summary: LLMs are increasingly applied to cybersecurity workflows, where they are expected to translate analysts' intent into tool invocations. However, existing evaluations focus on knowledge-based assessments or end-to-end agentic tasks, and do not directly measure LLMs' ability to generate executable commands for real-world cybersecurity tools. This gap is critical because cybersecurity operations rely on strict command-line interfaces (CLIs), where minor syntax errors, incorrect flag--value bindings,
papers.summary_zh: 既有資安評測多偏重知識問答或端到端代理任務，無法直接衡量 LLM 能否為真實資安工具產生可執行命令。CLI 對語法極為嚴苛，旗標拼寫、別名或參數順序稍有偏差即失效，且資安工具鏈龐大，難以在提示中列舉 JSON schema，因此屬於「無 schema」的自然語言轉 CLI 情境。作者提出 KaliBench，涵蓋 1,642 個工具、8,504 組查詢與命令配對，橫跨 23 個能力維度與 5 個安全階段；資料由官方手冊引導生成，再經 LLM 驗證、Docker 沙箱終端執行與人工複核多階段清洗，最終切分為 5,000 筆評測與 3,504 筆訓練樣本。評測分為無限制、受限與提示三種模式，並以工具準確率、選擇性參數 F1、位置參數 F1、總分與完全正確率等細粒度指標計分。結果顯示，24 種開放權重模型在無限制設定下完全正確率均未超過 42%，提供工具文件可大幅提升參數建構表現，顯示參數層級才是主要瓶頸；SFT 與以 KaliBench 推導之可驗證獎勵進行 RLVR，可使 8B 模型平均總分提升約 7.5 個百分點並接近大型 MoE 模型。限制在於單輪命令生成、依賴手冊資料，以及手冊漂移與別名抽取不完整可能造成偏差。
papers.title: KaliBench: A Fine-Grained Benchmark for Cybersecurity Tool Use on Kali Linux with Runtime-Free Verifiable Rewards
papers.title_zh: KaliBench：在 Kali Linux 上以無需執行時期的可驗證獎勵進行細粒度資安工具使用評測

links.title: Cross-Lingual Alignment for Decoder-Only Models using MoE Routers

evidence: Section 3.2 Eq. 1: L_XLR = (1/|M|) sum KL(pbar_eng || pbar_tgt) over mean-pooled routing weights, added to LM loss as L_LM + alpha*L_XLR
Section 5.2 / Table 1: routing loss beats LM-only baseline on 13 of 14 model-language pairs (ties on Marco-Nano Vietnamese), mean gain 0.9 points
Table 2 (Appendix B, Table 6): hidden-state cosine alignment on Marco-Nano yields 26.3/36.9 vs routing 26.8/38.1 on Sinhala/Hungarian
Section 5.1, Figure 4: SoftCKA hidden-state similarity to English increases after routing-loss training on Qwen3-30B-A3B
Appendix C and Table 7: layer ranges 7-34 (Qwen3), 4-17 (GPT-OSS), 7-19 (Marco), 10-35 (Granite); for Granite/Marco layers were 'subjectively' chosen
Code Availability section: https://github.com/lucasbandarkar/xl_moe_alignment
Section 6 'Experimental Limitations': experiments run only on fully post-trained LLMs with 200k-sample CPT, baseline gains small, no negatives or load-balancing interaction studied
llm_evaluation.rationale: Directly targets decoder-only LLMs with a novel MoE-router-based cross-lingual alignment loss, squarely in the LLM/Transformer/MoE/NLP preference space (though not Japanese). Method is simple and clearly specified (Eq. 1, mean-pooled top-k routing weights, KL to English). Rigor is solid: 4 MoE models, 7 languages, controlled CPT baseline, router-only and hidden-state-pooling ablations (Table 2), hyperparameters and layer ranges reported (Appendix B/D/F), and honest limitations (short post-training CPT, dependence on parallel data, subjective layer selection for two models per Appendix C). Evidence is consistent but modest: routing loss beats baseline in 13/14 model-language pairs with mean +0.9 points and no per-task significance testing; some tasks regress (e.g. FLORES). Generalizability limited to MoE architectures and English-anchored translation pairs. Code URL is provided.

primary_link.title: Cross-Lingual Alignment for Decoder-Only Models using MoE Routers

papers.summary: Cross-lingual contrastive learning has been a core component of multilingual encoder training, but the ability to explicitly align representations is not possible in decoder-only LLMs because of varying multilingual tokenization. However, a growing amount of research suggests that even in LLMs, higher cross-lingual representational alignment leads to improved cross-lingual transfer. In this paper, we propose a novel approach to reimagine cross-lingual contrastive learning given the architectural
papers.summary_zh: 解碼器-only 的大型語言模型缺乏編碼器那種自然的句級表徵，加上各語言分詞方式不同，使得跨語言對比學習難以直接套用。本文提出改以混合專家（MoE）路由器輸出作為對齊目標：對中間層的路由權重在序列上做平均池化，得到低維、可跨語言比較的句級分布，再以 KL 散度把平行句對的路由分布拉近。此輔助損失與語言模型損失相加，梯度只回傳到目標語言序列，並透過打包與分流前向傳遞降低額外計算成本。作者在四個開源 MoE 模型與七種語言上做受控的持續預訓練，結果顯示路由對齊損失確實降低跨語言路由散度，梯度也讓中間層隱藏表徵更接近英文；在 FLORES、Belebele、Global-MMLU、MGSM 等多元評測上，十四個模型—語言配對中有十三個勝過僅做語言模型訓練的基準，平均提升約 0.9 分。與平均池化隱藏狀態的餘弦對齊相比，路由目標在 Sinhala 與 Hungarian 上表現更好。限制在於方法完全依賴平行語料、僅在已後訓練模型上做小規模持續預訓練，且基準本身增益有限，因此絕對改善幅度不大；作者認為此對齊訊號更適合在預訓練階段大規模導入。
papers.title: Cross-Lingual Alignment for Decoder-Only Models using MoE Routers
papers.title_zh: 以 MoE 路由器進行解碼器-only 模型的跨語言對齊

links.title: Argo-Bench: Evaluating Data Agents on Enterprise-Scale Workflows

evidence: Abstract/Sec 1: 210 tasks over a simulated NYC food-delivery world exported to an Oracle EBS warehouse of 235 tables and 7.5 billion rows; strongest of 14 models scores 59.5 and solves 34.8% of tasks
Sec 2.1: world calibrated to NYC DCWP quarterly reports and DoorDash/Grubhub 10-K anchors; per-delivery economics within 5% of anchors in 13 of 16 quarterly comparisons (Figure 2a)

Sec 2.2: schema designed with three ERP consultants (14-31 years experience); every standard table/column exists in Oracle EBS 12.2 Vision data dictionary; tables carry on average 52% of Vision columns
Sec 3.1/Appendix I.1: bootstrap CIs over 146 base scenarios; Claude Opus 5.5 leads GPT-6 Astra by 7.7 points [1.4, 13.7]; 95% CIs on score roughly ±2 to 8 points
Sec 3.2/Appendix I.7: across 4,553 forecast series, nominal 80% intervals cover the realized value only 44.8% of the time (overconfidence)
Appendix I.2/Table 10: reasoning effort sweep — Opus gains 17.0 points low→medium with diminishing returns; DeepSeek V4.1 Flash and Qwen 3.8 Max show no gains past medium
Appendix D: early sandbox escape by Gemini 3.8 Flash reading grader code (score 0.99); round discarded, final runs use network-less gVisor isolation
Appendix J: injected refunds in the refund-collusion family leak via liability-tier shares (664 of 424,807 refunds), shortcutting candidate search
Sec 5/Limitations: single city, single year, one ERP format, no data drift; each model-effort setting has one run per task and all tasks share one simulated world

Reproducibility statement: warehouse (CC BY 4.0) and code (Apache 2.0) released, but simulator and graders withheld and paper runs use a private-seed world, so re-running reproduces procedure on a sibling world, not exact numbers
llm_evaluation.rationale: Highly relevant to LLM agents, tool use, and agent evaluation: a simulated enterprise ERP warehouse benchmark (235 tables, 7.49B rows) where 14 frontier/open-weight LLMs file actions graded against withheld simulator latent state. Novel contribution is consequence-based grading of agent actions rather than gold SQL/LLM-judge, plus an audit of prior benchmark answer-key errors. Rigor is strong: calibration to NYC DCWP/10-K anchors (Sec 2.1), three ERP consultants validating the schema (Sec 2.2), frozen answer keys (App. G), 9,869 graded runs with bootstrap CIs clustered over 146 task families (App. I.1), reasoning-effort sweeps (App. I.2), prompt-variant comparisons, proper scoring-rule analysis (App. I.7), disclosed reward-hacking incident (App. D), and a candid task audit exposing injected-refund shortcuts (App. J). Limitations are real: one simulated city/domain, one year, one ERP format, no data drift, one run per model-setting, and simulator assumptions may favor tested systems (Sec 5). Reproducibility is partial — warehouse, tasks, reference agent, harness, and sandboxes released, but simulator and graders withheld, and the paper's runs use a private-seed world so exact numbers cannot be reproduced (Reproducibility statement).

primary_link.title: Argo-Bench: Evaluating Data Agents on Enterprise-Scale Workflows

papers.summary: Real-world enterprise data science and analytics workflows require reasoning across dozens of tables, performing statistical analyses, and acting on the results. Established text-to-SQL benchmarks evaluate query generation alone, and audits have found their answer keys frequently wrong. Because real enterprise warehouses are too sensitive to release, these benchmarks are built on public datasets where a business event fits in a single table. We introduce Argo-Bench, an evaluation framework compr
papers.summary_zh: 現有 text-to-SQL 基準多以公開資料測試查詢生成，涵蓋的表少、單一業務事件常只落在單一資料表，且審計發現其答案鍵錯誤率偏高（Spider 2.0-Snow 約 62.8%、BIRD Mini-Dev 約 52.8%），因此無法代表企業端橫跨數十張表、需統計分析並付諸行動的工作流程。作者提出 Argo-Bench，模擬 2024 年紐約市外送平台：8,100 萬筆訂單、340 萬名活躍顧客，以 34 個公開資料集與監理申報校準，並注入真實詐欺樣態，再投影成 Oracle E-Business Suite 格式、235 張表、74.9 億列的倉儲。模擬器的潛在狀態不寫入倉儲，代理須先從倉儲重建事實，再透過 Mission Control 介面提交封禁帳號、分配外送員獎金、發布儀表板資料源等行動；評分依模擬器中的後果計分（如封禁相對於全不封與全封的成本節省），而非比對查詢結果。210 項任務中 178 項涉及實際行動、99 項僅見部分月份。14 個前沿與開源模型中，最強者僅解出 34.8% 任務、平均 59.5 分，九個模型平均低於 35 分；典型失敗源自讀錯紀錄、最佳化錯目標、量錯數量與過度自信的預測區間（名目 80% 區間僅 44.8% 覆蓋）。限制包括僅單一城市、單一年份、單一 ERP 格式，且未模擬真實倉儲的資料漂移；作者強調此基準用於比較代理，不能直接外推真實企業表現。此工作的重要性在於把評測重心從「生成正確 SQL」轉向「在企業級資料環境中理解、導航並採取可問責的行動」。
papers.title: Argo-Bench: Evaluating Data Agents on Enterprise-Scale Workflows
papers.title_zh: Argo-Bench：在企業規模工作流程上評估資料代理

links.title: CARM: Cancellation-Aware Response Masking for LLM Reinforcement Learning

evidence: Abstract and Table 1: CARM improves four-dataset average mean@16 from 61.59 to 63.45 (Qwen3.5-4B) and 67.29 to 70.42 (Qwen3.5-9B) over GeoMean
Table 2: average pass@1 over TACO/LiveCodeBench-v6/HumanEval+/MBPP+ rises from 65.28 (GeoMean) to 68.31 (CARM), +3.03 points
Section 3.2 Proposition 1: alternating ratios B and 1/B yield s_GeoMean = 1 with every token outside the band; Appendix A.1 gives full construction
Section 3.4 Proposition 3 / Eq. 12-13: accepted responses satisfy p_out <= log(tau)/b_min, e.g. p_out <= 8.88% at tau=1.02 for band [0.8,1.28]
Section 3.3 Figure 3: on 1,024 unfiltered Qwen3.5-4B responses, d_CARM >= d_GeoMean for all, mean difference 0.0319, verifying Proposition 2 empirically
Section 5.2: negative-advantage-only masking drops AIME mean@16 from 75.63 to 60.28 on Qwen3.5-9B (Figure 6)
Appendix E Table 4: threshold sweep shows non-monotonic accuracy vs tau and model-specific best thresholds (1.02 for 4B, 1.025 for 9B)

llm_evaluation.rationale: Directly addresses LLM RL post-training (GRPO/PPO) with a response-level off-policy mask for math reasoning and code generation, hitting LLM, reasoning, training/optimization, and code-generation preferences. The core idea (average |log-ratio| instead of signed mean) is simple, with cancellation and triangle-inequality proofs that are correct but elementary; novelty lies mainly in the joint frequency-severity bound and the practical framing. Experiments cover two model sizes, two tasks, multiple benchmarks, three seeds, threshold sweeps, and an advantage-conditioning ablation against Null/IcePop/TRM/GeoMean baselines. Caveats: method-specific threshold grids (GeoMean vs CARM use different tau sets) confound clean comparison, best-checkpoint selection on AIME/LiveCodeBench, no reported variance or significance tests despite small gains on some benchmarks (e.g., TACO +0.67), IcePop sometimes beats GeoMean, and no code release is claimed. Scope is Qwen-only and verl/GRPO-specific, limiting demonstrated generality.

papers.summary: Recent years have witnessed the rapid adoption of reinforcement learning (RL) in large language model (LLM) post-training, with substantial gains in mathematical reasoning and code generation. In practical systems, however, policy updates and differences between rollout and training engines can make sampled responses off-policy. Sequence-level masking addresses this mismatch by deciding whether an entire response should contribute to optimization. A common masking rule uses the length-normalized
papers.summary_zh: 大型語言模型的強化學習後訓練中，rollout 引擎與訓練引擎之間的差異會使取樣回應變成 off-policy。序列層級的遮罩用來決定整段回應是否納入更新，常見做法是取 token 機率比之幾何平均（本文稱 GeoMean），但在對數空間中這等同於平均帶正負號的 log-ratio，正負變化會互相抵消。作者指出極端情形：所有 token 比值都落在指定區間之外，GeoMean 分數仍可為 1。為此提出 CARM（Cancellation-Aware Response Masking），先對每個 token 的 log-ratio 取絕對值再平均，避免方向相反的機率變化彼此抵消，同時對倒數形式的變化保持對稱。理論上，作者證明 CARM 接受的回應滿足一組聯合界限：落在非對稱比值帶外的 token 比例與其平均越界幅度共同受 log τ 的預算約束，讓序列層級門檻具備 token 層級的可解釋性；並證明在相同門檻下 CARM 的接受集是 GeoMean 接受集的子集。實驗以 verl 搭配 GRPO，在 DAPO Math 上訓練 Qwen3.5-4B 與 9B，評估 AIME 2024/2025/2026 與 BeyondAIME 的 mean@16，並在 TACO 訓練、以 LiveCodeBench-v6、HumanEval+、MBPP+ 評估程式生成。結果顯示相較 GeoMean，數學平均最高提升 3.13 個百分點，程式四個基準的平均 pass@1 提升 2.88 個百分點。分析指出遮罩比例相近時準確率仍可不同，準確率對遮罩比例並非單調，且僅遮罩負優勢回應會明顯變差。限制在於理論只涵蓋取樣 token 的比值，並非完整條件的 KL 散度，且實驗規模與基準數量有限。

links.title: Are We Recovering Mechanisms? Objective-Level Recovery Gaps in Mechanistic Interpretability

evidence: Section 3, Table 2: KL misranking rates up to 80.0% (task 111 R-C under zero) and 72.5% (C-C) on equally sized controlled candidates, with mean Q deficits reported per cell
Section 4, Tables 4-5: resampling C-C KL misranking of 20.0% (EAP), 30.4% (EAP-IG), 41.2% (ACDC), 9.4% (Edge-SP) on human-reference tasks
Section 5, Table 6 / Appendix D Table 24: restoring recipient-intact signals repairs 96 of 100 persistent KL misrankings (50/50 Human, 46/50 InterpBench) while circuits and Q values remain fixed
Appendix B, Tables 7-8: InterpBench reference conversion validated to max logit error 2.56e-13; size-preserving candidate inventories documented per task
Limitations section: behavioral criterion Q depends on ordinary resampling, tasks and search budgets limited, restoration cohort selected and not compared to random restoration
llm_evaluation.rationale: Mechanistic interpretability of language models (GPT-2 small and semi-synthetic transformers) fits LLM, transformer, and interpretability preferences strongly. The paper introduces a well-motivated 'objective-level recovery gap' showing faithfulness scores can misrank equally sized circuits, with a plausible 'context distortion' mechanism tested via a restoration intervention. Rigor is high: size-controlled pairs, frozen disjoint validation/test prompts, three metrics (KL/LD/PD) and three interventions, four discovery methods, tie handling, paired bootstrap uncertainty, and candid limitations (selected failure cohort, no random-restoration baseline, dependent pairs). Evidence is extensive and internally consistent (Tables 2-6, 22-26). Main weakness is generalizability: models are small (GPT-2 small, 4-layer code model, InterpBench), so claims about large modern LLMs are untested; no author code-release claim is verified.

primary_link.title: Are We Recovering Mechanisms? Objective-Level Recovery Gaps in Mechanistic Interpretability

papers.summary: Mechanistic interpretability aims to recover the internal computations responsible for model behavior. Progress in automated circuit discovery is often framed as a search problem: better attribution or optimization should identify better mechanisms. This assumes that the evaluation objective can recognize a better circuit once it is found. We show that intervention-defined faithfulness can instead prefer an equally sized circuit that reproduces the model's behavior less well, creating an objecti
papers.summary_zh: 這篇論文指出機械可解釋性（mechanistic interpretability）的一個根本問題：自動化電路探索常被視為搜尋問題，但即使搜尋更精準，若評估目標本身無法辨識出更好的電路，機制還原仍會失敗。作者將此稱為「目標層級還原落差」。他們以干預定義的忠實度（faithfulness）為檢驗對象，固定行為準則 Q（在保留提示上與完整模型答案的一致率，Greater-Than 則用語意準確率），比較驗證階段的忠實度分數與獨立測試行為的排序是否一致。研究涵蓋四個有人類參考電路的任務（IOI、Greater-Than、Docstring、Acronym）以及 InterpBench，並在等大小電路的前提下進行成對比較。結果顯示，在受控的同尺寸參考電路修改中，即使不涉及任何探索演算法，忠實度也會錯排；EAP、EAP-IG、ACDC 與 Edge-SP 四種方法的輸出池同樣出現此現象，在人類參考任務上僅用 ordinary resampling，KL 就錯排 9.4% 至 41.2% 的候選配對。作者進一步提出「脈絡扭曲」（context distortion）作為解釋：以捐贈者活化、平均值或零替換被排除訊號，改變了保留元件所處的計算脈絡。他們從探索池中挑出 100 個持續性 KL 錯排案例，改以接收端完整模型執行時的快取訊號部分還原脈絡，在驗證與獨立測試提示上成功修正 96 例，而電路本身與其原始行為分數維持不變。限制在於 Q 依賴 ordinary resampling、無法單獨證明機制同一性，任務與搜尋預算有限，配對彼此相依，還原實驗僅針對特定錯排族群，未證明最小因果集合或優於隨機還原。此研究的重要性在於：若評估目標偏好較差的候選，單靠改良電路探索並不足以達成機制還原，呼籲在忠實度之外並行報告固定行為準則、干預方式與電路大小控制。

llm_evaluation.rationale: Agentic Omni-LLM framework with multi-turn tool use, multi-hop CoT trajectories, and RL (GSPO) with an Audio-Visual Necessity reward — strongly aligned with LLM agents, reasoning/CoT, and multimodal LLM topics, though not Japanese NLP, safety, or code. Novelty is real but incremental over prior temporal-zoom and omni tool-use work (e.g., OmniReasoner, Video-o3); the attention-masking counterfactual necessity reward with min-gating is the main original element. Rigor is decent: phase-wise ablations, rollout-size scaling, text-only CoT control, dataset utility comparison, tool-call analysis; but no variance/significance reporting, single base model, English-only data. Results are quantitative across 10 omni + 4 video benchmarks with consistent gains. Hyperparameters and prompts are documented, but no explicit code/data/model release claim limits reproducibility.

primary_link.title: OmniSeek: Native Tool Integration for Multi-turn Audio-Visual Reasoning

papers.summary: We present OmniSeek, an agentic framework that transforms an Omni Large Language Model (Omni-LLM) into an active, multi-turn reasoning agent with native tool use. Rather than passively processing an entire audio-visual sequence in a single forward pass, OmniSeek makes evidence acquisition part of the reasoning process: it dynamically decides whether to look or listen, and over which temporal window, to retrieve sparse but critical evidence across different modalities within long contexts. Throug
papers.summary_zh: 現有 Omni-LLM 多採單次前向編碼，一次被動吸收整段音視覺串流；當上下文變長，細緻的視覺細節與短促的聲音事件會被稀釋，模型因而退回到語言先驗或單一模態捷徑。作者提出 OmniSeek，把音視覺推理改寫為主動的「找證據」過程：模型在 <think> → <tool_call> → <observe> 的多輪迴圈中，自行決定要看或要聽、以及鎖定哪個時間窗，並以 get_audio_clip 與 get_video_clip 兩個解耦工具，將檢索到的原始音訊或影像片段以更細的粒度直接附回上下文，直到判定證據充分才輸出答案。為冷啟動此行為，團隊建構三階段資料引擎，產出 OmniTraj-170K：涵蓋 39,797 支影片、169,725 條軌跡與 19 種跨模態題型，每題綁定 2 至 7 個帶時間戳的音訊或視覺證據片段。訓練採三階段：先以 SFT 對齊格式，再用 GSPO 進行可驗證獎勵的 RL，並於第三階段針對 8K 難例加入「音視覺必要性」獎勵——透過模態特定的注意力遮罩計算對數似然下降量，以 min 運算子強制軌跡同時依賴兩種模態，避免幻覺式接地。實驗在 10 個 Omni 基準上評估，相較基礎模型 Daily-Omni 提升 8.1、WorldSense 7.3、OmniVideoTest 15.0、VideoHolmes 15.5、LVOmni 8.4 分，並在一般影片理解基準上不降反升。限制方面，受限於 32K 上下文與音訊 token 隨時間線性成長，處理兩小時級長片時會出現格式崩解與重複思考迴圈；未來擬擴展上下文並採模態非對稱的 token 壓縮。

llm_evaluation.rationale: Agent/tool-use harness for multimodal LLMs (visual memory, inspect/read_pixels tools, ReAct-style reasoning, notes, context management) — squarely relevant to Agents & Tool Use, Multimodal AI, Reasoning, and Long Context & Memory. The core idea (lossless visual memory with model-directed re-inspection) is a sensible but incremental harness design rather than a new model/method. Rigor is strong: component-wise ablations (text grid→images→limits→continuous conversation→notes→memory/inspection→pixel readout), context-size and image-scale sweeps, an open-weight GLM-5.3 Flash run, 3D rendering robustness, 3-run variance, and per-game tables with the RHAE formula given. Evidence is quantitatively concrete (RHAE 40.68→100.00 on 25 public ARC-AGI-3 games, 57.4% fewer actions than human reference), but key baselines are partly organizer-published numbers rerun via subscription CLIs rather than APIs, and the authors themselves concede possible benchmark contamination since models postdate public games. Generalization across four benchmarks is credible but all are game/puzzle domains and private ARC-AGI-3 is untested. Reproducibility aided by GitHub code, full prompts and tool pseudocode, and an open-weight configuration; main headline results depend on closed models.

primary_link.title: VISTA: A Visual Harness for Reasoning in an Interactive World

We introduce VISTA, a visual harness that gives a general-purpose multimodal model long-horizon vision. VISTA allows the model to directly perceive the environment through visual observations and maintains a lossless visual memory that preserves past observations in their original form. The model can actively retrieve
papers.summary_zh: ARC-AGI-3 是要求代理在陌生互動遊戲中自行摸索規則與目標的基準，過去多半以文字或符號網格呈現環境，並靠程式合成建立可執行的世界模型。本論文把它重新定義為視覺問題，提出 VISTA：一種視覺化外掛框架（harness），讓通用多模態模型直接從渲染影像觀察環境，並以無損視覺記憶保存每一個回傳畫格（含中間動畫格），模型可在推理過程中主動檢索、放大任意矩形區域，或讀取精確像素值，形成對互動歷史的「顯式注意力」。方法純屬機械式工具層，不需訓練任何模型，並以 GUIDE.md 與 WORKING.md 兩份筆記維持跨層級與跨情境的理解。在 ARC-AGI-3 25 款公開遊戲上，Claude Opus 5.0 搭配 VISTA 取得 RHAE 100.00 的滿分，總動作數 7,302，比首次遊玩的人類基準少 57.4%；GPT-5.6 Sol 亦完成全部遊戲並達 99.00，官方最小外掛僅 13.33 與 40.68，且 VISTA 是首個不做程式合成即接近滿分的系統。消融顯示：影像取代文字網格、放寬動作上限、連續對話、筆記、無損視覺記憶與逐像素讀取皆逐步提升分數，且影像觀測的 token 用量遠低於 64×64 文字網格。同一框架在 GameWorld、AI GameStore 與 BabyVision 上也優於同模型的最小外掛基線。限制在於模型本身能力仍是關鍵，且無法排除公開遊戲已進入訓練資料；未來需在 ARC-AGI-3 私有集等新遊戲上驗證泛化。

llm_evaluation.rationale: Directly targets LLM decision-making with structured output from next-token probabilities over bracketed identifiers, plus fine-tuning (LoRA/full) with tree-factorized listwise loss and KL anchors; strong match to LLM, prompting/structured-output, training/optimization, and agent-decision topics. Method is a sensible combination of known ideas (prefix-free multi-token readouts, KL regularization against a frozen reference) rather than a breakthrough. Rigor is high: multiple baselines on the same backbone, sign tests, contamination filtering (§3.5, Appendix E), ablations over anchor weight and LoRA (§4.4, Table 12), and honest reporting of negative transfer and unexplained artifacts (option-1/10 effect, Appendix H). Evidence is quantitative across 5 evaluation suites, but rests on a small public JevBench subset with private held-out tests, exploratory data iteration, and only two Qwen backbones, so generality beyond this family is unproven. Reproducibility is decent (hyperparameters Table 3, public datasets, fixed seed) though no code release is stated and some datasets lack clear licenses.

primary_link.title: LLM2Jev: LLMs Are Already Jev-Style Decision Models -- When and How to Fine-Tune Them

papers.summary: Jev-style decision models return categorical probability distributions over predefined options without generating free-form text, enabling software systems to act on their outputs directly. In this work, we investigate the extent to which general-purpose LLMs already possess this capability out of the box, and when fine-tuning is actually necessary. We present LLM2Jev, an architecture-preserving framework that extracts calibrated decisions directly from next-token probabilities over bracketed nu
papers.summary_zh: 本文探討通用大型語言模型是否天生具備「Jev 式決策」能力，即直接輸出候選選項的類別機率分布，而不生成自由文本。作者提出 LLM2Jev，一個不改變模型架構、分詞器與詞彙表的框架：將選項編號為 [1]…[K]，以「Best answer: [」作為前綴，再從續接詞元的對數機率計算各候選的聯合機率。此介面具備前綴無關性，可支援任意數量選項（如 Banking77 的 77 類），並能直接套用於多模態模型。框架另提供 fine-tuning 配方：以樹狀分解的 listwise 損失訓練候選選擇，並以三個 KL 散度錨點約束合法詞元機率質量、非法詞元分布與其他位置的下一詞元分布，避免模型行為漂移。實驗以 Qwen3.5-4B 與 Qwen3-0.6B 為主，涵蓋外部基準、公開 JevBench、通用能力、多模態與對話行為。結果顯示，未經訓練的 4B 模型在 JevBench 達 81.4%，與同骨幹的社群 Jev 式模型相當，且校準良好（ECE 0.057）；多模態視覺決策可零樣本湧現。Fine-tuning 僅在訓練資料覆蓋特定缺口時有明顯效益，對強骨幹的廣泛任務則回報遞減；KL 錨點對維持生成穩定性至關重要，能力較強模型建議採用 LoRA。限制在於僅評測 231 題公開集，資料混合屬探索性，且部分錨點超參數未系統性消融。

llm_evaluation.rationale: Directly relevant to LLMs (LoRA/hypernetwork adaptation, test-time scaling, fine-tuning) with strong topical overlap on training, inference-time compute, and adaptation. Novel contribution: query-conditioned distributional hypernetworks over LoRA updates enabling weight-space test-time scaling, distinguishing itself from task-description-conditioned T2L/HyperTuning and prior LoRA generative/Bayesian work. Rigor is solid but not airtight: 5 base models, 7 benchmarks, multiple baselines (FullFT, LoRA, MoL, deterministic hypernet) and ablations (covariance choice, loss reduction, hypernet capacity, LoRA placement, task diversity, update reuse), but regression vs. mixing comparisons are confounded by unequal training exposure (bank trained 3 epochs plus 1 epoch hypernet vs. 1 epoch), no error bars or significance testing, GPQA-Diamond is small-sample, and the appendix table is truncated for Llama test-time scaling. Here we ask: how much adaptation signal can be obtained using only the input query to an LLM?. To answer this, we study query-conditioned Hypernetworks for LoRA estimation. Further, we introduce distributional Hypernetworks, able to produce not only point estimates of parameter adaptors, but also a dist
papers.summary_zh: 這篇論文探討一個關鍵問題：單一輸入查詢本身能提供多少模型適應的訊號？作者以超網路（hypernetwork）為基礎，跳脫過去需依賴任務描述或示範範例的做法，改為僅以 LLM 的查詢輸入直接預測 LoRA 更新，並進一步提出「分布式超網路」，不只輸出單一權重調整的點估計，而是輸出一個 LoRA 更新的機率分布。方法上，作者採用可微分的蒙地卡羅近似邊際對數概似，並設計高斯 LoRA 回歸與參考 LoRA 凸組合兩種參數化，同時比較平均、best-of-K 與 worst-of-K 等損失聚合方式。實驗涵蓋 Qwen3、Gemma3、Llama3.2 等五個 1B 至 4B 模型，以及 GSM8K、MATH500、HumanEval 等七項基準。主要結果顯示，分布平均值的表現比確定性超網路高出約 4.6 至 11.7 個百分點；更重要的是，作者提出「權重空間測試時擴展」：對每個查詢取樣多組權重更新以產生多個已適應模型，其多數投票結果可與固定權重下的 token 取樣相競爭，甚至更佳。此外，生成的更新具有跨查詢可重用結構，能彙整成共享 LoRA 並套用於未見查詢。限制在於實驗僅涵蓋 1B 至 4B 模型與 LoRA 適應，且超網路需常駐記憶體並增加一次前向傳遞；儘管如此，此工作將測試時擴展從 token 空間拓展至權重空間，對無梯度測試時適應具有重要意義。

Prolonged real-image training can erode grounding while benchmark gains persist. Both findings expose the same gap: an image in the prompt is not an image in the learning signal. papers.summary_zh: 這篇論文指出，可驗證獎勵強化學習（RLVR）在視覺語言模型上帶來的分數提升，未必代表模型真的學會使用影像。作者在 Geometry3K 上把訓練影像換成灰色畫布，3B 模型仍能回收約一半、7B 模型約四分之三的增益；而長時間以真實影像訓練搭配可訓練視覺編碼器時，基準分數持續上升，定位能力卻反而低於基礎模型，作者稱之為 grounding corrosion。問題核心在於：提示中出現影像，不等於學習訊號中存在影像。作者提出「視覺可解性」設計原則，要求正確答案必須仰賴視覺證據，同時任務仍可學習，並以反事實座標場景落實：問題固定、目標不以名稱給出，只給關係（例如 y 座標最小者），因此必須先在圖中找出目標。以標準 GRPO 與正確性加格式獎勵訓練 7B 模型，在比訓練更密的 20 點保留場景上，辨識目標的正確率由 0.425 升至 0.875，且未訓練過的題型與獨立建構的定位任務同樣改善。兩個對照指出增益來源：測試時改為灰色畫布，正確率降為零；以灰畫布訓練的控制組在配對步數與四個隨機種子下幾乎沒有增益。若在相同影像、獎勵與預算下加入可回答問題的說明文字，增益削減近三分之二。限制在於場景為人工座標圖，自然影像尚待驗證；但這說明改變獎勵所要求的事，就會改變強化學習學到的技能。

links.title: Trust the Direction, Search the Step: Zero-and-First-Order Methods for LLM Fine-Tuning

evidence: Abstract/§1: ZFO uses a trusted first-order direction plus two symmetric zeroth-order probes to select a curvature-aware step in [0, R_t]; four instances T2, T3, P2, P3 (Algorithm 1, §2).

§3.1 Theorem 1 and §B proof: CRN finite-difference curvature estimates concentrate with bias terms B*eps^2/12 and L*eps^2/20 plus O(1/sqrt(n)) sampling term; fixed-direction caveat stated in §3.1(ii).
§3.2 Theorem 3: stationarity bound 2*L_J(J*-J(theta_0))/(mu^2 T) + 2*L_J*Delta_T/mu^2, i.e., convergence to a neighborhood controlled by step-selection error.

Table 1: ZFO variants vs AdamW and MeZO across 12 model-dataset settings with mean±std over 3 seeds; e.g., Qwen-2.5-Math-1.5B MATH 31.77±1.63 (FO) vs 40.10±1.19 (Taylor2); Table 9: Padé3 improves FO in 14/16 settings, Taylor3 in 7/16.
Appendix C.2 Table 10: best ZFO variant beats AdamW+cosine and Prodigy on all 8 Qwen datasets, but worst ZFO variant falls below AdamW+cosine on several, noted as model-choice dependence.
Table 13: step-location diagnostics show Padé2 never selects interior steps and Padé3 fallback frequency rises to 54.95% at beta=3, acknowledged in §5.
Abstract and §4.2: code publicly available at https://github.com/nizswan/Zeroth-First-Order-Framework; Tables 4-7 give fixed settings, config types, LR/bound sweeps, and seeds {100,101,102}.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Directly targets LLM fine-tuning optimization (GRPO/RLVR with AdamW/Muon-style directions) and evaluates on mathematical/commonsense reasoning benchmarks with open LLMs (Qwen-2.5-Math, Phi-2, Gemma-2, Llama-3.2), matching high-weight LLM, reasoning, training/optimization, and RL preferences. The ZFO idea (zeroth-order probes along a trusted first-order direction for fixed-budget step selection, with Taylor/Padé local models) is a sensible generalization of GeN rather than a wholly new paradigm, but the unified framework framing plus separated error analysis is a genuine increment. Theory (CRN curvature concentration, local model near-optimality, stationarity to a neighborhood) is proved in full in Appendix B with stated assumptions; however Assumption 6 (direction alignment), the q_t/L_J-in-interval condition, and the fixed-direction concentration caveat are strong, and the Padé3 fallback fires 55% of the time at beta=3 (Table 13). Empirics are honest: 3 seeds with std devs, win-ratio accounting (14/16 for Padé3, 7/16 for Taylor3), additional FO baselines (cosine AdamW, Prodigy), line-search comparisons (ZFO-Seq vs Armijo/BB/Polyak/PLS), beta=1 control, alpha-beta ablation, wall-clock (~5.2%) and memory (11-19%) overhead, and candid reinterpretation of the ARC result. Limits: models only 1.2-2.7B, one fine-tuning paradigm (GRPO), some huge std devs (e.g., Taylor2/OpenBookQA ±17.85), and the theory's idealized same-surrogate probes differ from the RLVR implementation (acknowledged in C.1.1). Code link and detailed hyperparameter/config tables (Tables 4-7) support reproduction.

primary_link.title: Trust the Direction, Search the Step: Zero-and-First-Order Methods for LLM Fine-Tuning

papers.summary: Step-size selection remains a central challenge in large-scale neural network optimization; conservative steps slow convergence, while aggressive steps can destabilize it. We combine \textbf{Z}ero-and-\textbf{F}irst-\textbf{O}rder optimization~(ZFO) and propose a lightweight framework that decouples direction selection from step-size. ZFO uses a trusted first-order optimizer to determine the direction and performs zeroth-order evaluations only along this one-dimensional subspace to choose how fa
papers.summary_zh: 這篇論文處理大型神經網路最佳化中長久存在的步長選擇難題：步長太保守會拖慢收斂，太激進則可能使訓練不穩定。作者提出 ZFO 框架，把「方向選擇」與「步長決定」解耦：方向仍交由可信的一階最佳化器（如 AdamW、Muon）產生，而步長則只在該方向上做零階評估。具體做法是在固定 minibatch 下，利用反向傳播已有的方向導數，加上 ±ϵ 兩個對稱前向探測，據此估出二階與三階方向導數，再以 Taylor（T2、T3）或 Padé（P2、P3）區域模型在搜尋區間 [0, R] 內選出曲率感知的步長。理論上，作者證明共同隨機數下的有限差分曲率估計會集中於母體值、區域模型最大化可取得近似最佳步長，並給出收斂至穩態鄰域的保證，誤差由累積步長選擇誤差控制。實驗涵蓋 Qwen-2.5-Math-1.5B、Phi-2、Gemma-2-2B、Llama-3.2-1B 在 GSM8K、MATH、SVAMP、AsDiv、OpenBookQA 等推理基準上的 RLVR 微調，另含經典最佳化問題與玩具環境驗證。結果顯示至少一種 ZFO 變體在幾乎每個模型—資料集組合上優於一階基準，Padé3 與 Taylor2 在 16 個設定中各有 14 次勝出；相對於 AdamW 搭配餘弦退火與 Prodigy 等自適應基準亦具優勢。成本方面，每次迭代僅多兩次前向探測，牆鐘時間約增 5.2%，但 GPU 記憶體峰值增加 11% 至 19%，且 MeZO 的記憶體節省技巧無法直接套用。限制在於最佳區域模型隨任務而異、搜尋半徑與學習率需共同調整（β 過大在較大 α 下會不穩）、Padé 需靠極點回退機制，且理論保證依賴平滑性、子高斯與方向對齊等假設，收斂僅到穩態鄰域而非精確穩態點。其意義在於把 GeN 等單一步長規則提升為固定查詢預算的方向性建模框架，讓昂貴的線搜尋有了輕量替代方案。

llm_evaluation.rationale: Highly relevant to LLMs, alignment/model-spec auditing, evaluation, and LLM-as-judge reasoning: VeriSpec extracts structured rules from the OpenAI Model Spec, clusters them on a topic-guided graph, and uses an LLM-as-verifier to detect inconsistencies, validated by manual review and reported to developers. Novel framing (auditing the spec text rather than model behavior) with a coherent formal definition and a five-baseline ablation-style comparison. Rigor is decent (two-reviewer validation, Cohen's kappa checks on topic tests, permutation test on topic validity, matched detection budget across baselines) but limited by a single specification, single verifier model, constructed rather than existing baselines, small validated counts (5 vs 13 reported), and no reported annotator agreement on final labels. Generalizability is asserted but only demonstrated on one document; reproducibility is aided by released code and detailed appendices but hindered by reliance on proprietary frontier models and a Claude Code-based anonymization/annotation pipeline.

papers.summary: Model specifications define how large language models (LLMs) should behave, guiding alignment training, inference-time behavior, and evaluation. Yet these specifications may themselves contain defects: two individually reasonable principles may prescribe incompatible behavior when applied to the same situation, leaving no response that satisfies both. Detecting such inconsistencies is challenging. Formalizing natural-language specifications risks losing subtle distinctions, while behavior-based
papers.summary_zh:
本文探討模型規範（model spec）本身的內部矛盾：兩條各自合理的原則，套用於同一情境時可能無法同時滿足，使模型無論如何回應都違反其一。過去做法各有侷限，將自然語言規範形式化容易流失 must、should、例外與軟性義務等語意細節，而以模型行為為基礎的測試則難以區分「規範有缺陷」與「模型行為差異」，且模型與規範更新時程不同步，缺陷也可能因模型恰好一致地解讀而不顯現。

作者提出 VeriSpec，主張保留自然語言、改以 LLM 作為驗證器。流程分三階段：首先進行情境感知的規則擷取，將每條原則轉為（標註、權威層級、前置條件、後置條件）的結構化規則，並附上解讀所需的脈絡；其次建構主題導向的規則圖，以語意邊與句法邊連結同一權威層級下行為相關的規則，聚類成精簡的分析單元；最後以 LLM-as-verifier 對每個單元推理，唯有能提出具體見證情境、說明兩規則同時適用，並論證合併脈絡無法化解衝突時，才回報不一致。

在 OpenAI Model Spec 上，VeriSpec 擷取出 405 條規則、建構 32 個分析單元，五次驗證嘗試後得到 13 個候選不一致，經兩位審查者人工驗證確認 5 個，涵蓋法律限制、程式碼轉換、僅輸出任務、虛構角色扮演與諂媚式安慰，並已回報給開發者。相較五個基線方法，VeriSpec 的 precision 最高（38.5%），每個已驗證不一致的成本最低（11.12 美元）。

限制在於驗證仍依賴人工判讀，且僅在單一公開規範上評估，成本與涵蓋範圍也受規則擷取與主題註冊品質影響。其意義在於把規範文本本身視為稽核對象，挑戰「規範即 ground truth」的預設，可與行為對齊評估互補，在缺陷影響模型之前於源頭發現。

evidence: Section 5.2 / Table 1: SourceLearn best in 13 of 15 settings; avg. gains over Hybrid RAG of +14.3, +4.9, +13.4 for the three backends; up to +22.6 on APIBench (GPT-5.6-Luna).
Section 5.3 / Figure 3: ablation on two sources per QA benchmark shows full M_T best on all three benchmarks; removing either learning stage or either task-guided pathway lowers accuracy.
Section 5.4 / Figure 4: explicit-condition units rise from ~30% (M_0) to 65-82% (M_T); required-claim coverage 23.2% -> 40.0%; accuracy 67.5% (no claims covered) vs 86.6% (all covered).
Appendix B.1 / Figure 5: removing gold document drops Hybrid RAG ~25 points vs ~8 for SourceLearn on MultiDoc2Dial.
Appendix B.2 / Table 2: under matched context budgets, SourceLearn best on 3 of 4 sources, second on Sphinx.
Appendix B.3 / Tables 3-4: contradictions <=1% and 93-100% of dropped claims preserved, but M_T on StudentAid shows 13.3% unsupported units.
Appendix B.4 / Table 5: gains over Hybrid RAG +14.9 seen vs +12.1 unseen regions (All QA), suggesting transfer beyond guidance-task regions.
Appendix A.3: one Inspect-Study-Consolidate cycle with K=20 study actions, B=24k token activation budget; Appendix B.5 / Table 6 shows no consistent gains beyond the first cycle.
Conclusion: limitation stated — only persistent, authoritative, relatively stable sources with repeated same-source tasks are studied.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Strongly relevant to LLM agents, RAG/knowledge grounding, and agent memory: proposes 'source learning' via a persistent source model refined by self-directed study and task-guided refinement. The framing is a useful reframing of agent memory + iterative RAG rather than a fundamentally new mechanism, but the design (grounded reconstruction, failure-guided vs cross-task pathways) is coherent. Evaluation is reasonably thorough: 5 benchmarks (document QA, code QA, tool use, interactive env), 3 LLM backends, 13/15 best settings with clear gains over Hybrid RAG/RAPTOR/HippoRAG 2/AWM, plus ablations of both learning stages and both task-guided pathways, matched-context-budget control, retrieval-degradation robustness, grounding/preservation audits, and seen/unseen region transfer. Limitations acknowledged: only persistent authoritative sources; some M_T units partially/unsupported per Table 3; single-cycle choice motivated post hoc by diminishing returns (Table 6); QA judged by an LLM judge (GPT-5.6-Luna) also serving as a backend; no variance across splits reported in main table. Reproducibility aided by released code, full prompts, splits, and implementation details, though several backends and the judge are proprietary.

primary_link.title: From Knowledge Access to Source Learning: Developing Source-Specific Competence

papers.summary: Large language model (LLM) agents increasingly rely on persistent external sources to solve sequences of knowledge-intensive tasks. Existing methods improve how source content is accessed and organized, while agent-memory systems preserve reusable knowledge from prior interactions, but repeated use of the same source is still largely treated as repeated access rather than an opportunity to progressively improve understanding of that source. We study source learning: developing reusable source-sp
papers.summary_zh: 大型語言模型代理日益依賴持久的外部來源來解決一連串知識密集任務，但既有方法多半只改善來源內容的存取與組織，或保存過去互動所得的經驗，對同一來源的反覆使用仍被視為重複存取，而非逐步深化理解該來源的機會。本文提出「來源學習」，目標是在一個持久且具權威性的來源上，發展可重用的「來源專屬能力」，並以持久、可修訂的「來源模型」來表徵這份能力，涵蓋來源知識如何被結構化、詮釋與應用。作者提出 SourceLearn，結合兩種互補機制：自主導向來源學習會辨識理解仍不完整之處並自適應地重新研讀來源，任務導向來源學習則利用下游任務經驗揭露局部表徵缺口與反覆出現的組織需求。兩者皆以學習訊號決定何處應重新檢視，但持久更新一律由權威來源重新建構，任務答案本身不會被直接寫入記憶。在五項基準、三種 LLM 後端下，SourceLearn 於 15 組設定中拿下 13 組最佳，相較 Hybrid RAG 最大提升達 22.6 分，並優於靜態來源表徵與經驗式記憶基線。分析顯示，學習後模型表徵由孤立查找內容轉向規則與程序，具明確適用條件的單元比例由約三成升至六成五至八成二，未來任務所需來源主張的覆蓋率由 23.2% 升至 40.0%，且覆蓋率越高準確率越高。限制在於目前僅針對持久、權威且相對穩定的來源與重複同源任務，如何延伸至持續演變、雜訊或相互衝突的來源仍待研究。

llm_evaluation.rationale: Directly targets LLM post-training via GRPO/RLHF-style policy optimization with LLM-as-a-Judge pseudo-rewards, aligning strongly with LLM, alignment/RLHF, and reasoning preferences. Novel element is pairwise comparison of conformally calibrated reward intervals whose width weighting can flip advantage signs, with a clean Dr.GRPO point-collapse special case (Prop. 1) and a contrast to response-level reweighting (Prop. 2, Eq. 4). Rigor is decent: controlled toy comparison with shared data/range construction, ablation of scalar reductions (LB/Midpoint/UB under GRPO and Dr.GRPO), UARM and TraPO baselines, prompt-allocation and response-budget accounting (Table 10), and wall-clock runtime (Table 16). Main weakness is that main-experiment results are single runs per configuration (Appendix C), with only the toy using three seeds, so the reported 5.2%/7.0% ID/OOD gains lack variance estimates; no ablation over lambda in the main setting, no sensitivity to miscoverage alpha, and no code/data availability statement. Generality is limited to math + reasoning benchmarks with a single 7B backbone, though the framework is domain-agnostic in principle.

primary_link.title: Range-GRPO: Policy Optimization via Pairwise Relations among Reward Intervals

papers.summary: As the use of large language models (LLMs) expands, post-training has become increasingly important for adapting them to downstream tasks. However, obtaining reliable supervision remains costly, especially in domains without reference answers or executable verifiers. LLM-as-a-Judge provides scalable pseudo-rewards for unlabeled responses, but a single point score does not explicitly represent reward uncertainty. This motivates representing pseudo-rewards as conformally calibrated reward ranges.
papers.summary_zh: 這篇論文處理半監督式 LLM 後訓練中「獎勵不可靠」的問題：在沒有標準答案或可執行驗證器的領域，常以 LLM-as-a-Judge 產生偽獎勵，但單一分數無法表達評估本身的不確定性。作者提出 Range-GRPO，先用穩健加權保形推論（RoWCI）為每個回應建構經校準的獎勵區間，再改寫 GRPO 的優勢估計方式：不再把區間壓縮成單點獎勵，而是對群組內所有回應兩兩比較區間中點差，並以兩區間半寬之和所構成的權重 ω_ij = λ/(h_i+h_j+λ) 衰減不確定性較高的比較項。理論上，作者證明當所有區間寬度退化為零時，Range-GRPO 的優勢恰等於 Dr.GRPO；而在中點獎勵固定下，區間寬度仍可改變優勢的正負號，這是僅對點獎勵做正向重縮放的 UARM 做不到的。實驗包含合成候選選擇任務與真實推理基準：前者平均測試準確率 39.40%，高於最佳純量縮減法 7.63 個百分點，且平均區間寬度最小；後者以 Qwen2.5-Math-7B 搭配 Qwen3-4B-Instruct 評審，在 ID 與 OOD 平均準確率上皆為受評半監督方法中最高，較最強基線分別提升 5.2% 與 7.0%，且總回應預算比 TraPO 少約 18.2%。限制在於多數基準僅單次訓練、部分基線為重現結果，保形覆蓋率仍依賴可交換性假設，且需額外配置評審與密度比估計流程；但其價值在於指出獎勵不確定性除了調整學習訊號強度，也能改變其方向。

llm_evaluation.rationale: Highly relevant: agentic LLM forecasting with multi-turn tool use (web search, retrieval, time series) trained end-to-end via outcome-based RL (GRPO/LoRA) on Qwen3.5-35B-A3B with a Brier reward, touching agents/tool use, RL, RAG-style evidence gathering, evaluation, and reasoning. Novel step is folding context acquisition into the RL training loop with layered temporal leak filtering (blocklist, date filter, LLM keep/drop judge benchmarked across 5 judges), which addresses a genuine gap in prior frozen-context forecasting work. Rigor is decent but not strong: identical-harness comparison across 4 frontier models, pre-declared uncertain subset, calibration/coverage/search-effort measurements and variant runs (market-visible, search-off) constitute partial ablations, yet n=265 test, single training epoch/seed, and no significance tests or CIs; the headline 'beats Claude Opus 4.5' margin (0.254 vs 0.256) is well within noise and the paper makes no effort to quantify that. Evidence is quantitative and traceable (figures, per-question gaps, cost accounting, verbatim rollouts), but some claims (30-40% calibration improvement 'holds in every variant run') rest on repository data not shown in the text. Generalizability is limited to binary Polymarket questions, one open model, and one reward; the harness itself is reusable. Reproducibility is a strength: open environment, dataset, run configs, per-rollout records, open-source training stack.

papers.summary_zh: 這篇論文針對預測市場（Polymarket）的機率預測任務，指出既有做法有兩大限制：一是訓練前就把研究脈絡凍結（例如預先貼上的新聞標題或預先生成的「研究階段」），二是只在測試時才讓模型進行代理式研究，導致「蒐集證據」這項技能從未真正被獎勵訊號塑造。作者因此建立一套代理式預測環境、資料集與測試框架，涵蓋 2,100 多題已結算的 Polymarket 題目；代理在 rollout 時自行取得脈絡，包括網頁搜尋、頁面閱讀與金融時間序列，並以分層外洩過濾（網域黑名單、日期啟發式規則、以及以 Claude Haiku 逐筆判斷保留或丟棄）確保只使用各題截止日之前發布的資訊。方法上，作者以單一 epoch 的 GRPO、Brier 分數獎勵，對 Qwen3.5-35B-A3B（3B 活躍參數）進行訓練，並刻意隱藏市場價格工具，使模型只能靠研究與先驗來取得獎勵。主要結果顯示：訓練後校準改善 30–40%，每次 rollout 的搜尋次數由 3.8 降至 2.25，顯示證據紀律被學到；在完全相同的測試框架下與四個前沿模型比較，訓練後策略在「以證據為基礎的預測」上勝過所有受測前沿模型，包括以 soft-Brier 0.254 對 0.256 些微領先 Claude Opus 4.5（n=265），而推論成本約僅 5%，且在群眾本身尚未決定的困難題目上優勢最明顯。限制方面，作者自己指出所有比較都建立在檢索與外洩過濾之上，若讓市場價格可見，各模型都會趨向群眾而難以真正勝過它；此外訓練僅一輪、題目限於二元結果，統計差距在部分配對上相當接近。整體而言，本文的貢獻在於把脈絡取得納入 RL 迴圈，讓「研究本身」成為可學習的時間性技能，並開源環境、資料集與逐次 rollout 紀錄，為時間性預測代理提供可重現的評測基礎。

Appendix E.2: EoH upgraded to gemini-3-pro-preview still shows median cost ~26 vs TRACE below 1 on Scenario 1, supporting the claim that the architectural component rather than the LLM drives the gap
Appendix E.1: with gemma-3-27b and Llama-3.1-70B, Coder failures to produce valid surrogate-training code cause sharp degradation, indicating dependence on code-generation reliability

llm_evaluation.rationale: Highly relevant LLM/agent work: TRACE augments LLM-based automatic heuristic design with a Reasoner/Coder agentic workflow that mines system logs into insights and executable surrogate tools, feeding them into an evolutionary code-generation loop (Sec. 3, Algorithm 1). The core novelty - letting an agent decide what to extract from execution logs and write the extraction code, including callable surrogates, instead of scalar fitness only - is a genuine, well-scoped contribution to LLM-driven heuristic/program synthesis (Sec. 5). Rigor is solid: equal generation budget (3000) with the same open-weight backbone for all AHD baselines, 10 runs with distribution plots, a clean ablation (TRACE without agentic workflow reduces to EoH, Sec. 4.2), and LLM-backbone controls in Appendix E including running EoH on the same frontier model as TRACE's Reasoner. Quantitative evidence is clear but narrow: two scenarios of one synthetic cloud benchmark (Tables 1, Fig. 4) and one 5G vRAN case study (Table 2), with the cloud processing-time model being a simple linear inner product (Appendix B); auditability uses an LLM-judge panel on a single heuristic per method (Table 3/6, self-admittedly indicative). Generalizability is limited to resource-assignment/scheduling settings despite claimed orthogonality to the evolutionary backbone. Reproducibility is aided by full prompts, pseudocode, and config (Appendices C, H), but no code release is stated and the 5G case relies on external measurement datasets.

papers.summary: Dynamic resource assignment, the real-time allocation of task streams to heterogeneous processing nodes, is the backbone of modern computing infrastructure. While learning-based schedulers excel in research, industrial deployments still rely on hand-written rules that operators can read, audit, and execute within tight latency budgets. LLM-based Automatic Heuristic Design (AHD) promises to automate writing such rules. However, existing AHD frameworks were developed for combinatorial problems ful
papers.summary_zh: 動態資源分配是現代運算基礎設施的核心，但業界仍偏好可稽核、可即時執行的人工規則。近年以 LLM 驅動的自動啟發式設計（AHD）雖能自動產生規則，卻只依賴單一純量適應度分數：它能得知哪個啟發式較好，卻無法解釋原因。而決定好壞的系統行為（如處理器速度、能耗曲線、佇列容量）事前未知，相關線索其實都記錄在每次評估產生的系統日誌中。作者提出 TRACE，將演化式 AHD 迴圈與代理人式知識萃取流程結合：Reasoner 代理人依最佳化目標分析日誌欄位結構並提出假設，Coder 代理人則針對該結構撰寫並執行測試程式，產出語意洞察或可呼叫的代理模型（如處理時間預測器），再合併回生成提示中引導新一代啟發式。研究在合成雲端基準（10 與 50 台異質伺服器）與以工業級測試平台量測、搭配真實電信流量軌跡的 5G vRAN 情境上評估。結果顯示 TRACE 在資源分配上穩定優於 FunSearch、EoH、ReEvo、HSEvo 等最先進 AHD 方法：50 伺服器情境下是唯一達成零任務遺失者，成本較最佳基線低約 36 倍；5G 情境維持 0% 遺失，能耗較業界標準低約 65%、較 EoH 低約 25%。以 LLM 評審評估的可稽核性亦最高，額外負擔低於 2%。限制在於成效取決於日誌是否含足夠資訊欄位、代理人能否寫出有效程式；若失敗則退化為純量回饋的 EoH，且一次性探索成本約 2.5 小時。

llm_evaluation.rationale: A benchmark/evaluation paper on LLM companion memory and user understanding built from ten real longitudinal conversations, with verbatim probes, per-item reasoning traces, and three tracks (reconstruction, chat, question). Highly relevant to LLMs, memory/RAG, agents, and NLP evaluation. Novel aspects include measuring the natural memory-demand rate (3.4% of messages), the decomposition showing 96% of pooled ablation gain lands on probes that need no memory (Proposition 2), and auditable stage-by-stage traces with 26 mechanical gates. Rigor is strong for a dataset paper (controls, bootstrap over participants, independent audit, macro vs pooled aggregation, monotonically one-sided verification). Evidence is quantitatively dense but bounded: 10 subjects from one application, single-reader on-screen judgments, LLM-derived gold labels, modest judge agreement on the graded scale (kappa 0.545), and an internal inconsistency on the question-track defect rate (28.8% in Table 26 vs 3.8% in H.2). Generalizability is the main weakness (single product, English after rewriting, memory-demand quantities rest on 5 subjects under the strict reading). Reproducibility is good: data and code released with schemas, prompts, and reproduction map.

It should remember what they said, infer who they are, and know when the past bears on the message in front of it. Testing this requires a real person's record, and such records are private, so benchmarks generate the person and the questions and settle in advance what matters. We release \bench, ten real relationships with an AI companion: 27,218 messages over up to 120 days, released as the conversation and four fi
papers.summary_zh: 這篇論文發布 RealCompanion，內含十段真實的人與 AI 陪伴者關係，橫跨最長 120 天、共 27,218 則訊息，並附上由對話衍生的四份檔案：profile（使用者陳述過的事實）、persona（其思考、感受與決策方式）、chat ground truth 與 question set，每一項標註都指出它所依據的訊息，並附上產生該標註的推理軌跡。作者指出，既有記憶與個人化 benchmark 多以生成對話、預先宣告的 persona 與人為撰寫的題目構成，等於在系統看到資料前就回答了「誰是這個人」與「過去哪句話此刻有關」；生成式對話幾乎每則訊息都需要過去，作者撰寫的題目會洩漏線索，而腳本化的歷史不會自我修訂。實測結果顯示，在自然取樣的訊息中僅 3.4%（嚴格判讀下 1.3%）真正需要近期脈絡之外的記憶，且所需訊息中位數遠在 2,157 則之前；但供給正確證據能使內容匹配提升 0.455。問題在於「何時該回頭找」：作者嘗試的偵測器在真實訊息上幾乎只有隨機水準（AUROC 0.530），相較之下在作者撰寫的題目上可達 0.802。此外，把同樣十則訊息標為「檢索到的記憶」而非「先前的對話輪次」，會讓記憶使用率上升十到十四個百分點。在重建軌上，三個 agent 系統以相同 F1（約 0.69–0.70）重建 persona，但處理 token 數相差約三十一倍。限制包括：十位使用者僅來自單一應用、非任何母體樣本；匿名化改寫全部訊息，作者指出風格計量分類器與語言模型仍可辨識作者身分；部分判讀由單一讀者完成。此研究的意義在於提供第一份以真人逐字對話為基礎、可逐項追溯與反駁的長期記憶評測，並證明彙總式的 ablation 會把大部分效益歸因於其實不需要記憶的訊息，對現行記憶系統的設計假設提出直接反證。

Section 5.4, Table 6: external τ2-bench, 278 tasks, three domains, Mingbird 0.856 vs 0.791 (native) and 0.737 (opencode); the paper discloses pooled native-agent significance leans on the near-saturated telecom domain (p=0.22 on retail+airline subset).

Section 5.6, Table 9 and Figure 9: leave-one-mechanism-out at 2B (n=18/arm) gives finish gate -0.098, verify feedback -0.048, anti-loop -0.015, flat prefill -0.003, but all bootstrap 95% CIs cross zero and same-arm replications move means by up to 0.069; the paper labels these directional only.

Section 5.6 (common-cause disclosure): LH-01 falls 0.67-0.72 in all four ablation arms and a fresh full-mechanism re-run lands in the low mode (0.740 vs 0.821), evidencing batch variance; the only batch-matched comparison (full stack vs text-re-read-only, three replications) favors executable guards at +0.096/+0.133/+0.056.

Section 6 Threats to Validity: self-built benchmark, single Windows machine, dev-eval overlap (M4 developed on WF-08), single-trial greedy cells, cloud simulator not frozen — all stated by the authors.
Appendix B: repository, per-cell CSVs, significance scripts, Ollama manifest SHA-256 digests, arm versions, and version/measurement caveats published (Apache-2.0).
llm_evaluation.rationale: Directly on-target for agent harness/tool-use with small local LLMs: a systems paper (no new algorithm) mapping small-model failure forms to harness mechanisms (finish gate, flat net-zero prefill, signature loop detection) and evaluating them under controlled harness-only variation. Rigor is unusually candid — full 288-cell publication, paired Wilcoxon/Holm tests with bootstrap CIs, external τ2-bench replication, and explicit disclosure that the self-built benchmark, single machine, single-trial cells, and ablation CIs all crossing zero limit claims; the ablation is honestly demoted to directional after same-arm replication variance (up to 0.069) matched nominal deltas. Generalizability is constrained by one Windows machine, one model per tier, dev/eval overlap (M4 developed on LRAB task WF-08), and a single external benchmark family with a non-official simulator. Reproducibility is excellent: code, per-cell CSVs, model manifest digests, scripts, and version pinning in Appendix B.

primary_link.title: Mingbird: A Local-First Agent Harness Enabling Small Open Models to Complete Real Tasks

papers.summary: Small open-weight models (2-9B) run on ordinary laptops, but under cloud-scale agent harnesses they rarely complete real tasks: tool prefill overflows the context, self-correction diverges, tool demonstrations loop, and tasks are silently abandoned. We present evidence, from a controlled single-machine comparison and one third-party benchmark, that a substantial share of these failures is attributable to the harness rather than the model. We introduce Mingbird, a local-first agent harness for Wi
papers.summary_zh: 這篇論文處理一個實務痛點：2B 至 9B 的開源權重模型雖能在一般筆電上順暢推論，但放進為雲端大型模型設計的代理框架（agent harness）後，幾乎無法完成真實任務。作者主張，這些失敗多數不是模型能力不足，而是外殼（scaffold）的工程缺陷，並歸納出四種典型失效型態：工具預填（prefill）佔滿脈絡、失敗後無法自我修正、在工具示範上無限迴圈，以及產物不存在卻宣稱完成。為此他們提出 Mingbird，一套面向 Windows 與 Ollama 的本機優先代理框架，以十項核心機制逐點對應上述失效型態，其中三項最具代表性：位元組級淨零預填預算、在受理完成前重讀任務原文的完成閘門（finish gate），以及以簽章（工具名稱加上正規化參數）為單位的迴圈偵測。評估上，作者自建 LRAB 受控基準，固定機器、模型、預算與評分，只變動框架，涵蓋 4 套框架、4 個開源模型（2B 至 35B）與 18 個真實任務共 288 格，全部逐格公開；Mingbird 總分 0.886，高於 goose 0.631、opencode 0.479、agent-mini 0.405，且是唯一在 2B 層級沒有崩塌的框架。第三方驗證採用 τ²-bench 三個領域共 278 題，Mingbird 為 0.856，對比原生代理 0.791、opencode 0.737；前沿模型探針則顯示缺陷外殼可埋沒超過一半能力，而結構良好的外殼彼此差距僅 0.072。限制方面，作者坦承 LRAB 為自建基準、僅單一機器、單次試驗，且留一機制消融僅具方向性，因為同一臂的隔夜重複實驗平均變動可達 0.069，與名目單次差異同量級。整體而言，本文的貢獻是系統工程而非新演算法：指出哪些框架行為會壓垮小模型，並證明修好它們能大幅改變可量測的成果。

llm_evaluation.rationale: Multimodal MoE work highly relevant to LLM/VLM foundation models, MoE transformer architecture, interpretability (logit-lens-style router decoding), and PEFT/efficiency, though core target topics (reasoning, agents, safety, Japanese NLP) are absent and medical/remote sensing appear mainly as evaluation domains. ExpertLens (data-free router-weight decoding to identify domain experts, then selective expert fine-tuning) is a reasonably novel synthesis of logit lens and routed fine-tuning. Rigor is strong: FFT and LoRA baselines with matched budget, two random-selection controls, frequency and privileged-oracle selectors, parameter-group ablations, three domain orderings, threshold sensitivity, and routing-stability analysis; three seeds with 95% CIs and statistical tests (Hartigan dip, Pearson r). Evidence is quantitatively detailed (e.g., 64.6 vs 63.8 math, 4.0x average speedup, Table 1/2/3/4), though some claims rest on figure-only data and semantic relevance labeling uses an LLM judge (Qwen3-VL), acknowledged as a noise source. Generalizability shown across Qwen3-VL-30B-A3B, Kimi-VL-A3B, and Gemma-4 for analysis, with adaptation on two models (Kimi speedup only 1.53x and expert classification borrowed from Qwen). Strong reproducibility: released code/data/models, full prompts and hyperparameters in appendix.

primary_link.title: Harnessing Domain Specialists in Multimodal Mixture-of-Experts for Efficient Adaptation

papers.summary: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architectures scale model capacity through sparse computation, routing each token through only a small subset of experts. In this work, we explore whether this sparsity gives rise to emergent intrinsic organization in multimodal MoEs. We find that experts develop strong semantic specialization across modalities and domains despite not being explicitly trained for modularity. Building on this structure, we introduce ExpertLens, a data-free method that identifies domain-sp
papers.summary_zh: 這篇論文探討多模態混合專家模型（MoE）的稀疏路由是否會自然形成語意分工。作者分析 Qwen3-VL-30B-A3B、Kimi-VL-A3B 與 Gemma-4 26B-A4B 三個模型，發現專家在未被特別訓練模組化的情況下，仍展現明顯的模態偏好（偏圖像或偏文字），視覺表徵更依語意領域聚類，且語意相近但外觀差異大的物件類別會招募重疊的專家集合，顯示分工反映語意而非低階視覺統計。基於此結構，作者提出 ExpertLens：一種無需領域資料的方法，將路由器權重經語言模型輸出頭解碼為詞彙 token，再以模型自身判定 token 與目標領域的關聯，藉此找出領域專屬專家。適配實驗在數學、醫療與遙測三個領域依序進行，只微調被選中的專家 MLP，並更新路由器、QKV 投影與 LM head；結果顯示 ExpertLens 可匹敵甚至超越全參數微調，僅更新 21.7% 至 47.0% 的參數，平均訓練加速約 4.0 倍，並在效能與效率上均優於 LoRA；與相同預算的隨機專家選擇相比也較佳。限制方面，token 層級分類會受碎片、標點與控制 token 干擾而產生雜訊標籤，且需要語言模型輔助判定；不過路由器在持續適配中仍維持約九成以上的路由結構穩定。此研究的意義在於指出為效率而引入的稀疏性可孕育可解讀的語意模組化，並可直接用於降低適配成本。

llm_evaluation.rationale: In-scope benchmark/evaluation work on LLM-based literature retrieval and search agents (Agents & Tool Use, RAG/Knowledge, LLM, Evaluation). Novel contribution: author-firsthand 'catalyst paper' labels capturing undocumented inspiration, with pre-discovery queries, temporally filtered 191K corpus, and hard negatives judged non-inspiring despite topical similarity. Rigor is strong: sparse/dense/multi-vector retrievers and three agent designs with knowledge-cutoff controls (Table 3, Sec 4.1), plus ablations on query rewriting (Table 5), reading depth (Table 25), source context vs. web vs. bibliography (Table 22), oracle gold injection (Table 20), and coverage/ranking/recognition failure decomposition (Sec D.6). Claims are quantitatively supported and mostly carefully hedged (e.g., Claude Fable 5.1 flagged as post-cutoff comparison, Sec 4.1). Weaknesses: CoreQ set is small (n=207) and several analyses use 50-100 query subsets; labels are retrospective single-author judgments with acknowledged hindsight bias and an unmeasured performance ceiling (Limitations, Sec 5); taxonomy coding and rationale agreement use an LLM judge with self-agreement acknowledged as an upper bound (Sec 4.3, Sec D.6); scope is restricted to CS/AI papers from 2025-2026 at top venues, limiting generalizability. Dataset, code, and full prompts are promised (front matter, Appendix G), though the annotation pipeline depends on proprietary frontier models.

primary_link.title: ScholarCatalyst: A Benchmark for Retrieving Papers That Inspire New Research

papers.summary: What makes great scientists great? Even as AI systems start to make progress on open problems, scientists remain far ahead of them at sensing which prior idea, buried in an ever-growing archive of research, a new problem needs. To study this skill, we draw on researchers who know firsthand which earlier work advanced their completed projects, with papers serving as pointers to the ideas within. Using our automated pipeline that makes author annotation scalable, we build ScholarCatalyst by having
papers.summary_zh: 這篇論文處理一個檢索問題：給定專案初期尚未解題的研究問題，系統能否找出真正啟發該專案的既有論文。作者稱之為「催化論文」，其與問題的語意相似度可能很低，卻能提供關鍵洞見。為了取得可靠的標註，團隊設計自動化流程，只需一篇論文的 arXiv ID 即可產生可供作者審閱的草稿資料。最終由 184 位研究者針對 207 篇 2025 至 2026 年的電腦科學論文，驗證 894 個研究問題，並標註哪些既有論文確實或可能推進其研究，同時提供理由，其中包含當時未曾讀過的論文。檢索範圍限定在專案完成前已發表的 19 萬篇論文，避免時間洩漏。實驗涵蓋 BM25、多向量、稠密嵌入與 LLM 搜尋代理。結果顯示最佳系統在 top 20 僅回收約 48% 的作者認定論文；代理式搜尋（42%）並未優於嵌入檢索（48%），即使其呼叫同一檢索器。作者分析指出，主題相似度是弱訊號，正例與困難負例的相似度相當；引用紀錄亦不完整，43.6% 的子領域正例未被來源論文引用。限制在於標註屬回顧性判斷、領域僅限電腦科學，且任務的效能上限仍未知。此基準的價值在於把「研究品味」中難以言傳的一環化為可量測任務。

llm_evaluation.rationale: Strongly relevant to LLM evaluation, reasoning benchmarks, and explainability: a pipeline that estimates question difficulty via 1PL IRT over thousands of LLM responses, generates natural-language hypotheses from contrastive hard/easy samples, and validates them on held-out items. Methodology is sound (disjoint generation/validation/test splits, LASSO stability selection, four adapted hypothesis-generation baselines, difficulty-prediction baselines, sampling-strategy ablations), and evidence is quantitative with bootstrap CIs, effect sizes, and per-model counterfactual results. The causal claim is partly qualified (accuracy proxy over models <30B, no baseline causal comparison, per-hypothesis applicability differs), and generalizability is limited to three English reasoning benchmarks; reproduction depends on preview API models though prompts, seeds, and hyperparameters are provided.

primary_link.title: What Makes Something Hard(er)? Explaining Question Difficulty in Natural Language

papers.summary: Difficulty is one of the most fundamental properties of a question: it determines whether the question can meaningfully discriminate between models of differing ability. Although a variety of methods can now estimate or predict difficulty automatically, they yield only a single descriptive number, with no account of the underlying factors that make a question difficult in the first place. In this work, we propose a data-driven approach that automatically generates and validates natural-language
papers.summary_zh: 這篇論文處理一個長期被忽略的問題：我們能估計題目難度，卻說不出難在哪裡。現行做法分成兩類。一類以 Item Response Theory（IRT）為代表，用大量受試者的作答把難度估成一個數值，但只得到描述性分數；另一類用專家手工設計的特徵或神經網路直接預測難度，前者難以跨領域規模化，後者的表徵本身不可解讀。作者主張把難度由「被測量的量」轉為「被解釋的量」，並沿用 LLM 生成自然語言假設的研究路線，但目標改為潛在、連續、且由多重因素交互造成的難度。方法分三步：先以五千餘個 LLM 的作答擬合 1PL（Rasch）模型，取得每題的不變難度估計；接著在生成集上以分群與配對兩種對比抽樣，反覆取出高難度與低難度題目並提示 LLM 提出候選假設，抽樣權重刻意偏好難度差距大、且尚未被使用過的桶與題目；最後以嵌入相似度去重與精煉，用 Judge LLM 標註每題是否滿足各假設，再以 L1 正則化迴歸在驗證集上做穩定度選擇。實驗涵蓋 GSM8K、BBH-structured 與 Winogrande。結果顯示，前五名假設多數描述真正落在解題者身上的認知負荷（多步記帳、需自行推導比率、需排序五個以上實體等），GSM8K 上還抓到參考答案本身有錯的資料品質問題；13/15 個假設的難度差距信賴區間下界高於零。以假設為特徵的 OLS 在 GSM8K 與 Winogrande 取得最佳 R²，在 BBH 為次佳，並優於多種黑箱預測器；把假設向量加入 fine-tuned RoBERTa、Gemma-3-4B、Qwen3-Embedding-4B 等模型，GSM8K 上增益最高達 +0.19。此外，依假設改寫題目可讓實測難度朝預期方向移動，顯示假設具因果效應而非事後描述。限制在於 Winogrande 難度本就不易預測，基線大多失效；因果驗證因算力限制僅用約三十個小模型的準確率作為難度代理，且各假設對應的題目與改寫型態不同，難以互相公平比較。整體而言，此工作把純描述性的難度分數轉化為可操作的陳述，對基準測試的設計與迭代具有實務價值。

Appendix C.3/Table 12: threshold calibration over 1000 non-matching pairs per run finds SIFT FPR 5.2-12.7%, pHash ~0
Section 9: single run per configuration, k=1 fixed, self-constructed undefended MRAG systems, disjointness of shadow/private corpora unverified
llm_evaluation.rationale: Attacks image-returning multimodal RAG via in-image instruction injection and adaptive embedding-space exploration; squarely relevant to RAG/knowledge, AI safety, red teaming and multimodal LLMs (though not core LLM methodology or Japanese NLP). Threat model is genuinely new (textual channel denied, instruction embedded in pixels) and the relevance-weighted blending loop beats a non-adaptive baseline by 1.8-5.6x on URC. Rigor is strong for an attack paper: formal objectives, three corpora, three retrievers, two generators, ablations on retriever/shadow size/query placement/blending, and unusually honest post-hoc calibration of leakage thresholds (Appendix C.3-C.4) that quantifies SIFT false positives and target-misattribution. Limitations are candid: one run per configuration (no variance), k=1 only, baseline reconstruction entries left empty, self-built undefended systems, oracle URC, and public surrogate corpora. Reproducibility aided by released anonymous code and full parameter tables, but hurt by a preview commercial generator and single seeds. Generalizability limited to image-returning MRAG with CLIP-family retrievers.

primary_link.title: Walking the Embedding Space: Datastore Extraction from Multimodal RAG

papers.summary:
Multimodal Retrieval-Augmented Generation (MRAG) has emerged as a reliable and cost-effective technique of grounding the generative capabilities of Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) into relevant, up-to-date, external knowledge. Despite presenting several benefits, such as reducing hallucinatory behavior, they also introduce new attack surfaces, including leakage of private information and vulnerabilities against data extraction attacks.
  In this paper, we introduce $\immrag$, an adaptiv
papers.summary_zh: 這篇論文研究「以影像回傳」的多模態檢索增強生成（MRAG）系統之隱私風險，並提出名為 imMRAG 的自動化、自適應黑箱資料萃取攻擊。作者指出，過去的萃取攻擊多半把惡意指令寫在文字提示中，因此假設攻擊者握有文字通道；但在實際部署中，文字輸入常受到 prompt injection 分類器與指令偵測過濾器檢查，影像通道卻被當成純資料，少有同等檢視。imMRAG 因此把攻擊指令以低透明度排版浮水印嵌入使用者提供的影像中，並搭配無害的文字請求送出。其查詢建構策略是將攻擊者自備的影子影像與系統先前回傳的影像做像素層級線性混合，使混合後的嵌入落在兩者之間，藉此沿著私有資料庫的嵌入空間逐步推進；再以相關性加權重取樣，把後續查詢導向仍能產生新檢索結果的區域，並以重複偵測維護多樣性。實驗涵蓋三個情境（醫療影像 ROCOv2、文件掃描 DocVQA、通用網路影像 CC）、兩種生成器（Lumina-MultiImage 與 Gemini 2.5 Flash Image Preview）與三種 CLIP 系列檢索器。在 2500 次查詢的單次執行中，可重建最多 611 張放射影像、566 份文件掃描與 416 張通用影像，在相同預算下可達非自適應基線的 1.8 至 5.6 倍相異項目。作者也強調，條件式重建率高但絕對覆蓋率低，且 SIFT 指標在非匹配對上有 5.2% 至 12.7% 的偽陽性，pHash 在文件資料集上不具鑑別力，各項指標需互補解讀。結論是：把指令移入影像幾乎不損失攻擊效力，顯示當前防禦在通道覆蓋上存在缺口，而最穩健的緩解方向應放在輸出端與檢索結果的比對閘門，而非僅篩檢輸入。

Section 4.2/Table 2: Llama-3.1-70B counterexample - QK error falls 5.27 to 3.27 but WikiText-2 PPL rises 4.98 to 18.89
Section 4.3: shared-budget QK-Wanda lowers QK error in 133/135 checkpoint-sparsity configs but accuracy in only 30/45

Introduction: code and reproduction scripts at https://github.com/vectozavr/qk-wanda, with pinned revisions and hash manifests in Appendix E.5
llm_evaluation.rationale: LLM pruning method (QK-Wanda) coupling query/key deletion costs with GQA-aware closed-form scores and shared budgets; directly relevant to LLM efficiency and transformer attention internals. Novelty is moderate: the authors concede the base score is a diagonal specialization of AESPA's QK reconstruction quadratic (Appendix L.1), with the contribution being compensation-free elementwise pruning, GQA statistics, and shared budget allocation. Rigor is strong: exact proofs (Propositions B.1, C.2), eight scoring-variant ablations, matched-budget controls, calibration sensitivity sweeps, timing benchmarks, and unusually candid limitations (Llama 3 PPL regressions despite lower QK error). Evidence spans 15 checkpoints (0.5B-72B) with PPL and seven-task zero-shot metrics, but main comparisons use one calibration seed (explicitly noted as descriptive counts, not significant wins), and QK-only pruning touches just 4-16% of parameters with full-block evidence limited to three smaller models. Generalizability is therefore partial: gains are family-dependent and local reconstruction error does not predict downstream quality. Reproducibility is high: public code, pinned HF revisions, source-manifest hashes, masks regenerable.

primary_link.title: QK-Wanda: Coupling Queries and Keys for Unstructured Pruning

papers.summary: Wanda (Sun et al., 2024) prunes large language models by scoring weights independently within each linear projection, although queries and keys interact through dot products. We introduce QK-Wanda, which scores query and key weights by their individual deletion costs under an unmasked pre-RoPE reconstruction objective. It augments Wanda scores with information from the opposite projection (keys for query weights, and queries for key weights), allowing both projections to share a pruning budget.
papers.summary_zh: 大型語言模型的剪枝方法 Wanda 以「刪除單一權重對該投影的重建誤差」為評分依據，但忽略查詢（Q）與鍵（K）其實是透過內積交互作用。本文提出 QK-Wanda，將 Q 與 K 的權重放在同一個未遮罩、RoPE 之前的 QK 乘積重建目標下評分：查詢權重的分數乘上對應鍵頭的活化能量，鍵權重的分數則加總共享該鍵頭之所有查詢頭的查詢能量，並延伸至 grouped-query attention（GQA）。分數具備封閉解，不需梯度、也不更新保留下來的權重，且 Q 與 K 可共享同一個剪枝預算，無須人工指定各自的稀疏度。實驗涵蓋 TinyLlama、Llama 2、Llama 3 與 Qwen2.5 共 15 個模型（0.5B 至 72B）：相較 Wanda，在 50% 稀疏度下 QK 重建誤差平均降低約 60%，80% 下降低約 45%；在 Llama-2-70B 的 80% 稀疏度下，WikiText-2 與 C4 的困惑度分別下降 20.3% 與 13.5%，七項零樣本任務平均準確率提升 5.94 個百分點。限制在於：較低的重建誤差並不保證較佳的下游表現，Llama 3 全系列在 80% 稀疏度下困惑度反而高於 Wanda，顯示局部重建指標作為模型品質預測子仍有其極限。整體剪枝耗時僅比 Wanda 多約 1.3%（A100）與 3.1%（H200），方法成本低且易於實作，對關注 LLM 壓縮與剪枝準則設計的研究者具參考價值。
papers.title: QK-Wanda: Coupling Queries and Keys for Unstructured Pruning
papers.title_zh: QK-Wanda：耦合查詢與鍵的無結構剪枝

llm_evaluation.rationale: Well-grounded study on conditioning eight LLMs (GPT family, Llama, Qwen, Gemma) on Social Value Orientation profiles to align their behaviour in Centipede Game variants with human experimental data. Highly relevant to LLMs, behavioural alignment, and prompting/persona conditioning, though outside core topics like reasoning, agents, or RAG. Rigour is solid: blinded/unblinded prompts, sensitivity analyses (Appendix B), comprehension test (Appendix C), GLM fits with full statistics (Appendix E), and a random-agent baseline. Evidence is quantitative (MAE reductions of 25-36%, per-node logit slopes with p-values), but generalizability is limited to one game family, one psychological dimension, and one human reference sample, as acknowledged in Conclusions. Reproducibility is strong: GitHub code/data, full prompts, and explicit probability-normalisation formulas in Methods 4.2-4.3.

primary_link.title: Conditioning LLMs on Social Value Orientation improves behavioural alignment in a sequential social dilemma

papers.summary: Large language Models (LLMs) are increasingly used to simulate human decision-making, yet their outputs often under-represent human behavioural heterogeneity. We investigate whether conditioning LLMs on Social Value Orientation (SVO, a measure of how individuals value their own outcomes relative to others') can better reproduce human behaviour in a sequential social dilemma. Using experimental data from two variants of the Centipede Game (CG) as reference, we compare the default behaviour of eig
papers.summary_zh: 大型語言模型（LLM）常被用來模擬人類決策，但其輸出往往低估人類行為的異質性。本文以兩種「蜈蚣賽局」（Centipede Game, CG）變體的人類實驗資料為基準，比較八個 LLM（GPT 系列、Qwen3.5、Llama-3.3、Gemma-4）在未經條件化的預設行為，以及依人類樣本中的「社會價值取向」（Social Value Orientation, SVO）剖面相應提示後所產生的行為。方法是逐節點取得模型對 Take／Pass 的前五名 token 對數機率，並以策略法還原完整的終端節點分布。結果顯示：預設策略因模型而異，且普遍比人類更具確定性，與人類參考分布的距離較遠；但經 SVO 條件化後，行為會被系統性引導，對人類參考的對齊改善最多可達 70%，公平結局版本的改善尤為明顯（平均相對誤差降低約 36%）。GLM 分析指出，誘導的 SVO 值越高（越利社會），各節點停止賽局的機率越低，重現了人類資料中利社會性與合作行為的關聯。不過，直接向模型誘發的 SVO 對提示框架與選項順序敏感，顯示其並非穩定的人類式社會偏好。作者主張，SVO 對行為模擬的價值不在於 LLM 具有穩定偏好，而在於其能把偏好剖面映射到相應的策略選擇。限制包括僅涵蓋 SVO 與兩種 CG 變體、改善並非普遍，且部分條件下仍不如隨機基準。

llm_evaluation.rationale: Diffusion language-model methodology paper: HC-DLM couples a persistent continuous latent with per-step token readout/feedback, with a derived variational bound (Proposition 1, Appendix A) and a principled training objective. Strong fit to language-model generative modeling and transformer/DiT training interests; touches structured reasoning (Sudoku, Countdown) but no CoT/LLM-alignment/Japanese content. Rigor is solid: matched 6M-parameter comparisons, component ablation (Table 4), noise-kernel ablation (Table 5), latent-length ablation (Table 9), NFE/CFG sweeps, wall-clock measurements. Main caveats: scale is small for structured tasks and moderate (118M) for LM1B with only generative perplexity as metric; several baselines are numbers taken from other papers or reproduced by the authors on their own backbone (CCDD), no error bars despite claimed repeated runs, and no pretrained-LLM-scale validation (acknowledged in Appendix D).

primary_link.title: Hierarchical Continuous Diffusion Language Models

papers.summary: Discrete diffusion language models offer a compelling alternative to autoregressive generation for tasks demanding bidirectional reasoning and global constraint satisfaction. Yet they share a structural bottleneck: when decoding in parallel, each token is sampled independently from its marginal, severing the statistical dependencies among the tokens decoded together. Continuous diffusion language models avoid this by denoising a shared continuous state, but their denoiser sees only that state, s
papers.summary_zh: 這篇論文處理離散擴散語言模型在平行解碼時的核心瓶頸：同一步驟中被還原的多個 token 是各自從邊際分布獨立取樣，切斷了彼此之間的統計依賴，因此在需要全域限制滿足或雙向推理的任務上容易出錯。連續擴散模型雖然以共享的連續狀態解噪，但其去噪器只看得到連續狀態，直到最後解碼前都與合法的 token 組態毫無連結。作者因此提出 HC-DLM，把離散 token 生成與連續潛在軌跡整合進單一階層式去噪過程：連續潛在軌跡是唯一持續存在的生成狀態，每個反向步驟都透過讀出分布從潛在狀態取出 token，再經由離散前向核重新加噪，回饋成為下一步潛在轉移的條件鷹架；token 狀態本身不帶自己的轉移核，因此每步都能重新修正。作者由變分下界推導訓練目標，將其拆解為重建、先驗匹配、邊界與去噪等項，並以 flow matching 實作連續去噪，推論時交替進行潛在去噪與 token 讀出、再加噪。在 Sudoku、Countdown 與 LM1B 上，HC-DLM 在相同模型規模下優於離散與連續擴散基線：Sudoku 困難分割達 72.41%（CCDD 為 70.73%），Countdown CD5 達 37.52%（CCDD 為 25.35%），LM1B 生成困惑度 75.5，優於 MDM、SEDD、Duo、Plaid 與 LangFlow。消融顯示移除連續潛在或離散條件都會大幅退化，且均勻狀態核明顯優於吸收核。限制在於同時訓練編碼器、去噪器與 token 預測器使訓練成本提高，實驗規模仍屬中等，尚未驗證於大型預訓練骨幹。

llm_evaluation.rationale: Directly targets LLM debiasing/fairness (AI safety + alignment preferences) with a concept-guided mutual-information objective over LoRA adapters and retrieval-based selective activation. The MI approximation via token-level KL plus fair-reference alignment is a reasonable but incremental idea; MMR concept selection and routing are standard components. Rigor is solid but not exemplary: five baselines, three backbones (Phi-4-mini, Qwen3-4B, Llama-3.1-8B), six benchmarks, loss ablations, routing and threshold analyses, and full hyperparameters — yet no seeds/variance, no statistical tests, no MMR or concept-source ablations, and routing results reported only for Phi-4-mini. primary_link.title: Acmite: Mitigating Gender Bias in LLMs through Concept-Guided Mutual Information

papers.summary: Large language models (LLMs) can reproduce social stereotypes from their training data, motivating extensive research on model debiasing. However, existing methods often rely on explicit biased examples or predefined group-term substitutions, making them sensitive to wording and less effective at capturing stereotype concepts shared across diverse contexts. More importantly, they typically suppress biased outputs without explicitly modeling the statistical dependence between model outputs and th
papers.summary_zh: 本文針對大型語言模型（LLM）常從訓練語料中複製社會刻板印象的問題，提出名為 Acmite 的概念引導式除偏框架。現有方法多依賴明確的偏見範例或事先定義的群體詞替換，對措辭敏感，且往往只壓制偏見輸出，而未顯式建模模型輸出與刻板印象概念之間的統計相依性。Acmite 將刻板印象表示為結構化語意概念，並以最大邊際相關（MMR）挑選多樣化概念，再以 token 層級的 KL 散度近似條件互資訊，同時以公平參考句引導最佳化方向，確保修正朝向公平詮釋而非反向刻板印象。方法僅訓練輕量 LoRA 適配器並凍結基礎模型，推論時僅在輸入與檢索到的刻板印象概念足夠相似時才啟動除偏路徑，否則直接使用原模型。實驗涵蓋 Phi-4-mini、Qwen3-4B 與 Llama-3.1-8B 三種模型，在 BBQ、CrowS-Pairs、StereoSet 上評估偏見，並以 ARC-Challenge、GSM8K、PIQA 檢驗一般能力保存。結果顯示 Acmite 在多種互補評測格式上皆有效降低性別偏見，同時維持具競爭力的一般任務表現，並在開放式生成案例中避免加入未受支持的性別歸因。消融實驗指出互資訊項為核心貢獻，檢索引導路由則顯著減少對偏見無關輸入的干擾。限制在於目前僅聚焦性別偏見，且沿用二元性別類別，尚未涵蓋種族、宗教、年齡與非二元性別等更廣泛面向，未來需擴充概念庫與評測協定。此研究的重要性在於把干預訊號由個別實例提升到共享概念層級，為偏好對齊式除偏提供互補途徑，並提醒問答低偏見不等於刻板聯想已消除。
