llm_evaluation.rationale: Multimodal LLM-as-judge audit for instruction-based image editing: relevant to evaluation/red-teaming of MLLM judges but centered on image-editing evaluation rather than core LLM/NLP methodology. Methodological novelty is real — a counterfactual benchmark (1,196 triplets, 13 cues across 4 injection sites) whose key contribution is verified quality preservation (SSIM, calibrated MLLM validators with positive controls, blinded human checks) so judgment shifts can be attributed to bias. Rigor is strong: judge-specific sham and re-query noise floors, bootstrap CIs, Wilcoxon/McNemar tests, Benjamini-Hochberg correction, a pre-declared replication judge analyzed separately, and control analyses (instruction-collision removal, high-MOS tertile, cross-benchmark, selection-corrected permutation tests). Evidence is quantitative and internally consistent (e.g., order-swap reversal up to 60.9% vs 10.5% re-query; bandwagon raising ratings for all judges). Limitations (fixed cue doses, judge-version drift, no mitigation study, preservation checks cover only the requested edit) are stated in Appendix A. Reproducibility is partial: the repo excludes benchmark images, annotations, and judge/validator responses, so exact reconstruction is not possible (Reproducibility Statement). Generalizability is limited to five primary judges in image-editing evaluation.

However, systematically auditing whether these judges are influenced by cues irrelevant to editing quality is challenging because visual interventions may themselves alter the quality being evaluated. A judgment shift can therefore be attributed to bias only when the intervention is verified to preserve the underlying editing quality. To
papers.summary_zh: 這篇論文關注指令式影像編輯評估中的一個關鍵問題：多模態大型語言模型（MLLM）被大量用作自動評審與訓練獎勵訊號，但它們的判斷是否會被與編輯品質無關的線索牽動？作者指出，過去難以系統性審計此類偏誤，因為視覺干預本身可能改變被評估的品質；唯有先驗證干預確實保存了底層編輯品質，觀察到的判斷位移才能歸因於偏誤。为此，作者提出 EditJudgeBias 反事實基準，涵蓋 1,196 個真實編輯樣本，並在四個評估站點（顯示協定、評審提示、影像像素、編輯內容）注入 13 種線索，再以校準過的多模態驗證器、正控制與人工檢視確認品質保存。實驗審計五個 MLLM 評審，從三個互補面向衡量：對品質保存線索的不變性、與人類判斷的一致性、成對偏好的穩定性，並以各評審自身的零劑量 sham 與重複查詢雜訊底線作為比較基準，而非以零為基準。結果顯示，品質保存線索使所有評審的位移都超過自身雜訊；捏造的多數意見會推高評分，與編輯無關的小貼紙造成的位移比整張影像操弄更大，調換候選順序最多使 60.9% 的成對判斷反轉。編輯區域相關線索也傾向降低與人類的一致性。三項量測對評審的排序各不相同，說明穩健性無法用單一指標捕捉。限制在於線索集合與強度有限、結果受評審版本與 API 影響，且緩解策略僅初步探討。此研究提醒：可靠的評審不只要與人一致，更要在被評估品質不變時維持不變。

llm_evaluation.rationale: Highly relevant to LLM agents, agent evaluation/red-teaming (process vs outcome checks), LLM-as-judge, and enterprise agent workflows. The core contribution — continuous process-level regression evaluation with runtime-resolved template test cases and independently computed live-API ground truth — is a reasonable but incremental extension of AgentEval-style DAG step evaluation and GroundEval-style state contracts. Rigor is decent for an application study: a 2×2×2×3×10 = 240-trial factorial design, Wilson CIs, bootstrap difference-in-differences with stated caveats, sensitivity analyses (removing the allowlist check, excluding error runs), and an unusually candid limitations appendix (confounded MD/TXT variants, non-causal harness cost claims, judge self-preference since Sonnet 4.6 judges its own traces, live-API snapshot drift, per-cell n=10). primary_link.title: Continuous Process-Level Evaluation for Evolving Enterprise AI Agent Skills

papers.summary: Enterprise AI agent skills evolve as tool APIs, models, and specifications change, yet final-output evaluation can miss process-level behavioral drift. We present a continuous evaluation framework combining outcome-level and process-level checks, applied to Revenue and Productivity variants of a Business Value Determination skill in an enterprise Value Aware Resiliency system. The framework independently computes per-run ground truth, materializes reusable template tests, and evaluates tool sele
papers.summary_zh: 企業 AI 代理技能並非靜態成品，每當工具 API 改版、LLM 版本更新或技能規格修訂時都會被反覆修改，但現行驗證往往只看最終輸出數值是否正確，因而系統性漏掉演進過程中產生的流程層級行為漂移。本文提出一套持續性評估框架，在企業 Value Aware Resiliency（VAR）系統中針對 Business Value Determination（BVD）的兩個技能變體（Revenue 與 Productivity 分攤），同時結合結果層級與流程層級檢查：獨立呼叫真實 API 計算 ground truth、把樣板測試案例實例化為可重複使用的回歸測試，並以程式化檢查評估工具選擇、參數正確性、執行順序與資料庫完整性，僅在精確比對過於脆弱時才由範圍受限的 LLM judge 輔助。作者在 240 次自動試驗中涵蓋兩種規格變體（SKILL.md 與 Skill.txt）、兩套 agent harness（Claude Code 與 Codex）與三個模型。主要發現是：175 次通過所有適用最終數值檢查的試驗中，仍有 162 次（92.6%，Wilson 95% CI 87.7–95.6%）至少存在一項額外的評估器偵測偏差；若改用較寬鬆的七項最終狀態檢查定義，仍有 151/164（92.1%）違反軌跡檢查。依賴關係歸因可把平均 6.34 個失敗檢查壓縮為 2.65 個根因，且規格變體敏感度會隨模型與 harness 而改變，六組差異中的四組 bootstrap 交互區間不含零。限制在於：僅涵蓋單一企業系統與兩個相關技能、每格僅 10 次試驗、MD 與 TXT 差異混合了格式與內容、執行雜訊（83/240 至少一次工具或 harness 錯誤）與 judge 本身即受評模型等。其意義在於指出最終輸出正確並不足以證明流程合規，流程層級回歸測試才是企業代理技能持續演進時可用的品質關卡。

Novel twist on OPSD asymmetry (where-to-look text vs. enhanced visual views) is a meaningful but incremental design choice amid concurrent OPSD variants. Rigor is solid: 15 benchmarks, 3 backbones, comparisons to 4 OPSD baselines with public/author checkpoints, and ablations over training signal (SFT/GRPO/OPSD), hint type, data size, scene resolution/density, and EMA rate. primary_link.title: Where-OPD: Spatially Guided On-Policy Self-Distillation of MLLMs with Synthetic Scenes

papers.summary: On-policy self-distillation has recently emerged as an effective approach for improving language-model reasoning by supervising students with a frozen or EMA version of themselves that receives privileged information. Its application to multimodal large language models (MLLMs), however, remains largely unexplored. Recent approaches use privileged visual information, such as image crops corresponding to a question, to improve fine-grained perception, but their gains are confined to tasks that ben
papers.summary_zh: 這篇論文探討如何把「同策略自蒸餾」（on-policy self-distillation, OPSD）有效套用到多模態大型語言模型（MLLM）的視覺感知上。既有做法多半讓教師模型看到裁切、放大或高解析度的局部影像，使師生差異來自「看到什麼」，但這類特權資訊的效益侷限在需要視覺放大的任務，且依賴人工標註的 grounding 資料或外部教師模型。作者提出 Where-OPD，改為維持影像不變，只給教師一段文字形式的「空間引導提示」，指名與問題相關的視覺元素及其在圖中的座標；學生只收到影像與問題，推論時完全不使用提示。提示來自程序化生成的合成場景：幾何圖形的位置、顏色、形狀與數量在生成時即已知，因此可自動產生精確且免標註的訓練資料。方法在 Qwen3.5-4B、Qwen3.5-9B 與 Qwen3-VL-4B 上，於 CountQA、ChartQA、EvoChart、OCRBench 等計數、文件與圖表理解基準皆獲改善，例如 ChartQA 與 EvoChart 分別提升 7.20 與 10.11 分。更關鍵的是，僅用合成場景後訓練，卻能在 CVBench、V*、ZoomBench、BLINK、HR-Bench、MME-RealWorld 等真實影像基準上平均提升 3.23 分，展現合成到真實的遷移。消融顯示：若移除提示、只給答案，或改給裁切影像，平均表現皆下降，說明「指出證據位置」本身才是有效的蒸餾訊號；教師凍結亦優於 EMA 更新。限制在於訓練任務僅為合成計數，且多數設定僅跑單一隨機種子，其泛化機制與更大規模模型上的表現仍待驗證。整體而言，此工作指出特權資訊不必是更好的視覺輸入，空間定位式的文字引導即可誘發更廣泛且可遷移的感知能力。
papers.title: Where-OPD: Spatially Guided On-Policy Self-Distillation of MLLMs with Synthetic Scenes

Table 2/Section 4.3: outperforms PARA (3.31 Target, 2.78 Off vs epsilon=.90) and evaluated Spectral Surgery config (3.32/4.51) without calibration data

llm_evaluation.rationale: A data-free post-training spectral rebalancing method (LoRA-Norm) for LoRA adapters in LLMs, squarely within LLM fine-tuning/PEFT and efficiency interests but not Japanese NLP, agents, or reasoning-methodology topics. The method is a modest extension of prior fixed-direction spectral editing (including the authors' own Spectral Surgery), reusing Muon-style quintic iterations plus nuclear-norm restoration. Rigor is strong: 18 checkpoints over two 8B backbones and three tasks, paired bootstrap intervals, matched-strength controls, energy-matched and flattening ablations, sensitivity sweeps, transition analyses, and explicit caveats that energy-matched controls (Scalar-E/Flat-E) recover most of the benefit and that exact flattening nearly matches HNS, honestly limiting claims of a spectral-shape advantage. Evidence is quantitative and self-critical (e.g., Table 2, Fig. 4, Tables 16-25), though the headline gain is partly a strength-reduction effect and the practical advantage over simpler scaling is not established (Appendix H). Generalizability is limited to two English 8B models, rank 16, and three tasks; reproducibility is aided by extensive config/provenance appendices but no explicit public code release is stated in the text.

primary_link.title: Learn the Directions, Normalize the Gains: Post-Training Normalization for LoRA

papers.summary: While Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) enables efficient task specialization, its learned updates can compromise capabilities beyond the target task. We identify \textbf{adaptation imbalance}: a few singular directions dominate the trained update, leaving its performance sensitive to how gains are allocated. We argue that \textbf{learning where to adapt does not ensure that adaptation gains are well balanced}. This motivates \textbf{LoRA-Norm}, a post-training normalization method that retains learned
papers.summary_zh: 這篇論文指出，LoRA 雖然能以低秩更新讓預訓練模型快速特化到特定任務，但訓練完成的適配器常出現「適配失衡」：少數奇異方向主導整個更新，使其表現對增益如何分配變得敏感。作者主張「學到在哪裡適配」不等於「適配增益已被妥善平衡」。為此提出 LoRA-Norm，一種訓練後的譜正規化方法：保留原本學到的方向，只重新平衡其增益。方法結合譜重平衡（對奇異值施加固定的非線性轉換，採用混合 Newton–Schulz 迭代）與核範數回復（維持每個模組原本的譜總量），不需校準資料、不需額外訓練，也不增加推論負擔。實驗涵蓋兩個骨幹模型（Qwen3-8B 與 Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct）與三種適配任務（程式、數學推理、指令遵循），共 18 個適配器。平均而言，LoRA-Norm 將目標任務表現由 68.00 提升至 72.08 分，非目標類別平均由 69.55 提升至 72.79 分，並把遺忘落差由 2.71 降至 0.34 個百分點，優於所比較的譜剪枝與梯度引導編輯設定。分析顯示，保存核範數並不保存更新強度；與 LoRA-Norm 功能能量相符的純量控制即可重現多數效益，而更強的功能等化並未帶來一致增益，說明「平衡增益」與「等化回應」是不同目標。限制在於：部分比較區塊各有其參考基準，且涵蓋的模型與任務仍有限，尚待更廣泛驗證。

llm_evaluation.rationale: Strong topical fit: LLM mathematical reasoning via GRPO reinforcement learning, code/program synthesis with executable verifiers, tool-integrated reasoning, and span-level credit assignment. The FSG-RL framework (function graphs + multi-verifier rewards + answer gating) is a plausible but incremental combination of existing components (GRPO from DeepSeekMath, PAL/ToRA-style tool use, SCRL-style span credit, Graph of Thoughts decomposition). Rigor is weakened by missing reward-component ablations (no isolated test of gating, span-level credit, or individual verifier terms), a small benchmark (866 train / 400 eval problems), a single model family with unusual naming (Qwen3.5-9B, Qwen3.8-27B, gpt-5.6-terra), no variance across seeds, and a teacher continuation on only 60 problems. Evidence includes two quantitative tables, an exact McNemar test (Sec. 3.2), and an illustrative case study (Sec. 3.4) distinguishing execution consistency from correctness. Reproducibility is mixed: code URL is claimed (Abstract) and hyperparameters are detailed (Sec. 3.2), but private verification specs are withheld (Conclusion), and the API baseline uses a single unverifiable external endpoint. Generalizability is limited to math word/competition problems with one base model; no cross-domain or cross-model transfer is shown.

papers.summary: Algorithmic mathematical reasoning requires reliable decomposition, computation, and aggregation. Final-answer rewards provide limited guidance on intermediate errors, while successful execution does not guarantee mathematical correctness. This work proposes Function-Structured Graph Reinforcement Learning (FSG-RL), connecting subproblem graphs and Python implementations with multi-verifier feedback. The policy first learns to generate code from function graphs through supervised fine-tuning (SF
papers.summary_zh: 這篇論文針對數學解題中「答案對但推論錯」與「程式能跑但不代表正確」的落差，提出函式結構圖強化學習（FSG-RL）。做法是把問題拆成有型別相依關係的子問題圖，每個可執行節點對應一段公開的 Python 介面，另搭配不對外公開的驗證規格。策略先以監督式微調（SFT）學會依節點順序產生函式圖與程式碼，再以 GRPO 搭配多重驗證器獎勵進行強化學習，訊號涵蓋執行成功、單元測試與性質測試通過率、相依邊一致性，以及最終答案正確性。作者設計答案閘門，當最終答案錯誤時壓低過程獎勵權重，並以 span 層級的信用分配把訊號導向對應的程式片段，另可選用教師監督與結構化記憶模組。基準測試從 GSM8K、MathQA、MATH 與 Omni-MATH 整理出 866 題訓練與 400 題評估，指標區分執行成功、隱藏測試全過、程式與答案一致、最終答案正確與完整解題成功。結果顯示，相較於 SFT，GRPO 將最終答案正確率由 43.25% 提升到 67.50%，完整解題成功由 32.25% 提升到 52.25%，且教師監督的接續訓練僅用 60 題難題便有額外增益。作者也以反例說明執行成功與答案一致不足以保證正確。限制在於驗證規格未公開、部分對照為 API 參考而非同等推論設定，且獎勵權重屬人工設定，需留意其可遷移性。此工作的重要性在於把可驗證的子問題層級信用連到實際程式行為，讓強化學習不僅改善格式遵循，更能提升可被檢驗的解題正確性。

links.title: Mapping the RAG Landscape: A Four Axis Taxonomy of Efficiency, Defense, Interactivity, and Reasoning

evidence: Abstract/§I: survey organizes RAG into four axes (efficiency, defense, interactivity, reasoning) with RQ1-RQ4
§II: PRISMA-inspired protocol, ~780 records from Google Scholar/Semantic Scholar/arXiv (Jan 2020-Jan 2025) plus snowballing, but no released dataset or screening counts
§III-E, Table II: cross-axis comparison of representative methods with design-feature checkmarks

§III-F, Eq. (7) and Algorithm 2: utility-cost retrieval objective; §III-G Eq. (8)/Algorithm 3 risk-aware scoring; §III-H Eq. (9)/Algorithm 4 user-conditioned policy; §III-I Eq. (10)/Algorithm 5 multi-step reasoning

Tables III-VIII (§IV): aggregated quantitative results (e.g., PoisonedRAG ASR 0.97-0.99 in Table IV; Chipper chunking accuracy 72.34-84.40% in Table VII) drawn from cited works without normalized comparison
§III-H text cites 'Active RAG' to reference [137], which in the reference list is a 2016 Cell biology paper on RAG transposons — citation/content mismatch
§III-G: FILCO cited as [63], but reference [63] is a 2026 'RAG for AI-generated content' survey, indicating reference mapping errors
§V/§VI: catalog of open challenges (retrieval bottlenecks, hallucination, domain adaptation, latency, explainability) and future directions (RL for RAG, neuro-symbolic, multimodal, benchmarks)
llm_evaluation.rationale: Highly relevant LLM/RAG survey covering retrieval, efficiency, safety, personalization, and multi-step reasoning, but a review/synthesis contribution rather than new methodology. The four-axis taxonomy with per-axis objectives (Eq. 7-10) and reference algorithms (Algorithms 2-5) is a reasonable organizing contribution, yet the objectives are ad hoc and unvalidated. Rigor is weakened by serious reference-verification failures: e.g., §III-H cites 'Active RAG' [137] to a 2016 Cell paper on RAG transposons (biology), FILCO [63] maps to an unrelated 2026 AIGC survey in the reference list, and §IV-C citation-to-content mismatches ([207]-[209]) appear. Quantitative tables (Tables III-VIII) aggregate heterogeneous metrics without normalization or meta-analysis; the PRISMA-inspired protocol (§II) is described but no search strings, screening counts, or data are released. Broad cross-domain coverage gives good generalizability; reproducibility is only partial.

primary_link.title: Mapping the RAG Landscape: A Four Axis Taxonomy of Efficiency, Defense, Interactivity, and Reasoning

papers.summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated remarkable fluency across many tasks but remain limited by their static, parameter bound knowledge and their susceptibility to hallucinating information. Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) addresses these issues by incorporating external retrieval into the generation process, grounding model outputs in verifiable and up to date sources. While prior surveys primarily focus on core RAG architectures and standard pipelines, recent research explores b
papers.summary_zh: 本文為 Retrieval-Augmented Generation（RAG）的整合性綜述，針對大型語言模型（LLM）因參數知識靜態而產生幻覺與資訊過時的問題，系統性梳理 2020 至 2025 年間的研究進展。作者主張既有綜述多聚焦於核心架構或單一關切（信任、領域、模態、代理行為），因此提出以「系統所欲最佳化的設計張力」為組織原則的四軸分類法：效率與壓縮（RQ1）、防禦與安全（RQ2）、互動與使用者中心（RQ3）、以及多步推理（RQ4）。每軸皆搭配一形式化目標函式（式 7 至式 10）、一個參考演算法（演算法 2 至 5）與跨軸方法比較表，將效率軸表述為效用對成本之比、防禦軸為風險加權懲罰、互動軸為使用者條件化政策、推理軸則為多步檢索接地損失加上連貫與一致性正則化。方法上採用 Snyder 架構與 PRISMA 2020 原則，檢索約 780 筆紀錄並輔以引用滾雪球，納入 RAPTOR、SELF-RAG、Chat-REC、GenGround 等代表系統。文中亦整理開放域問答、程式碼生成、教育與企業應用，以及醫療、法律、科學等領域的評測數據。限制在於檢索瓶頸、殘餘幻覺、領域與使用者適配、延遲與可擴展性，以及缺乏統一的可解釋性與評測框架；作者指出目前的量化結果多來自異質基準，難以直接合併比較。本文價值在於為系統建置者提供可並列比較的設計地圖，並指出 RL 整合、神經符號、多模態檢索與改良基準等未來方向。

links.title: TopK-Guided: Adaptive, Budget-Aware Activation Sparsity for Efficient LLM Inference

evidence: Table 1 (Section 3): TopK-Guided attains lowest PPL and highest accuracy in all 12 model/sparsity comparisons; margins grow at s=0.7 (e.g., Llama-3-8B PPL 21.55 vs TEAL 24.09 and WINA 27.78).

Section 3 Setup: two models (Llama-2-7B, Llama-3-8B), s in {0.3,0.5,0.7}, C4 PPL on 500 samples, average zero-shot accuracy over 8 tasks via lm-evaluation-harness; (s-bar, lambda) selected on WikiText-2, evaluated on C4.
Appendix F Table 6 (Ablation): both components help individually and combined is best at every sparsity; largest joint gain at s=0.7 (10.15 C4 vs WINA 10.72).
Appendix B Table 3: TEAL realised sparsity undershoots target (48.14-47.64% at s=0.5) and drifts by dataset; TopK-Guided stays within ±δ=0.01 (49.39-49.52%).
Appendix E Table 5: full (s-bar, lambda) grid on WikiText-2; at s=0.3 15/16 settings meet or beat WINA, showing limited hyperparameter sensitivity.
Section 4 Conclusion and Limitations: evaluated only decoder-only models up to 8B; FLOP-level savings reported rather than wall-clock speedup, kernel implementation left to future work.
Section 2.1: TopK-Guided masking defined via Eq. 2-3 with quickselect O(d); δ fixed at 0.01 and treated as non-tunable.
Section 2.2 Eq. 4-5: per-block sensitivity from one calibration pass and budget redistribution with clamp to [0.05,0.95]; s-bar and lambda remain free.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Training-free activation sparsity for LLM inference, squarely in the LLM efficiency/inference-serving preferences (plus transformer internals). Method is a sensible but incremental combination of TEAL-style threshold adaptivity (clipped to ±δ) with WINA TopK, plus sensitivity-based block budget redistribution closely resembling prior layerwise allocation ideas (OWL). Evaluation is careful: two baselines, 3 sparsity levels, 2 models, C4 perplexity + 8 zero-shot tasks, per-task breakdown, a component ablation, and hyperparameters selected on a held-out dataset rather than the reported one. Weaknesses: only two decoder-only models up to 8B, no wall-clock/kernel measurements (FLOP-level only), no repeated runs or variance, modest margins at low sparsity, and one unexplained perplexity/accuracy reversal that is acknowledged but not investigated. No code or artifact release is claimed.

primary_link.title: TopK-Guided: Adaptive, Budget-Aware Activation Sparsity for Efficient LLM Inference

papers.summary: Activation sparsity speeds up large language model (LLM) inference by setting unimportant activations to zero so that the corresponding computations can be skipped. Existing training-free methods, however, make different trade-offs: threshold-based methods such as TEAL adapt the sparsity level to each token but do not tightly control the realised sparsity, while TopK-based methods such as WINA enforce a fixed sparsity level but use the same sparsity budget for every token. Both also apply the sa
papers.summary_zh: 大型語言模型（LLM）推論時，每個 token 都需完整前向傳遞，成本主要來自注意力與 MLP 中的大型線性投影。活化稀疏化可在推論時將活化向量中絕對值最小的元素設為零，藉此跳過對應的權重行，達到加速效果，且不需重新訓練。現有免訓練方法各有取捨：TEAL 以校準後的固定閾值做遮蔽，能隨每個 token 自適應，但實際稀疏度會偏離目標、加速幅度難以預測；WINA 則以 TopK 精確保留固定數量元素，稀疏度準確卻失去 token 層級的自適應。此外，兩者對所有 Transformer 區塊套用相同預算，忽略早期區塊遠比後期區塊敏感的事實。本論文提出 TopK-Guided，包含兩項互補的免訓練改良：其一是 TopK-Guided 遮蔽，利用校準閾值 τ 以 O(d) 成本估計每個 token 的自然稀疏度，再將其夾限於目標值正負 δ（固定為 0.01）的窄帶內，並以 quickselect 取代排序來選取前 k 個元素；其二是敏感度感知的區塊預算分配，透過單次校準量測各區塊在探測稀疏度下的相對輸出誤差，再依公式將全域預算由敏感區塊重新分配至穩健區塊。實驗在 Llama-2-7B 與 Llama-3-8B 上，於目標稀疏度 0.3、0.5、0.7 下評估 C4 困惑度與八項零樣本任務平均準確率。結果顯示 TopK-Guided 在全部十二組比較中同時取得最低困惑度與最高準確率，且隨稀疏度提高而領先幅度擴大，在 0.7 時增益最顯著，同時維持與 WINA 幾乎相同的投影計算量。消融實驗證實兩項貢獻各自有效且能互補。限制方面，研究僅涵蓋 8B 以下參數量的解碼器模型，且僅報告 FLOP 層級的節省而非實際執行時間加速，核心層級實作留待未來工作。此方法與旋轉式量化作用於同一計算不變模型，可自然組合，朝向更快的低精度推論。

links.title: Stochastic Rounding in Low-Precision Transformer Inference: A Variable-Precision Emulation Study of a Small GPT-2

evidence: Section 6.2 reports component sweeps: at t=6 in the MLP, perplexity 71.97±1.16 (SR) vs 137.93 (RN), and at the lm_head the ordering reverses (5054±464 vs 519.18)
Table 3(b) mixed-rounding vs all-RN at matched per-site precisions: gaps of -3.04%, -5.81%, -28.17% for k=8,7,6 with 95% Student-t CIs (df=4)

Theorem 3 (Section 5.1) states a vector Bienaymé-Chebyshev bound with confidence multiplier 1/sqrt(alpha) independent of output dimension m; Section 5.1 numerically evaluates coefficients 1537u (RN) vs ~248u (SR) for n=3072
Section 5.3 and Table 4 decompose expected excess loss into D, Q, V, R terms; over t=6,...,9 the variance penalty V accounts for ~100% of SR excess loss at the head
Section 4.3 and Table 1 benchmark PRISM SR overhead at 8.5-32.1x native vs 88-597x for Verificarlo MCA RR on Intel Xeon Gold 6130, 30 runs
Section 6.4 Limitations acknowledges one six-block model, one leading text prefix, no exponent-range modeling of FP8/NVFP4, and untested ties-to-even behavior
Section 7 Reproducibility states pipelines, scripts, and aggregated data at github.com/big-data-lab-team/fuzzy-llm and Zenodo doi:10.5281/zenodo.23066028
llm_evaluation.rationale: Directly studies transformer/LLM inference arithmetic (DistilGPT-2, GPT-2 architecture, perplexity on WikiText-2), so it hits LLM, transformer, and efficiency/inference topics, though the core contribution is numerical-analysis/emulation methodology rather than language modeling per se. Novel contributions are concrete: a variable-precision stochastic rounding algorithm with an exactness proof, a vector Bienaymé-Chebyshev forward-error bound avoiding the union-bound blowup, and an exact cross-entropy loss decomposition into drift/curvature/variance-penalty terms. Rigor is strong: stated hypotheses, full proof in Appendix A, honest caveats that per-reduction bounds do not predict end-to-end ordering, matched-precision SR-vs-RN controls, untied-RN tie handling, and a Limitations section. Evidence is quantitative and reproducible but narrow: one 6-block checkpoint, one leading text prefix of WikiText-2 (1020 positions), 5 seeds per sweep (32 for the decomposition), so generality across models, texts, and tasks is unestablished by the authors' own admission. Code, scripts, and aggregated data are claimed on GitHub and Zenodo with a DOI.

primary_link.title: Stochastic Rounding in Low-Precision Transformer Inference: A Variable-Precision Emulation Study of a Small GPT-2

papers.summary: Should low-precision transformer inference use stochastic rounding (SR) or round-to-nearest (RN)? The answer depends on where in the network you look. We isolate this effect by holding the numerical format fixed and varying only the rounding rule at individual operation sites. To enable experiments at freely chosen precisions, we extend the PRISM vectorized rounding library to arbitrary virtual precision via a variable-precision stochastic rounding (VPSR) algorithm, proving that the rounding dec
papers.summary_zh: 這篇論文探討一個被既有量化研究忽略的問題：在低精度 Transformer 推論中，中間運算該用隨機捨入（SR）還是捨入至最近（RN）？作者固定數值格式、只改變各運算站點的捨入規則，以隔離捨入規則本身的影響。為此他們擴充 PRISM 向量化 CPU 捨入函式庫，提出可變精度隨機捨入（VPSR）演算法，並證明其捨入決策可在硬體浮點中精確判定。理論上，作者推導線性投影的前向誤差機率界線，顯示 SR 誤差包絡隨縮減長度呈 O(√nu) 成長，而 RN 為 O(nu)；並將 softmax 交叉熵損失變化分解為有號漂移、漂移曲率與由 Fisher 資訊矩陣加權的變異數懲罰。在 DistilGPT-2 與 WikiText-2 的實驗中，MLP 下投影在 t=6 位元時 SR 使困惑度升至全精度參考的 1.15 倍，RN 則為 2.21 倍；但在語言模型頭部排序反轉，SR 因非均勻變異數懲罰而較差。混合配置（MLP 用 SR、頭部用 RN）可將困惑度壓在參考的 1.10 倍內，較同位元全 RN 減少約 28%。限制在於 PRISM 僅模擬有效位數與累加器精度，未納入 FP8、NVFP4 等窄格式的指數範圍限制，且僅用單一六層模型與單一文本前綴，站點排序的可攜性仍待驗證。此研究指出捨入規則應視為站點層級的設計變數，對低精度推論與混合精度部署具實務意義。

links.title: Before It Fades: Reinforcing Temporal Representations at Inference Time in VideoLLMs

evidence: Sec. 3.1 and Fig. 2(a): normalized temporal divergence tau_hat_l peaks at mid-to-late layers then decays, consistent across Qwen2.5-VL-7B, Qwen3-VL-8B, InternVL2.5-8B
Sec. 3.2 and Fig. 2(a): the divergence peak is substantially attenuated under spatial and video-irrelevant questions on the same video pairs, indicating question-conditioned temporal specificity
Sec. 3.3 and Fig. 2(b): attention knockout at the last token causes the largest ground-truth probability drop at layers aligned with the tau_hat_l peak
Tables 1-3 (Sec. 5.2): TAI improves over the baseline on TempCompass, TVBench, AoTBench for all three models (e.g., Qwen3-VL-8B TVBench 49.9->52.6) with negligible MVBench change
Table 4 (Sec. 5.3): Anti-TAI (negative beta) drops Attribute Change by 36.3 and Order by 27.4 while Action and Speed stay within 1% of baseline
Table 5 and Fig. 5 (Sec. 5.4): schedule ablation (baseline 73.4, uniform 75.4, reversed 75.1, profile 75.6) and sensitivity sweeps for frames, beta, L_src, extraction window
Appendix B, Tables A-B: profile peak at L20 across 18 extra runs and near-unchanged accuracy when the profile source domain is swapped; TAI gains +1.8 on Molmo2-O-7B and Gemma4-12B
Appendix D, Tables C-D: McNemar tests show significant TAI gains under frame-sampling and prompt-phrasing perturbations (p<1e-6 to 0.004)
Appendix L, Table J: TAI overhead ~1.7x forward passes, 1.52 s/sample vs 1.14 baseline on a single A6000, flash-attention compatible
llm_evaluation.rationale: VideoLLM temporal reasoning via inference-time activation steering: introduces the temporal divergence vector tau_l and shows a peak-then-decay profile across layers, then reinjects the peak signal (TAI) training-free. Relevant to LLMs, reasoning/CoT-adjacent temporal reasoning, interpretability/activation steering, and multimodal/video topics, but not to Japanese LLM/NLP, agents, or alignment themes. Analysis is careful: question-conditioned specificity (Sec. 3.2), attention-knockout causal test (Sec. 3.3), anti-steering sign-flip control (Tab. 4), schedule and hyperparameter ablations (Tab. 5, Fig. 5), McNemar robustness tests (App. D), and cross-family generalization (App. C). Gains are modest (~2-3 points), confined largely to reversal-sensitive categories, and the method needs a reversed-video pass per input; scope is limited to frame-order temporal information (Sec. 7). Code URL and detailed config are given, though several appendix bodies are not in the supplied text.

primary_link.title: Before It Fades: Reinforcing Temporal Representations at Inference Time in VideoLLMs

papers.summary: Video Large Language Models (VideoLLMs) receive frames in sequential order and interpret how visual content evolves along the temporal axis, yet temporal reasoning remains a persistent weakness across architectures. Reversing the frame order of a video, a transformation that should invert temporal answers, often leaves the final prediction unchanged. We investigate where this failure originates by defining the temporal divergence vector $τ_l$, the layer-wise representational difference induced b
papers.summary_zh: 影片大型語言模型（VideoLLM）依序接收影格並解讀視覺內容隨時間的演變，但時序推理始終是各類架構的共同弱點：把影片影格順序反轉、理應翻轉時序答案，模型卻常給出相同預測。作者將此歸因於一個可量測的內部現象。他們定義「時序分歧向量」τ_l，即同一影片正序與反序輸入在最後一個 token 隱藏狀態上的逐層差異，並以正序激活範數正規化得到純量 τ̂_l。跨 Qwen2.5-VL-7B、Qwen3-VL-8B 與 InternVL2.5-8B 三個模型，τ̂_l 曲線高度一致：中後段層急升並達到峰值，隨後逐層遞減至輸出。控制實驗顯示，此峰值只在時序型問題下出現，換成空間或與影片無關的問題即明顯衰減；注意力遮蔽實驗亦顯示，遮蔽峰值層對正確答案機率的破壞最大，證明該處表徵確實被用於預測。方法 Temporal Activation Injection（TAI）不需訓練：在峰值層 L_src 以正、反序輸入之差抽取 τ_steer，再依實測的 τ̂_l 曲線作為逐層權重 w_l，按 w_l = τ̂_l / τ̂_L_src 回注到後續層的最後 token，並以單一全域係數 β 調控強度；反序支路只需跑到 L_src 即提前結束。τ_steer 不經正規化，因此對影格反轉敏感的輸入自然得到較強注入，時間不變的輸入幾乎不受影響。在 TempCompass、TVBench、AoTBench 三個時序基準上，TAI 對三個模型皆穩定提升，且在 MVBench 的一般影片理解上幾乎無損；改進集中在答案隨反轉改變的類別（如 Attribute Change、Direction、Order），而 Action、Speed 等對反轉不變的類別變化極小。將 β 取負號的反向注入會選擇性大幅拉低這些敏感類別，進一步佐證 τ_steer 確實編碼時序訊號。消融顯示依曲線加權優於均勻或反向排程，L_src 取峰值層最佳；τ̂_l 曲線在 5 對影片時即可浮現、20 對近乎收斂，且換用不同基準影片重估仍落在同一層。TAI 可疊加於 ArrowRL 訓練後的權重之上仍有一致增益，顯示與權重層級最佳化互補。限制在於工作只處理影格順序造成的時序資訊，空間推理、物件互動與視聽對應不在範圍內；此外 TAI 需一次額外的前段反序前向傳播，時間成本約為基準的 1.7 倍，但仍低於兩個完整前向傳播。此工作的意義在於把「模型其實算得出時序資訊、卻在輸出前讓它消退」具體定位到中間層，並提供一個無需標註、無需改參數的推論期介入點。

links.title: LineupRL: Verifiable Reinforcement Learning for Time Series Captioning via Caption-to-Series Identification

evidence: Section 2.2: reward defined as r(c,x)=λ·acc(c,x) with a frozen Qwen2.5-14B verifier choosing among K=4 raw-value candidates, queried at all K positions to cancel positional bias
Table 1 (Section 3.2): LineupRL (0.400/0.709/0.638 BEDTime; 0.611/0.886/0.868 CaTS) best in all six columns among four models fine-tuned from Qwen2.5-VL-3B, and ahead of the 72B teacher
Table 2 (Section 3.2): lowest caption-only predictor MSE in all 8 cells, significant in 7 per paired t-tests (Appendix B.5, Table 5)
Section 3.3 / Table 3: nearest-neighbor distractors beat random on entailment (0.506 vs 0.354) and downstream relative MSE despite lower training reward accuracy (0.872 vs 0.982)
Appendix A.2: LLM-as-judge baseline saturates (within-group std 0.004) and 99.9% of its captions end with grader-addressed text (43.8% of characters), documenting reward hacking
Appendix B.5: single training run per captioner; predictor seeded 5x, so captioner training variance is unquantified
Reproducibility statement / Appendix D: code, prompts, training fragment IDs and rewritten references released on GitHub
llm_evaluation.rationale: RLVR for time series captioning where a frozen LLM verifier's caption-to-series identification among statistic-matched distractors supplies a hack-resistant reward. Strong methodological relevance to LLM reward design, RL post-training, and reward-hacking resistance, but the domain (chart-based univariate time series captioning) is niche and the captioner is VLM-only, limiting breadth. Rigor is high: shared hyperparameters across RL baselines, two held-out evaluation verifiers plus five-verifier checks, three complementary criteria (entailment, identification, caption-only forecasting/reconstruction with empty/shuffled controls), paired t-tests, and ablations on verifier size, K, and distractor selection. Main weakness: each captioner is a single training run (only the predictor is seeded), so RL training variance is unmeasured; generalization to longer/multivariate series and non-VLM captioners is left open. Reproducibility is good with released code, prompts verbatim, and training fragment IDs.

primary_link.title: LineupRL: Verifiable Reinforcement Learning for Time Series Captioning via Caption-to-Series Identification

papers.summary_zh:
這篇論文處理時間序列描述生成（time series captioning）的監督瓶頸。傳統作法是對大型模型產生的 caption 做監督式微調（SFT），但品質上限被教師模型綁死，且容易出現「言之成理卻與序列不符」的無根據描述。既有的強化學習獎勵（LLM-as-judge、answerability）原本為影像描述設計，套用到時間序列時分別遭遇獎勵被破解與需要過強時間序列理解能力的問題。

作者提出 LineupRL，核心是把獎勵定義成「caption 對序列辨識」：captioner 讀折線圖寫出描述，而一個凍結的 LLM 驗證器只看 caption 與 K 個以原始數值列出的候選序列，必須指出描述對應哪一條。真序列會輪流放在每個位置，正確率即為獎勵。干擾項並非由目標序列變造，而是從同長度的真實序列中挑選摘要統計量（mean、std、min、max）最接近、且與目標重疊受限的鄰居，迫使 caption 描述更細緻的形狀而非粗略水準。

實驗在 BEDTime 與 CaTS-Bench 上以 entailment、雙向辨識評估，另用 caption-only 預測器測量預測與重建誤差。以 Qwen2.5-VL-3B 為基礎，LineupRL 在六個欄位全數勝過 SFT 蒸餾、answerability 與 LLM-as-judge 兩種 RL；3B 模型在 1/24 參數量下亦勝過 72B 教師。消融顯示驗證器需約 14B、候選數 K=4 較佳，且硬負例優於隨機干擾項；案例研究顯示其描述能依序指出趨勢與關鍵數值，並抵抗獎勵破解。限制在於僅處理單變數與固定長度、驗證器規模有門檻，且各項結果多為單一訓練種子。
papers.title: LineupRL: Verifiable Reinforcement Learning for Time Series Captioning via Caption-to-Series Identification
papers.title_zh: LineupRL：透過「 caption 對時間序列辨識」的可驗證強化學習於時間序列描述生成

links.title: Not All Error Yields to Scale: Where Scaling Stops in Vision-Language Inference

evidence: Abstract/§1: Separable Law L(N,R)=e_inf+A/N^α+B/R^β fit on 26 InternVL and QwenVL models (1B-72B) across four high-resolution benchmarks
§2.4 and Table 8 (Appendix B.3): pooled R²=0.898; multiplicative form has 53.2% higher SSE and +147.8 BIC; coupled form lowers SSE 3.1% but +115.2 BIC
§3.2 and Appendix C.3: 19,890 trajectories; 30.7% Ceiling Bound, gaining only 0.014 vs 0.239 probability between compute quartiles; 85.3% remain below 0.20 accuracy at highest-compute quartile
§4.1-4.2 and Table 7: InternVL β often hits upper bound 10 with token span ~1.22x; QwenVL β median 0.17 with token span 34-88x
§5.2 and Table 30 (Appendix E.3): joint-holdout allocation regret 2.33 pp (projection) and 0.76 pp (direct selection) vs 4.09-7.56 pp for static rules over 2,379 decisions
Appendix B.5/B.6/B.7: held-out RMSE comparisons, bounded-logit law agreeing on 98.3% of decisions, 500-replicate bootstrap intervals (e.g. β bound-hit rate 100% for several InternVL groups)
Appendix D.2 Table 28: controlled visual-token sweeps at fixed 8B show Holm-significant gains up to 42.41 pp (Qwen3-VL-8B, V*Bench)
Reproducibility Statement/Appendix A-B: publicly released unmodified models, detailed evaluation protocol and fitting procedure; no code artifact stated
llm_evaluation.rationale: A multimodal/VLM inference-scaling paper (largely vision-language focused, not Japanese NLP, agents, or LLM methodology proper, so only moderate preference relevance despite touching LLM backbones and scaling-law themes). It proposes a separable two-axis scaling law (backbone size N vs visual token count R) for VLM inference error and derives a closed-form compute allocation. Novelty is decent: the separable form is explicitly compared against multiplicative, coupled, CES, and p-norm alternatives under matched constraints, and the frontend-driven divergence (tiling vs continuous resizing) is a fresh empirical finding. Rigor is strong: 650 evaluation cells / 536,781 records, per-group fits, paired image bootstraps, held-out folds, bounded-law variant, exponent search-box sensitivity, precision weighting, effective-pixel alternative, controlled token sweeps with Holm-corrected tests, and a Lean 4 certificate for the allocation algebra. Weaknesses: many InternVL exponents hit the search upper bound so β is not identified for that family; benchmarks are multiple-choice high-resolution only; the visual encoder is excluded from the cost model; allocation claims are conditional on the evaluated grid and two model families only, limiting generalizability. Reproducibility is good (public models, detailed protocol and appendices) though no code release is stated.

primary_link.title: Not All Error Yields to Scale: Where Scaling Stops in Vision-Language Inference

papers.summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) face a fixed-budget trade-off between processing more visual information for fine-grained perception and using a larger language backbone for complex reasoning. Existing studies do not tell us which combination of backbone size and input resolution to deploy, especially in high-resolution deployments. To address this gap, we propose the Separable Law that describes how VLM performance changes with language backbone size and visual token count. We fit the law to meas
papers.summary_zh: 這篇論文探討視覺語言模型（VLM）在固定推論預算下的資源分配問題：究竟該把算力投給更大的語言主幹，還是投給更多視覺 token。作者提出「可分離定律」L(N,R)=e∞+A/N^α+B/R^β，將語言主幹規模 N 與視覺 token 數 R 的貢獻視為可分別估計的兩項，並在 26 個 InternVL 與 QwenVL 模型、四項高解析度基準（224 像素至 8K）共 650 個 cell、逾 53 萬筆評估上擬合。結果顯示：約三分之一題目在任何規模下都答錯，形成「認知天花板」，且此現象更依賴所需視覺技能而非視覺領域；兩個模型家族在容量指數 α 上接近，但在視覺 token 指數 β 上差異極大，因為 InternVL 的離散切磚使 token 數幾乎不隨影像尺寸變化，而 QwenVL 的連續縮放使 token 數大幅變動，導致 α/β 的優勢軸在兩家族間反轉。結合成本定律後，作者推導出 Visual–Parameter Exchange 的閉式分配規則，並在留出組態上驗證其 regret 低於靜態啟發式規則。限制在於擬合僅涵蓋特定模型與基準網格，β 在多數 InternVL 組別觸及搜尋上界，原生影像實驗亦顯示回報受來源影像品質調節，故架構層級的結論應視為網格條件下的結果。
papers.title: Not All Error Yields to Scale: Where Scaling Stops in Vision-Language Inference
papers.title_zh: 並非所有誤差都能靠規模解決：視覺語言推論中擴展的極限

evidence: Section 5.2 Tables 1-2: Coconut-Chem + Latent-JEPA improves all six optimization property scores and most understanding/reaction metrics but substitution editing drops (65.6 to 61.1) vs Coconut-Chem
Appendix F Table 8: textual-only, molecular-only, and dual prediction compared; dual has best average rank (1.47) while molecular-only wins editing
Appendix C Table 4: answer-prediction transfer to LatentChem improves most metrics under matched 3-epoch adaptation budget
Appendix E Tables 6-7: target-centering ablation; uncentered molecular targets give nearly identical original/shuffled distances (0.003/0.009)
Section 5.3 Figure 2 and Appendix I Figure 10: probe cosine rises from 0.186 to 0.397 on 277/321 held-out examples with shuffled-target control
Appendix B: full hyperparameters (AdamW lr 2e-4, lambda values, curriculum K in {0,2,4,6}), evaluation protocol in Appendix L; no code release stated, evaluation examples promised
llm_evaluation.rationale: Methodology paper on continuous latent reasoning (Coconut-style) augmented with JEPA future-view prediction, using LLM (Qwen3-8B) reasoning with dual textual and molecular targets; strong relevance to LLM latent reasoning/CoT but instantiated entirely in chemistry, so scientific-domain framing limits broader preference match. Novelty is moderate: JEPA future prediction for latent thoughts and dual-space targets are a sensible extension of Coconut, LLM-JEPA, and future-summary prediction. Rigor is high: matched training budget baselines, view ablations, target-centering and encoder-update ablations, transfer to LatentChem and Vanilla Coconut, plus probing/RSA retrieval analyses with documented cohorts. Gains are consistent on molecular optimization and several understanding/reaction metrics but mixed on editing (e.g., substitution drops), with no significance testing on main benchmark tables. Reproducibility aided by detailed hyperparameters and protocols, though no released code/checkpoints and outputs are only promised.

primary_link.title: Latent JEPA: Abstract Future Prediction for Latent Reasoning in Chemistry

papers.summary: Large language models offer a promising foundation for chemical reasoning, bringing together chemical knowledge and multistep problem solving. Chemical intuition can provide an initial sense of plausible outcomes before the details of a solution are fully worked out. Inspired by how such expectations complement explicit analysis, we study how continuous latent thoughts can be trained to anticipate informative aspects of future solutions without verbalizing every intermediate step. We introduce L
papers.summary_zh: 這篇論文探討化學推理模型能否在完整解題過程尚未展開前，先對未來解法形成有用的「預期」。作者借鏡化學直覺與認知科學中「先有感、後說明」的現象，指出連續潛在推理雖能在不逐字表達中間步驟的情況下更新內部想法，卻缺乏對後續結果的預測監督。為此，他們提出 Latent-JEPA：在自迴歸學習之外，加入聯合嵌入預測（JEPA）目標，讓最終的潛在思維 h_T 去預測未來解的「表徵」而非重建其細節。方法上，模型以 Coconut-Chem 作為代表性潛在推理器，設計兩種互補的未來視角：文字視角由解碼器自身對剩餘推理與答案做獨立前向傳遞，取其表徵作為目標；分子視角則以冷凍的 SMI-TED 編碼器編碼參考分子，經置中與 ℓ2 正規化後作為目標。兩者共用同一個潛在思維，但各自以獨立預測器映射到不同表徵空間，並以 stop-gradient 維持目標分支的不對稱性。在 ChemCoTBench 上，Latent-JEPA 在多數指標優於 Coconut-Chem：六項分子最佳化性質全面進步（如 LogP 由 0.7404 升至 0.8318、GSK3-β 由 0.2285 升至 0.2515），分子理解、骨架抽取與反應預測亦見提升，編輯任務則好壞參半。表徵分析顯示，最終潛在思維對個別分子結果的探針餘弦相似度由 0.186 升至 0.397，且在 321 個樣本中有 277 個改善；循環表徵與分子結構幾何（SMI-TED 與 Morgan 指紋）的一致性也明顯增強。作者亦發現原始 SMI-TED 目標存在主導共同方向，置中與正規化能使不同結果的差異對餘弦目標更可見。限制方面，編輯任務結果混雜、部分比較未嚴格配對訓練歷史、分子標註不足以解釋特定化學關聯，且預測分支僅用於訓練監督、不改變推論流程。整體而言，本研究提出把「抽象未來預測」作為連結連續潛在推理與科學結果的學習原則，對科學直覺式推理模型具啟發意義。
papers.title: Latent JEPA: Abstract Future Prediction for Latent Reasoning in Chemistry

Table 4 / Section 4.3: ablations (vector leg, lexical leg, consolidation, fact index, Memg++) run with claude-sonnet-4-6 as answerer, not the headline gpt-4.1-mini/gpt-4o-mini
Appendix B.2: LoCoMo judge uses Mem0 prompt over 1,520 questions while LongMemEval_S runs score 470 non-abstention questions vs published baselines over 500

llm_evaluation.rationale: Highly relevant: LLM agent memory for long-term organizational records, touching RAG/retrieval, long-context, and agent memory themes central to the preferences. The core idea (store documents whole, defer version selection to read time instead of write-time LLM distillation) is a sensible reframing but the machinery (RRF over lexical/tag/vector indexes, temporal pre-filter, recency reserve) is largely standard IR. Rigor is weakened by a very small primary benchmark (73 questions, one synthetic organization), an LLM-judge-only primary metric, ablations run only with claude-sonnet-4-6 rather than the headline answerers, unexplained baseline inconsistencies (RAG-4096 far below RAG-2048 on LoCoMo), mismatched LongMemEval_S question sets (470 vs 500) for baseline comparisons, acknowledged run-to-run variation up to 4.4 points, and duplicated method text (Memg++ described twice with different details). The paper is honest about limitations and shows the graph/consolidation/fact-index add little, which is a genuine finding, but generalization beyond one synthetic org is unproven.

primary_link.title: Mem++: Non-Destructive Memory for Long-Term Organizational LLM Agents

papers.summary: Large Language Model (LLM) agents now take part in organizational work, where many authors record decisions across documents over months. Because a revised decision arrives as a new document rather than an edit, answering a question requires knowing which version held at a given time. However, most memory systems compress the record at write time. By distilling each document into facts, notes or graph edges, these methods fix what can be answered before any question is asked. To address this, we
papers.summary_zh: 這篇論文處理的是「組織記憶」與既有「對話式記憶」的根本差異。在組織情境中，決策由許多人在電子郵件、工單、會議紀錄與共用文件中分別寫下，而修改後的決策是以新文件形式出現、並非直接改寫舊文件；因此同一個事實可能同時存在多個版本，回答問題時必須知道某個時間點哪個版本才是有效的。現有記憶系統多半在寫入時就把資料蒸餾成事實、筆記或圖譜邊，等於在問題出現之前就決定了什麼能被回答。作者提出 Mem++，把決策從寫入時移到讀取時：每份文件連同日期與作者整份保存，寫入階段不呼叫任何生成式模型；檢索時只取用日期不晚於問題所指時間點的文件，並以加權倒數排名融合（RRF）整合全文檢索、標籤與語意向量三條檢索路徑，另保留三個名額給日期最新的文件。在組織基準 OrgMemBench 上，Mem++ 於兩個回答模型下分別領先最強基線 RAG 2.6 分，並比最佳記憶系統高出 8.0 至 13.1 分，在 Supersession 與 Audit Replay 兩類題目表現最好；在 LoCoMo 取得最佳平均 LLM 評分，在 LongMemEval_S 排名第二，僅次於其加入實體圖譜的變體 Mem_g++。消融實驗顯示語意檢索是主要貢獻來源，而寫入時的事實抽取、整合與圖譜不但沒有穩定增益，還增加成本。限制在於公開的組織記憶基準仍少，組織面評估僅依賴 OrgMemBench 針對單一合成組織的 73 題；此外在 Contradiction、Bi-temporal 與 Justification Chain 等題型上仍落後或普遍偏低，偏好類問題也不如蒸餾式方法。

papers.title_zh: Mem++：為長期組織型 LLM 代理設計的非破壞性記憶架構

llm_evaluation.rationale: A streaming video LLM (Qwen3-VL-4B based) that unifies proactive caption memory (PHCM) and selective state-token supervision (PSTL) for timely response. Overlaps preferences via large/multimodal language models, memory/long-context, inference latency, training and data curation, and some temporal reasoning, but it is fundamentally a video-multimodal system rather than LLM/NLP/agent methodology, so relevance is moderate. Novelty is credible (query-independent generative memory writing plus transition-quota state supervision), though generative response control and hierarchical memory build on cited prior work. Rigor is solid: eight benchmarks, matched-supervision-ratio random baseline, focal-loss baseline, hierarchy and data ablations, decontamination by source video (Appendix B.1), yet only one training run/seed, and Appendix D selects the better of two evaluation settings per model-benchmark, which slightly favors baselines/ours asymmetrically. Evidence is quantitative and well localized (Tables 1-4, 16-20) with efficiency and failure-case analysis (Fig. 12). Generalizability is limited to streaming video interaction. Reproducibility is partial: hyperparameters (Table 7) and data statistics (Table 6) are detailed, but annotation relies on closed-source Gemini3.1Pro/Seed2.1Pro and no explicit dataset/checkpoint release is stated (only a project homepage).

primary_link.title: OneStreamer: Unifying Perception, Memory, and Proactive Response in Streaming Video Interaction

papers.summary: Streaming video LLMs must retain evidence before its relevance to future tasks is known and respond when sufficient evidence becomes available. The challenge is to form reusable factual memory without compromising real-time perception. We introduce OneStreamer, which jointly learns query-independent evidence recording and task response through a shared proactive generation process. Its Proactive Hierarchical Caption Memory (PHCM) produces time-grounded local-detail captions and summaries of comp
papers.summary_zh: 串流視訊 LLM 必須在事件與未來任務的關聯尚未明朗前就保留證據，並在證據充足時即時回應，難點在於如何建立可重用的客觀記憶而不犧牲即時感知。作者提出 OneStreamer，以共享的主動生成程序同時學習與查詢無關的證據記錄與任務回應。其 Proactive Hierarchical Caption Memory（PHCM）產生時間錨定的局部細節字幕與已完成事件的摘要，訓練時以串流字幕目標監督對已觀測前綴的理解；推論時模型自行生成的紀錄與近期視覺視窗互補，無需回訪歷史視覺特徵。Proactive State Transition Learning（PSTL）保留所有輸出錨點的監督，並挑選具代表性的狀態轉換與狀態持續 token，僅監督 27.5% 標註狀態 token 即勝過稠密監督。作者另建串流資料合成流程，使輸出內容與時機對齊可得證據，結合清理後的開源資料構成 OneStreamer-1M，逾百萬筆紀錄。4B 模型在八項串流視訊理解基準上皆為最佳，平均相對 Qwen3-VL 提升 25.0%。消融顯示保留生成字幕可改善歷史問答且不損即時感知；PHCM 亦在效率上大幅優於保留完整視覺歷史。限制在於合成資料依賴閉源模型標註，且質性分析顯示物件狀態判讀與後續修正仍會出錯。

primary_link.title: GeoLatent: Geometry-Guided Latent Structuring with Routed Optimization for 3D Reasoning

papers.summary: Despite progress in vision-language models, 3D spatial reasoning from 2D images remains challenging. Text-based methods describe intermediate geometry with discrete tokens, limiting fidelity for continuous spatial relations. Continuous latents offer richer representations, but a single latent type does not explicitly separate the cues needed across spatial tasks. Decomposed spatial latents address this by representing position, direction, and global geometry separately under geometric supervisio
papers.summary_zh: 這篇論文處理的是視覺語言模型在二維影像上進行三維空間推理的困難。既有作法多以離散文字描述中介幾何，難以保留連續空間關係；連續潛在表徵雖較豐富，但單一潛在型態無法區分位置、方向與全域幾何等不同需求的線索。GeoAnchor 以位置、方向、幾何三種潛在分量拆解空間資訊，然而作者指出兩項未解問題：幾何對齊目標在教師幾何含強烈共同分量時，會讓多個幾何狀態學到幾乎相同的表徵，有效秩接近一；此外，即使把潛在中介插入推理軌跡，標準多模態注意力仍讓答案 token 直接讀取影像，使潛在表徵在答案學習中被閒置。为此提出 GeoLatent，包含共同—殘差幾何對齊（CR-GEO）與路由式最佳化。CR-GEO 在集合層次建模教師幾何的共同方向，再要求各幾何狀態捕捉互補的殘差幾何；路由式最佳化分為聯合、瓶頸、恢復三階段，先聯合訓練答案生成與幾何監督，再暫時切斷非潛在查詢對影像的注意力，迫使視覺資訊經由潛在中介傳遞，最後恢復完整注意力並保留幾何監督。在控制實驗中，僅替換對齊目標即讓幾何有效秩由 1.00 提升至 3.87，並在瓶頸階段將 128 題方向準確率由 89.1% 壓到 25.8%，顯示答案預測確實依賴潛在中介；恢復後仍保留可用的潛在路徑與差異化幾何表徵。GeoLatent 在 SPAR-Bench 達 73.0%、SPBench 達 72.1%，分別較 GeoAnchor 提升 4.6 與 2.4 個百分點。作者也以空白與錯配影像干預驗證視覺依賴，並坦承以人物為中心的參考框架方向仍非現有潛在詞彙所能編碼，屬未來延伸。
papers.title: GeoLatent: Geometry-Guided Latent Structuring with Routed Optimization for 3D Reasoning

llm_evaluation.rationale: Strong topical fit: span-level hallucination detection from LLM hidden states with a cross-model observer, touching LLMs, interpretability/probing, factuality/hallucination, and evaluation. Novelty is moderate—span-level BIO probing extends prior hidden-state forensics and multi-view attention span detection, with the cross-model observer claim being the most original element. Rigor is reasonable (multiple classifier baselines, an external reimplemented baseline, threshold-independent metrics, a random-layer robustness check, explicit class-imbalance analysis) but weakened by single-seed results, a test fold with only 57 onset tokens for the central cross-model claim, and per-dataset class weights tuned up to 300. Generalizability is limited to QA datasets and models under 7B, offline post-hoc use, as the authors concede. Reproducibility is aided by detailed appendix hyperparameters and hardware, but code/data are only promised and no multi-seed variance is given.

papers.summary_zh: 這篇論文處理大型語言模型（LLM）幻覺偵測的問題：現有的內部狀態探測方法多半把偵測化約為逐 token 的二元分類，無法掌握語意漂移在序列上的起點與延續邊界，而外部檢索式方法則不適用於離線、隱私敏感的部署情境。作者沿用「Ghost in the Transformer」的隱藏狀態鑑識概念，先以正常與幻覺特徵向量的餘弦相似度排序，挑出 Attention 與 MLP 的關鍵層，再從這些層抽取 Neuron Activation Score（NAS）並串接成逐 token 的高維特徵序列。接著把此序列送入多種分類器，包含 MLP 探測器、BiLSTM、BiLSTM-CRF、BiLSTM-Attn-CRF 與 BERT-CRF，並以 BIO 標記預測幻覺起點（B-HALL）與延續（I-HALL）。實驗涵蓋 SmolLM2、TinyLlama 與 Mistral-7B 三個生成模型，以及 PsiloQA 與 RAGTruth 資料集。結果顯示 CRF 解碼能藉由限制不合法的標籤轉移，明顯提升極度不平衡下起點的 Precision；在 SmolLM2 上 BERT-CRF 的起點 PR-AUC 為 0.362，遠高於隨機基準 0.024。跨模型實驗則讓 Qwen、Gemma 2、Gemma 4 等外部模型觀察另一模型的生成表徵，發現外部觀察者的起點偵測可匹敵甚至超越生成模型自我偵測，且當觀察者比生成者更小時依然成立（SmolLM2 觀察 Mistral-7B 時 PR-AUC 0.242 對 0.221）。限制在於單一隨機種子、僅 57 個起點 token 的測試折、僅限 7B 以下與 QA 資料集，且 BERT-CRF 在極端稀疏下最不穩定；作者將此定位為受控的概念驗證，而非普適定律。

Section II-D, Theorem II.6: zero KL iff reward CDF is a shifted exponential, continuous case only
Section II-D, Theorem II.7: d_KL = n/(8(n-2)) * 1/d^2 + O(1/d^3) for uniform discrete Q, n>=4
Fig. 1: numerical verification of 1/(8d^2) rate for n=10 only
Appendix H, Lemma V.1 proof: convergence argument with case-2(a) claiming J~(s0)=delta-gamma despite earlier stating J~(s0)=0 at the mean
Section VIII AI Use Statement: GPT 5.5/5.6 used for plot code and proof cleanup; no code repository provided
llm_evaluation.rationale: Highly relevant theory paper on LLM alignment (KL-constrained RL vs best-of-n), directly extending prior asymptotic closeness results from i.i.d. to Markov LM outputs and characterizing m=1 zero-KL reward/distribution classes with vocabulary-size dependence. Contributions are genuine but incremental over ref [1], with restrictive assumptions (stationary Markov chain, locally decomposable additive rewards) that deviate from real LLM behavior. Rigor is largely sound with full appendix proofs (LDP via Markovian Sanov + contraction principle, Perron-Frobenius characterization), though there are internal inconsistencies (e.g., Appendix L Eq. 116 displays log(n)+(n-1)/n contradicting delta=log(n)-(n-1)/n used elsewhere; Appendix H case 2(a) is loosely argued; several mislabeled theorem references like 'Theorem 11'). Evidence is almost purely theoretical: only one numerical figure (Fig. 1) verifies the 1/(8d^2) rate for n=10; no experiments on real LLMs, no empirical validation of the Markov/local-reward assumptions. Reproducibility is moderate: proofs are in appendices but no code release is claimed (only AI-use statement mentions GPT-generated plotting code).

primary_link.title: The Asymptotics of Language Model Alignment with Memory

papers.summary: Language model (LM) alignment broadly aims to perturb a given LM $Q$ into an aligned LM $q$ such that i) the outputs produced by $q$ and $Q$ are 'close' in probability, ii) $q$ has a higher expected reward than $Q$. Two common techniques for LM alignment are: KL-constrained RL, which requires knowledge of the LM distribution and is computationally expensive, and the best-of-$n$ algorithm, which requires only sampling from the LM. The work of Yang et al. established asymptotic closeness between t
papers.summary_zh: 本文研究語言模型（LM）對齊中兩種方法的理論關係：需要完整參考分布知識的 KL 約束強化學習（KL-constrained RL），以及僅需抽樣的 best-of-n。既有文獻[1]已證明當輸出為 m 個 i.i.d. 符記、獎勵可分解時，取 n=Θ(exp(m)) 會使兩者分布漸近接近。本文放寬假設，改以 irreducible、aperiodic 的馬可夫鏈描述具記憶性的輸出，並要求獎勵可分解為相鄰符記對的局部獎勵之和。作者首先證明 KL 約束 RL 的解為指數傾斜分布 q_β，其分子由矩陣 G_β（P 與 exp(βr) 的逐元素乘積）構成，並可寫成非平穩馬可夫過程；隨著 m 增大，該過程趨於平穩，轉移矩陣 p^(t) 收斂至帶流量約束最佳化問題的解 p（以 G_β 的 Perron 特徵值與特徵向量表示）。接著建立平均獎勵的大偏差原理，並證明在 n=exp(mδ) 下，(1/m)·d_KL(best-of-n, q_β) 隨 m→∞ 趨近 0，正面回答了記憶性下兩法是否仍漸近等價的問題。針對 m=1 的有限長度情形，作者完整刻畫 KL 散度恰為零的充要條件：獎勵的累積分布函數須為平移後的指數分布；離散均勻詞彙表下則給出 d_KL 約為 n/(8(n−2)d²)＋O(1/d³) 的衰減率，說明詞彙量越大差異越小。限制在於結果依賴局部獎勵分解與馬可夫假設，離散情形僅得漸近近似，非任意分布的非漸近緊緻界仍待後續研究。
papers.title: The Asymptotics of Language Model Alignment with Memory

links.title: Hob-VL: A Benchmark for Visually Grounded Boolean Reasoning

evidence: Table 4 (Section 5.1): Boolean accuracy 48.52-50.57% across 8 thinking-disabled/minimized configurations vs 63.50% symbolic for thinking-enabled GLM, over 6K questions per format.
Section 4.4: validation reports 681,691 checks and 6,144,000 truth-table rows covering all 1,024 assignments for 6,000 expressions, plus independent NL parser reconstruction.
Section 5.4 and Table 7: both-correct accuracy 45.13% with thinking enabled vs 50% constant-label baseline, and conflict rate rising from 18.90% to 36.47% among valid pairs.
Section 4.2: 4,166 of 6K questions meet influence/certificate criteria; certificate sizes 3-10 despite ten essential inputs per function.

Reproducibility Statement and Appendix D: construction, validation commands, and offline regeneration via evals.paper_results without API calls; model aliases and provider defaults limit exact reproduction.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Hob-VL is a VLM benchmark for visually grounded Boolean reasoning, touching multimodal LLM evaluation, reasoning (thinking-enabled vs disabled), and consistency across logically equivalent prompts. The design is thoughtful (De Morgan-verified expression pairs, dual symbolic/NL presentations, certificate size and influence diagnostics from Boolean-function analysis), but it is a benchmark/evaluation contribution rather than new LLM methodology, and it is multimodal-VQA-adjacent rather than core language modeling. Rigor is strong: exhaustive 2^10 truth-table verification, independent parser and NumPy re-evaluation, and careful handling of unknown spatial comparisons. Evidence is broad (126K responses across 9 configurations with per-family and per-property breakdowns), but claims are descriptive with no significance tests, only one thinking-enabled model, and confounded property-vs-family variation is acknowledged. Generalizability is limited by 46 photographs, synthetic scenes, and a 1K identification set; reproducibility is good (public repo, offline table regeneration) but tempered by mutable API model aliases and unrecorded sampling defaults.

Hob-VL comprises two tasks: (1) evaluating whether a Boolean rule holds in an image, and (2) identifying the (unique) object satisfying a Boolean description. Hob-VL contains 6,000 human-verified balanced Yes/No questions, each defined by a Boolean combination of ten visual statement
papers.summary_zh: 可靠的視覺推理，需要模型把多個視覺觀察組合起來，並對邏輯等價的問題給出一致答案。本篇提出 Hob-VL 基準，包含兩項任務：判斷某個布林規則在影像中是否成立，以及找出唯一滿足布林描述的物件。資料集含 6,000 題人工驗證、Yes/No 平衡的問題，每題由十條視覺陳述的布林組合定義，涵蓋 1,000 張生成場景與 46 張有標註的照片，另有 1,000 題物件辨識問題。題目刻意設計成以誤導性的局部線索與巢狀邏輯運算來挑戰推理，並同時提供符號式與結構化自然語言兩種表述，另外為每個基礎式配上 De Morgan 等價改寫，用於檢驗一致性。作者以九種組態評估八個視覺語言模型，共收集 126K 筆回應。在關閉或最小化 thinking 的八種組態中，布林準確率僅 48.52% 至 50.57%，幾乎等於擲銅板；物件辨識最高僅 43.0%。啟用 thinking 的 GLM 在符號式布林與兩種辨識格式上有明顯但落差很大的提升，自然語言布林題卻幾乎沒進展，且對等價表述經常給出互相矛盾的答案。此基準的價值在於以可執行參考答案與配對評估，同時揭露準確率、配對正確率、衝突率與輸出有效性，指出目前模型在視覺落地組合推理上的結構性弱點。限制在於題目共享影像與函數、未提供訓練切分，且部分模型設定與供應商預設可能變動，難以完全重現。

llm_evaluation.rationale: Theoretical study of nonlinear in-context learning comparing a fixed-kernel learner and a feature learner with one-layer linear attention on single-index tasks. Matches In-Context Learning and Transformer Architecture topics (attention mechanism, self-attention) but is synthetic-task theory, not LLM/NLP applied work. Novel contribution: controlled comparison on a common dataset, phase diagrams over N, N0, L, L-tilde, and distinct context-length scalings (d^k staged vs single L=Theta(d) transition). Rigor is strong: full replica derivations (explicitly flagged non-rigorous Gaussian-equivalence ansatz) plus a rigorous population-limit theorem (Theorem 2) with detailed proofs, assumptions, and lemmas. Evidence: numerical experiments with quantitative agreement to replica predictions across N sweeps (e.g., N=1200000 memorization 0.037 vs 0.046, generalization 0.354 vs 0.657), task-diversity and context-length scans, order-parameter consistency checks in Appendix C. Limitations are acknowledged: one-layer linear attention, spherical-harmonic features, idealized two-stage training, single synthetic teacher (Eq. 24), small d (16-32). No code/data availability statement, only detailed hyperparameters, so reproducibility is moderate. Generalizability to real LLMs or softmax/deep Transformers is not established.

A kernel learner first maps inputs through a fixed nonlinear feature map and then applies linear attention, whereas a feature learner applies attention to the original input, f
papers.summary_zh: 這篇論文研究脈絡學習（in-context learning, ICL）在非線性目標下的行為，跳脫過去理論多聚焦於線性目標的限制。作者在同一組單指標（single-index）任務上，比較兩種單層注意力架構：核學習器（kernel learner）先以固定的非線性特徵映射處理輸入，再套用線性注意力；特徵學習器（feature learner）則直接對原始輸入做注意力，之後接上可學習的非線性讀出層。為了讓分析可行，核方法採用球諧函數（spherical harmonics）作為特徵基底，並以重模方法（replica method）推導記憶誤差與泛化誤差，保留預訓練量、任務池多樣性，以及訓練與推論脈絡長度的影響。預測結果在多種參數條件下與數值實驗高度吻合。分析產生相位圖，說明在預訓練資料量、任務多樣性與脈絡長度變化時，何種架構較具優勢；並進一步證明兩者的脈絡長度尺度不同：核學習器要恢復 k 階球諧分量需 L 約為 d^k，呈階段式學習曲線，而特徵學習器僅需 L=Θ(d) 即可同時利用教師函數的所有 Hermite 分量。限制在於分析假設單層線性注意力、固定球諧特徵與理想化的兩階段訓練，且推論採無雜訊標籤、任務未分布偏移。此結果釐清架構選擇如何與資料規模互動，對理解非線性 ICL 的理論機制具重要意義。

llm_evaluation.rationale: FedFit targets federated LoRA fine-tuning of LLMs (Qwen2.5 0.5B-7B) with disjoint shared vector-bank parameterization, an alternating A/B-only vs A+B schedule with Residual Spectral Correction (RSC), and blockwise RTN quantization with error feedback. Strong preference relevance to LLM fine-tuning/PEFT and efficiency/compression topics. Novelty is moderate: vector banks (VB-LoRA/Uni-LoRA) and alternating LoRA updates (RoLoRA, LA-LoRA) are prior art; the federated combination plus rank-1 residual correction and the SoP=PoS argument for frozen-bank phases are the incremental contributions. Rigor is reasonable (convergence theorems with proofs, ablations for RSC, schedule, bank dimension, rank, quantization bits, non-IID Dirichlet sweep, K-scaling, wall-clock breakdown), but theory assumes exact gradients/full precision and omits quantization/minibatch effects; claims like 'theoretically grounded' non-IID robustness are overstated relative to evidence (Sec. VII, Table X). Evidence is quantitative across 7 commonsense benchmarks plus GSM8K/MMLU (Table I, II, IX), yet relies on a single dataset (Dolly) for main results, one fixed seed for ablations (three-seed check only for one cell), and full participation; the '100x' headline is a per-model compression ratio against FedIT, while abstract/conclusion state 1-3% and 20-100x inconsistently. Generalizability spans model scales and two task families but only one model family and no partial participation/stragglers (stated as future work). Reproducibility is partial: algorithm pseudocode, hyperparameters, bank sizes and schedules are given, but no code or artifact availability is claimed and per-baseline tuning details are sparse.

To tackle these challenges, we propose FedFit. First, to significantly reduce communication overhead, we introduce a disjoi
papers.summary_zh: 這篇論文處理聯邦學習（FL）微調大型語言模型（LLM）時的兩個痛點：通訊成本過高，以及 LoRA 在聯邦架構下的「聚合兩難」。所謂兩難，是指伺服器若先平均各客戶端的乘積 ΔW=B·Aᵀ（Sum-of-Products, SoP），結果會失去低秩結構、增加下行傳輸；若先分別平均 A 與 B 再相乘（Product-of-Sums, PoS），雖保留 LoRA 格式，卻丟棄跨客戶端的交叉項而造成聚合偏差。作者提出 FedFit，核心包含三部分：其一為「不相交共享向量庫參數化」，用兩個各自獨立、低維的全域向量庫，透過固定且具等距性質的稀疏隨機投影矩陣，重建所有層的 A 與 B 轉接矩陣，使可傳輸參數遠少於原始轉接器；其二為「交替最佳化排程」，在 A-only 與 B-only 階段凍結其中一側，使該側完全一致，於是 PoS 聚合在數學上等同於 SoP，達到精確聚合且上行傳輸減半，而在 A+B 聯合階段則以「殘差頻譜修正」（RSC）補償 FedAvg 遺漏的乘積資訊；其三為分塊 round-to-nearest 量化搭配客戶端誤差回饋，並允許上行與下行使用不同位元寬。理論部分證明向量庫目標函數具備區塊平滑與混合平滑性質，交替階段的梯度範數以 O(1/T) 收斂，聯合階段在足夠小的學習率下亦收斂至駐點。實驗以 Qwen2.5-0.5B/1.5B/3B/7B-Instruct 為基礎，在 Dolly 資料集上與 FedIT、Flex-LoRA、FFA-LoRA、RoLoRA、Quantized-LoRA、LoRA-FAIR、LA-LoRA 比較：FedFit 在多數設定的困惑度與七項常識推理平均分數略優或持平，而每輪每方向通訊量降至約 0.70 MB，於 7B 模型上相對基線壓縮約 100 倍，搭配 4-bit 量化後更降至約 0.19 MB。消融顯示 RSC 需同時作用於兩個向量庫才有效，非獨立同分布與客戶端數量擴充至 32 的測試亦維持穩定，但核心矩陣的頻譜顯示秩 1 修正在 K=16、32 時已失效而自動回退為 FedAvg。限制在於：理論分析假設精確梯度與全精度通訊，未涵蓋部分參與、傳輸錯誤與延遲，且實驗規模與基準仍屬有限，向量庫維度也成為新的壓縮與精度權衡旋鈕。此工作的重要性在於指出共享結構化參數化本身即為壓縮機制，讓十億級模型在無線或跨組織環境中的聯邦微調更具可行性。
papers.title: FedFit: Federated Fine-Tuning of LLMs via Vector-Bank Parameterization and Quantization
papers.title_zh: FedFit：以向量庫參數化與量化實現大型語言模型的聯邦微調

evidence: Section 4.2, Table 1: architectural sampling improves pass@9 over temperature sampling by 6.58 points on average across 5 Qwen checkpoints and 12 benchmarks, with gains in 55/60 checkpoint-benchmark pairs
Section 5, Table 2: early-layer window reuse beats middle/late placement on all five benchmarks (e.g., CV-Bench 96.40 early vs 93.25 middle vs 90.83 late)
Section 5, Table 3: jointly reprocessing visual and language tokens gives highest pass@9 on all five benchmarks; language-only retains most of the gain
Section 5, Figure 4(a)/(b): pass@9 stable across temperatures including greedy T=0; mean 1-Self-BLEU 0.51 (architectural) vs 0.22 (temperature)
Section 5, Table 4: architectural sampling exceeds temperature, beam search, top-k, top-p at equal 9-candidate budget on all five benchmarks
Section 5, Table 5: architectural rollouts improve TTRV pass@1 on both backbones (e.g., A-OKVQA +15.34 on Qwen3.5-VL-2B; but only +0.11 on CV-Bench for Qwen3-VL-8B)
Appendix C, Table 7: five-run standard deviation below 0.32 points for both strategies on five benchmarks
Appendix C, Table 8: gains generalize to InternVL3-2B (+1.54 avg) and Gemma3-4B (+17.63 avg); authors note broader model-family coverage remains to be studied
Appendix B: test-time learning trains on only 20 samples with LoRA rank 32, majority-vote rewards, no ground-truth labels
Appendix E, Tables 9-10: analytic layer-cost model gives 10.5 vs 9.0 normalized traversals; wall-clock 53.8s vs 46.1s for 9 candidates on an A100
Limitations (Section 6): recursion increases per-candidate cost and method requires access to internal decoder layers, excluding API-only models
llm_evaluation.rationale: Relevant to LLM/VLM test-time scaling (high-weight 'test-time' and multimodal/LLM topics) though framed around frozen vision-language models and multimodal benchmarks rather than language methodology; not a pure-CV paper since it perturbs decoder layer computation of LLM-based VLMs and uses GRPO test-time RL. The core idea — generating candidates by reusing contiguous decoder-layer windows at varying recursion depths — is a moderately novel sampling axis, though closely adjacent to CoLa, Inner Loop Inference, and Training-Free Looped Transformers, which the paper acknowledges. Empirics are reasonably thorough: 5 Qwen checkpoints x 12 benchmarks with a +6.58pp average pass@9 gain, ablations on window placement (Table 2), token reprocessing (Table 3), decoding-temperature robustness and Self-BLEU diversity (Figure 4), comparison to beam/top-k/top-p (Table 4), run-to-run variance over 5 repeats (Table 7), and cross-family transfer to InternVL3/Gemma3 (Table 8). However, the main claim rests on pass@9 coverage only (no pass@1/quality-of-individual-candidates analysis in the main table), the TTRV test-time learning result trains on just 20 samples (Appendix B) with modest and inconsistent gains (e.g. +0.11 on CV-Bench for Qwen3-VL-8B), and generality beyond Qwen-family VLMs is weak (InternVL3 gains only +1.54). Cost analysis is analytic plus latency (Appendix E, Tables 9-10, 53.8s vs 46.1s). Code was supplied for review with release promised (Appendix A, Reproducibility Statement), and hyperparameters are specified, supporting reasonable reproducibility.

primary_link.title: Architectural Sampling: Test-Time Scaling via Computational Diversity in Frozen Vision-Language Models

papers.summary: Test-time scaling often seeks better answers by sampling multiple responses from a frozen model, yet conventional temperature sampling generates every candidate along the same fixed computation path. We introduce architectural sampling, a training-free method that generates candidates through distinct forward computations by reusing selected blocks of decoder layers. Varying the block location and repetition count introduces computational diversity without updating model weights or adding auxili
papers.summary_zh:
這篇論文處理測試時擴展（test-time scaling）中一個長期被忽略的前提：候選答案的多樣性究竟從何而來。傳統做法是在凍結模型上以 temperature sampling 產生多個回應，但所有候選都走同一條固定運算路徑，多樣性只在生成最後階段注入。作者提出「架構取樣」（architectural sampling），一種免訓練方法：對每個候選挑選一段連續的 decoder 層區塊，重複套用若干次後再回到原本的前向傳遞。改變區塊位置與遞迴深度即可產生不同運算路徑，權重全程凍結、不新增任何參數，且可與 temperature 或 greedy 解碼併用。

實驗涵蓋五個 Qwen 檢查點與十二個多模態基準（CV-Bench、RealWorldQA、MMMU、BLINK、MathVista、AI2D 等），在相同九個候選預算下，架構取樣的 pass@9 平均比標準路徑的 temperature sampling 高 6.58 個百分點，六十組檢查點—基準比較中有五十五組改善。消融顯示重複早期層效果最佳，同時重處理視覺與語言 token 優於僅更新單一模態；候選的 1−Self-BLEU 平均為 0.51，明顯高於 temperature 取樣的 0.22，代表詞彙重疊更低。增益在 greedy 解碼下依然存在，並在 InternVL3 與 Gemma3 上初步驗證。作者進一步把架構候選當作 TTRV 這類無標籤測試時強化學習的 rollout，取代 temperature rollout 後準確率一致提升，顯示多樣性帶有與正確性相關的訊號。

限制方面，遞迴本質使每個候選的前向成本略增（約多 1 至 2 秒，深度 4 以內），且在資源受限環境可能造成負擔；方法需要存取內部 decoder 層，因此無法用於僅提供 API 的閉源模型。整體而言，此工作把「運算圖本身」開闢為新的取樣軸，指出測試時擴展不必然只能靠模型多說幾次，而是可以讓它以不同方式思考。
papers.title: Architectural Sampling: Test-Time Scaling via Computational Diversity in Frozen Vision-Language Models
papers.title_zh: 架構取樣：在凍結視覺語言模型中透過運算多樣性實現測試時擴展

links.title: Implementing Multi-Environment Access for Claude Platform on AWS

primary_link.title: Implementing Multi-Environment Access for Claude Platform on AWS

radar.summary: Learn how to configure secure, multi-environment access to Claude Platform on AWS from a single subscription: cross-account SigV4 for AWS workloads, workspace-scoped API keys for developers, and OIDC federation for external environments, with workspace-level isolation in a dedicated AI Services account.
radar.summary_zh: 這篇文章（目前僅有摘要）談的是如何在單一訂閱的前提下，讓 Claude 平台在 AWS 上支援安全的多環境存取。問題核心在於：企業往往同時存在多個 AWS 帳號與多種執行環境，開發者、內部工作負載與外部合作夥伴都需要各自取得模型服務，但又不該共用同一組長期憑證，否則權限邊界模糊、稽核困難，一旦憑證外洩更難以界定影響範圍。文中提出的做法屬於架構與設定的實務指引，而非新演算法或模型訓練技術。它規劃三條存取路徑：針對 AWS 原生工作負載採用跨帳號的 SigV4 簽章，讓服務以 IAM 角色身分呼叫；針對開發者則發放範圍限定於特定 workspace 的 API key，避免一把萬用金鑰；針對外部環境則透過 OIDC 聯邦交換短期權杖，降低靜態祕密的管理負擔。並將這些資源集中放在專用的 AI Services 帳號中，以 workspace 層級做隔離，使不同團隊或租戶的用量與權限互不干擾。摘要未提供具體的效能數據、延遲量測或安全性驗證結果，也沒有比較不同方案的量化差異，因此其實證基礎主要來自架構層面的最佳實務與憑證最小權限原則。其限制在於缺乏實測佐證，實際導入成效仍取決於各組織的帳號治理成熟度。儘管如此，對已在 AWS 上運行 Claude 的團隊而言，這份指引提供了具體可循的多環境隔離藍圖，有助於在合規與開發效率之間取得平衡。
radar.title: Implementing Multi-Environment Access for Claude Platform on AWS

evidence: Abstract/Table 1: mean TPOT 38.0-44.8 ms (MoE-CORE) vs 1268.9-1269.1 ms (vLLM Prefetch) on DeepSeek-V4-Flash-W4A8; 206.6-220.5 vs 5941.5-5941.8 ms on GLM-5.2-W4A8C8
Sec. 4.3: TPOT reductions vs LoD of 42.9% (GSM8K), 33.1% (AIME 2026), 27.9% (HumanEval), 35.3% (MMLU), 42.9% (LongBench v2); E2EL gains 1.36-1.79x
Sec. 4.5.2/Figure 8: disabling RHAC raises TPOT from 36.0 to 46.8 ms (30.0% degradation); removing domain profile +1.4%; uniform allocation +1.1%
Sec. 4.5.3/Figure 9: prefetch depth 0 to 3 lowers TPOT 42.6 -> 36.0 -> 35.9 -> 36.5 ms; hit rate 89.05% -> 92.43/93.81/94.05%
Sec. 4.5.4/Table 3: AES raises effective availability 92.43% -> 99.972% but adds 4.7% TPOT overhead (36.0 -> 37.7 ms) at batch 1
Sec. 4.1 (Request Protocol): LoD/MoE-CORE capped at 1K output tokens but vLLM Prefetch at 128 tokens, so E2EL/TPS comparisons restricted to LoD and MoE-CORE
Limitations: single-NPU evaluation only; no joint KV-cache optimization; RHAC CPU-side updates add latency
llm_evaluation.rationale: Strong preference match for LLM inference efficiency: MoE expert offloading for memory-constrained LLM serving (LLM, MoE, inference/serving, efficiency, long-context memory pressure). Method novelty is incremental: a coordinated runtime combining dynamic layer-wise cache allocation, domain-profile initialization, an LRU-like routing-history cache, cross-layer prefetching, and score-proximity expert substitution — most components exist in prior systems (MoE-Infinity, SiDA-MoE, Fate, AdapMoE, SMoE/BuddyMoE), though the integration and characterization of layer-wise hit-rate skew and domain routing bias are useful. Rigor/evidence are weakened by concerns: the vLLM Prefetch baseline reports essentially identical TPOT (1268.9-1269.1 ms) across all five DeepSeek datasets and 5941.5-5941.8 ms across all GLM datasets, suggesting a degenerate or misconfigured baseline; output caps differ between systems (1K vs 128 tokens), confounding E2EL/TPS comparison; evaluation is batch size 1 only, on a single Ascend NPU, with two models. Ablations (cache capacity, RHAC, domain init, allocation, prefetch depth, AES) are systematic and quantitatively reported (Sec. 4.5), limitations are candidly stated, and code is claimed available. Generalizability is limited to single-NPU appliances and this hardware/software stack.

primary_link.title: MoE-CORE: Coordinated Expert Offloading and Residency for Memory-Constrained MoE Inference

radar.summary: Sparse expert activation reduces MoE models' computation, yet expert weights can exceed limited device memory. Offloading makes inference feasible on a compact AI appliance but exposes host-to-device transfers to the inference path. We present MoE-CORE, a system that coordinates expert offloading and residency for memory-constrained MoE inference. It stages complete expert layers in alternating buffers during prefill. During decode, it combines nonuniform layer-wise cache capacity, domain-inform
radar.summary_zh: 這篇論文針對單節點 AI 設備上部署大型 MoE 模型時，專家權重總量超出裝置記憶體的問題，提出 MoE-CORE 系統。作者指出，卸載雖讓推論可行，卻把主機到裝置（H2D）的傳輸放到推論關鍵路徑上；現有快取、預測、排程與替代等作法多在短上下文情境驗證，長上下文下專家常駐與卸載延遲的互動仍缺乏刻畫。MoE-CORE 因此為 prefill 與 decode 設計分離路徑：prefill 以兩個交替緩衝區暫存完整 MoE 層權重，重疊下一層傳輸；decode 則結合非均勻分層快取配置、依工作負載領域的熱門專家初始化、路由歷史感知（RHAC）替換，以及跨層預取，並提供可選的近似專家替代（AES）處理低分數的邊界未命中。實驗在 Ascend 950PR NPU、84 GB 記憶體上限下，以 DeepSeek-V4-Flash-W4A8 與 GLM-5.2-W4A8C8 於五個工作負載測試。精確執行設定下，DeepSeek 平均 TPOT 為 38.0–44.8 ms，GLM 為 206.6–220.5 ms，皆低於 LoD 與所評估的 vLLM Prefetch。消融顯示 RHAC 為維持 decode 常駐工作集的主要機制，移除後 TPOT 由 36.0 升至 46.8 ms；跨層預取以深度 1 最划算。另在 GSM8K 上啟用 AES 與 MTP 深度 2，最佳 TPOT 達 21.5 ms。限制包括未與 KV 快取聯合最佳化、僅單一 NPU 驗證、多 NPU 專家放置仍待研究，且 RHAC 的 CPU 端更新會帶來額外延遲，長 MTP 深度的傳輸成本亦需進一步釐清。
radar.title: MoE-CORE: Coordinated Expert Offloading and Residency for Memory-Constrained MoE Inference
radar.title_zh: MoE-CORE：記憶體受限 MoE 推論下的專家卸載與常駐協同排程

Section 4 Finding 2: feature guidance lifts Llama to 0.79 F1 and Claude to 0.94 but degrades GPT-5-mini to 0.25-0.40 under lexico-semantic prompting

llm_evaluation.rationale: Directly relevant to LLM evaluation, LLM-as-judge, and code generation detection. The 'detector half-life' framing and cross-generator/ prompting-strategy comparison are a useful but incremental contribution. Rigor is limited by a very small benchmark (18 problems, 18 human vs 126 AI snippets), no statistical significance testing, no ablation beyond prompting variants, and unverified claims about class bias directions (e.g., Llama 'predicts almost only AI') that lack a confusion-matrix table. primary_link.title: Code Detectors Have a Half-Life: Obsolescence and Metric Illusions in LLM-Generated Code Detection

radar.summary: Code detectors can become obsolete as code-generating models evolve: a detector validated on one generation of models may not transfer to the next. We call this limited useful life a detector half-life. We evaluate eight general-purpose LLM judges and three dedicated detectors on human-written code and code produced by seven generators across C++, Java, and Python. Our results reveal two problems. First, performance varies considerably across generators and prompting strategies, suggesting that
radar.summary_zh: 這篇論文指出，偵測 LLM 生成程式碼的分類器會隨生成模型演進而失效，作者稱之為「偵測器半衰期」。研究採用 AI-Human-Generated-Program-Code 資料集，涵蓋 C++、Java、Python 三種語言、18 個人類解法，以及 7 個生成器（StarCoder、ChatGPT、Bing AI Chat、Code Llama、CodeWhisperer、GitHub Copilot、InstructCodeT5+）各 126 段程式碼，並以 8 個通用 LLM 評審（Llama 3.1-70B、Gemini-2.5-Flash、Gemini-3-Flash、Ministral-14B、Mistral Large、GPT-3.5-Turbo、GPT-5-mini、Claude Sonnet 5）搭配四種提示策略（直接零樣本、詞彙引導、結構引導、詞彙語意引導）進行比較，每筆查詢重複三次取平均，並與 DetectCodeGPT、GPT-Sniffer、GPT-Zero 三個專用偵測器對照。主要證據有三：其一，專用偵測器在原作者設定下表現良好，但在此生成器集合上全面退化為準確率 0.50、F1 為 0.00，顯示其幾乎把所有樣本判為 AI 生成，證明其有效壽命受生成分布變化所限；其二，通用 LLM 評審表現突出，GPT-5-mini 零樣本 F1 可達 0.75 至 0.95，但詞彙語意引導反而使其降至 0.25 至 0.40，而 Llama 與 Claude 則在特徵引導下明顯回升，顯示提示策略與評審身分存在交互作用；其三，準確率會掩蓋預測偏誤，Llama 幾乎只判 AI、Gemini-2.5 與 GPT-3.5 偏向人類，Claude 對不同生成器的 F1 從高於 0.82 到低於 0.50。限制在於資料集規模有限、僅涵蓋三種語言與七個生成器，且未處理人機混合程式碼。作者建議應跨多個生成器驗證 LLM 評審，並同時報告 macro-F1 與各類別的精確率與召回率，而非僅看整體準確率。
radar.title: Code Detectors Have a Half-Life: Obsolescence and Metric Illusions in LLM-Generated Code Detection

llm_evaluation.rationale: Speech language model paper on latent reasoning: GMM mixture over alternative latent continuations, joint chunk prediction, and GRPO-style RL with quality-gated conciseness reward for adaptive reasoning depth. Strong relevance to reasoning/CoT and RL training topics, plus speech/audio and efficiency themes, but the domain is speech/audio-centric rather than general LLM methodology. Method is reasonably novel (distributional latent transitions with low-rank-plus-diagonal covariance, chunkwise semantic alignment, latent scheduled sampling). Rigor is solid: two backbones (Qwen2.5-Omni, Kimi-Audio), ablations for CSA/LSS/reward/mixture size/rank, grid over compression and chunk size, component intervention with controls (within-component resampling, collapsed mixture, single Gaussian), difficulty-depth analysis, latency distributions with paired protocol. Weaknesses: single seed per setting, small SFT-to-RL margins in several metrics (e.g., IFEval still below CoT-RL), difficulty ratings via LLM judge, reliance on LLM judges (DeepSeek-V4-Flash, Gemini-3.5-Flash) for quality scores and plan execution, corpus built partly from synthesized speech. Evidence is mostly quantified with tables and appendix detail; code/data release only promised on publication and license-restricted.

Explicit chain-of-thought (CoT) improves reasoning and audio understanding, but generating intermediate reasoning tokens delays responses. Describing fine-grained acoustic cues further lengthens CoT and increases latency. Latent reasoning can reduce this overhead, yet existing methods often trail CoT and remain limited by single-path supervision and
radar.summary_zh: 語音語言模型（SLM）同時追求智慧與即時回應相當困難。顯式思維鏈（CoT）雖能提升推理與音訊理解，卻必須逐字生成中間推理符記，拉長延遲；而音色、韻律、情緒等細緻聲學線索又難以用文字精確描述，進一步增加 CoT 長度。既有潛在推理方法多半仍落後 CoT，且受限於單一路徑監督與不隨難度調整的推理預算。作者提出 AURAL，在潛在空間中以高斯混合模型（GMM）表示多種合理的推理延續，並聯合預測未來狀態區塊，以減少序列前向傳遞次數。為提供初始監督，作者建構 AuralReason-683K，涵蓋 68.3 萬筆雙語語音（約 1,000 小時）與精簡 CoT，包含語音情緒辨識、同理對話與一般推理。AURAL-RL 進一步以結果導向的獎勵探索，獎勵「簡潔且答案品質高」的推理，並依問題難度調整推理深度。實驗在 Qwen2.5-Omni 與 Kimi-Audio 兩個骨幹上，AURAL-RL 在多數指標上優於各自的監督檢查點，整體表現與 CoT-RL 相當；在 Qwen2.5-Omni 上，首個答案符記的時間由 1.22 秒降至 0.10 秒，約 11.8 倍加速（直接回答為 0.05 秒）。分析亦顯示較難題目會觸發更多潛在推理步數。限制在於部分語音來源僅允許研究用途、需限制釋出，且推理軌跡由教師模型生成，可能帶有偏誤；混合成分是否也能分離競爭的聲學詮釋仍待未來研究。

links.title: Building ambient agents with Amazon Bedrock AgentCore: From event-driven signals to human-in-the-loop workflows

primary_link.title: Building ambient agents with Amazon Bedrock AgentCore: From event-driven signals to human-in-the-loop workflows

radar.summary: Ambient agents respond to events such as an Amazon S3 upload, a schedule, or an alert instead of waiting for a chat prompt. This post walks through building framework-agnostic ambient agents on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore using Amazon SQS, AWS Lambda, and Amazon DynamoDB, with a single ask_human tool and a Jobs page for human-in-the-loop review.
radar.summary_zh: 這篇技術文章的出發點，是傳統對話式代理必須等待使用者輸入提示才會動作，無法主動回應環境變化。作者提出「環境感知代理」（ambient agent）的做法：改由事件觸發，例如 Amazon S3 上傳檔案、排程時間到點，或系統發出告警，代理便自動啟動處理流程，而不需人工下達指令。方法上，文章以 Amazon Bedrock AgentCore 為執行基礎，搭配 Amazon SQS 佇列傳遞事件、AWS Lambda 執行動作，並以 Amazon DynamoDB 保存狀態與工作紀錄，整體設計刻意保持框架中立，讓不同代理框架都能套用。文中特別設計單一的 ask_human 工具，當代理遇到需要判斷或授權的環節時，可暫停流程並請求人工介入，同時提供一個 Jobs 頁面，讓審查者檢視待處理工作與歷史結果，形成人在迴路（human-in-the-loop）的監督機制。由於目前僅有摘要，文章未提供具體的量測數據、成功率或延遲表現，也未討論成本、安全性與大規模部署的限制，這些都是後續需要驗證之處。儘管如此，此文示範了如何把事件驅動架構與人工審核結合，對於需要自動化卻又不能完全放手的高風險企業流程，提供了可參考的工程藍圖，也點出代理系統從被動回應走向主動感知的實務路徑。

llm_evaluation.rationale: SoK on decentralized agent economic infrastructure with a novel 'guarantee closure' criterion across six lifecycle stages. radar.summary:

This creates a simple problem: a workflow can look correct at each step and still produce the wrong outcome. For example, a correct escrow may release payment on an authorized approval that provides little evidence that the delivered work actually satisfied the task.
  We systematize this problem across the full lifecycle of an agent task. Our study organizes security and econ
radar.summary_zh: 本文系統化梳理去中心化代理人經濟（DAE）中的跨階段保證失效問題：單一工作流程的每個步驟看似正確，整體仍可能產生錯誤結果，例如託管合約依一筆授權核准釋款，但該核准並未證明交付成果確實符合任務要求。作者將安全與經濟需求整理為六個生命週期階段、17 個性質家族，並將收據健全性與完備性分開評估；比較 12 個系統與標準、五個可重用機制家族及四個古典基準，提出「保證閉合」此一相對於任務的判準，用以檢驗某階段建立的保證是否仍可用、且能約束依賴它的後續決策。方法上涵蓋受控與原生工作流程，共 840 次配對執行，以及有限客觀任務域上 11,648 筆窮舉檢查。結果顯示驗證與清算之間反覆出現失效：合格工作未被接受，或有效證據被忽略。公開紀錄與模型判斷可區分「已記錄的核准」與「任務符合性的證據」，經濟分析則指出回報、罰則與共同誤差假設。限制在於多數結論依賴宣告的假設與特定服務設定，並非普遍保證；其重要性在於指出端到端保證何處斷裂，以及需要修補的環節。

llm_evaluation.rationale: Core contribution is statistical learning theory for discrete diffusions on categorical data (MRF targets): a new pinning decomposition separating time and target in the discrete score, a weight-sharing ReLU score learner, and end-to-end KL guarantees with rate O~(S^d/n). Connection to LLMs is motivational only (finite-memory language models, discrete diffusion LMs); experiments are on Potts/Ising/tree models, so preference relevance is moderate. Theory is deep and well argued (Theorems 1-4, oracle inequality, lower bound via Cho and Wu), with proofs in appendices and explicit constants. Experiments are thorough (10 repetitions, paired CIs, grid/sample-size studies, oracle-score baseline) though parameter budgets are unmatched and MMD estimates are noisy; the paper honestly notes experimental targets do not satisfy the normalized-factor convention of the theory (Appendix A.1). Generalizability is limited to low-order MRFs with bounded flip ratio; reproducibility is good on protocol detail but no code release is claimed.

primary_link.title: Sample complexity bounds for categorical Markov random fields via Discrete Diffusions

radar.summary: Many applications in statistics, economics, and physics require sampling from high-dimensional categorical distributions with local dependence structures. Examples include finite memory language models, Ising and Potts systems in statistical physics and protein folding, etc. In modern machine learning, discrete diffusions have emerged as a flexible approach for sampling such data, with strong empirical performance. Motivated by this, we develop learning methods with end-to-end sample complexity
radar.summary_zh: 這篇論文研究如何從有限樣本中，學習以離散擴散模型取樣高維類別型資料，並給出端到端的統計保證。作者針對均勻加噪的前向程序，假設目標分布 q⋆ 為 d 階馬可夫隨機場（MRF）並滿足有界翻轉比（離散版的 Lipschitz 分數條件）。核心技術洞見是「釘選分解」（pinning decomposition）：在均勻加噪下，分數可寫成兩個函數 g_t 的比值，而 g_t 可表示為時間權重與目標邊際乘積之和，時間只透過 Binomial(D, μ_t) 權重進入、與 q⋆ 無關，資料則只透過與 t 無關的部分邊際進入。這使得同一個網路可在整個訓練時間區間內學習分數，並在推論時才選擇取樣網格。作者進一步觀察到 MRF 的部分邊際是多個小潛勢表的乘積，表內元素會被大量重複使用，因而提出權重共享（weight-sharing）ReLU 分數網路，其有效參數量與 MRF 本身的參數量同級，避免 S^D 的環境複雜度。搭配 τ-leaping 取樣器，作者在隨機抽取的訓練時間上控制分數熵風險的時間積分，推導出單一網路在全域訓練區間上的 oracle 不等式，並將估計誤差、初始化誤差與離散化誤差分解後給出 KL(q⋆‖p_T) 的界。主要結果顯示，當互動階數 d 固定時，端到端速率為 Õ_P(S^d/n)，也就是詞彙量 S 的冪次由互動階數 d 而非序列長度 D 決定，遠優於無結構情形下的 S^D/n；作者並論證此速率在 n 與 S 上（至對數因子）具 minimax 最優性。數值實驗在 Potts 鏈、受挫 Ising 階梯與類別樹上（d=2、D 最高 32）顯示，權重共享網路在較高維度下比全連接網路有更低的分數風險與邊緣配對 TV，且同一訓練好的網路可套用不同取樣網格；不過在較小維度，全連接網路仍具競爭力，而部分 MMD 比較的差異並不穩定。限制方面，理論需要 d 固定、有界翻轉比與均勻加噪假設，且對 D 的依賴僅在多項式意義下成立；實驗中部分目標（如 Ising 階梯）並未嚴格滿足論文較強的歸一化因子限制，架構也未完全落實理論搜尋類別的所有限制，因此屬於啟發性驗證。整體而言，此工作把離散擴散模型的統計理論從無結構的 S^D 推展到由局部依賴結構主導的 S^d，並解釋了卷積與遞迴等權重共享架構在此類資料上的實用優勢。

llm_evaluation.rationale: Architecture paper on candidate-independent block-causal attention for permutation-robust action scoring over LLM backbones (Gemma 3, Qwen3), relevant to transformer architecture, LLMs, and agent/tool-use decision heads. The idea (cross-candidate attention blocking plus position resetting) is a clean but incremental structural fix relative to Deep Sets, dual/poly-encoders, and permutation augmentation. Evaluation is reasonably rigorous: matched train/val/test/OOD splits, three backbones, group-level bootstrap CIs, a mechanism ablation isolating isolation vs position resetting, and explicit limitations (one seed per condition, unmatched dual-encoder baseline, no block-sparse kernels). Evidence is quantitative (Tables I–II, flip rates 8.3%→0.1% etc.) but self-reported, primarily one decision benchmark, with the 250K artifact lacking a matched causal comparison. Code and model artifacts are claimed available with full hyperparameters.

primary_link.title: Permutation-Robust Decision Modeling with Candidate-Independent Block-Causal Attention

This setting is increasingly relevant for System 1 components inside generative systems, where candidates may be proposed or ordered differently across runs. Standard causal cross-encoding is expressive, but it can make a candidate's score depend on serialization order rather than on the underlying decision problem. We introduce candidate-independent block-causal attention, which preserves causal
radar.summary_zh: 這篇論文處理一個常見卻容易被忽略的問題：決策模型常把狀態或指令與一組數量不定的候選動作串接成單一序列，交給預訓練的因果 Transformer 評分。這種 cross-encoder 雖然表達力強，卻讓序列化順序變成潛在特徵——後面的候選項可以取用前面候選項的資訊，旋轉位置編碼也會因候選項排列不同而改變，導致同一組候選動作在不同排列下得到不同分數或選擇。作者提出「候選項無關區塊因果注意力」（CI）：共享前綴維持因果計算，每個候選項區塊僅能關注前綴與自身之前的 token，並在每個區塊重置位置，使同一段候選文字不論顯示順序為何都得到相同的位置序列；候選項仍在最終 softmax 中彼此競爭。研究在 Gemma 3 1B、Qwen3 1.7B 與 Qwen3 4B 三個骨幹上，以相同訓練資料、批次大小與 checkpoint 選擇準則，比較標準因果注意力、CI 與凍結雙編碼器基線，並以群組層級 bootstrap 量化不確定性。結果顯示 CI 在三種骨幹上都能大幅降低排列翻轉率（例如 Qwen3 1.7B 由 18.2% 降至 1.2%），同時維持甚至略升測試準確率；機制消融指出「候選項隔離」是主要來源，單獨重置位置反而比因果基線更差。限制在於主要比較僅用單一隨機種子、CI 以稠密核心計算、雙編碼器未做最佳化匹配，250K 案例研究也未提供因果對照。其意義在於讓候選項順序成為可控的架構性質，而非序列化的意外副作用，對生成式系統中作為快速 System 1 元件的決策模型尤其重要。
