llm_evaluation.rationale: Theory paper on expressivity of residual self-attention: universal interpolation with a fixed finite dictionary of frozen attention blocks, motivated by looped/recurrent-depth transformers. Strong Transformer Architecture relevance (self-attention, softmax attention blocks) but no LLM training, prompting, reasoning, or language methodology; relevance is architectural and mathematical. Novel contributions: two frozen Gaussian single-head blocks suffice (Theorem 3.5), O(Nnd) blocks for general heads (Theorem 3.3), exact rank obstruction for causal attention when N>d (Proposition 3.8), and continuous-to-finite-depth transfers (Propositions 2.9/2.10). Rigor is high with detailed appendices (Chow-Rashevskii criteria, Ax-Schanuel argument in Appendix L), explicit limitations (no depth bounds, conjectural head-width threshold in Remark 3.6), and a clear analytic-converse remark. Code and reproducibility details are provided (Section 2.2.2, Appendix M, run_threshold.py).

primary_link.title: Universal interpolation for deep residual self-attention networks

While it is generically verified on a variety of neural architectures and random feature models, it typically involves infinite width limits. radar.summary_zh: 這篇論文研究 Transformer 自注意力模組的表達力，但跳脫傳統「無限寬度」的極限框架，改採「深度驅動」的對偶情境：參數在不同層之間高度共享，呼應近期 Looped Transformers 等遞迴深度模型。作者提出「萬用內插（universal interpolation）」概念，要求事先固定一組有限的注意力區塊參數（不看資料），之後僅靠選擇區塊、正負號與作用時間長度，就能把任意 N 條、每條 n 個 token 的序列批次精確映射到任意另一組序列。方法上，作者把殘差層視為連續深度 ODE 的尤拉離散化，並透過 Chow–Rashevskii 控制理論的 Lie 秩條件，建立從連續深度過渡到有限深度的充分準則（命題 2.9、2.10），同時提供 PyTorch 實作以數值探索 Lie 代數秩。主要結果包括：非因果注意力下，透過高斯初始化的凍結區塊可達成萬用內插，區塊數隨批次大小線性成長（定理 3.3）；單頭寬度 r≥d 時，僅需兩個凍結隨機區塊即可在滿測度的連通區域上達成（定理 3.5），並延伸至有限深度。針對因果遮罩，作者證明首個 token 的更新為線性，會保留批次首 token 之間的線性關係，故當 N>d 時精確內插不可能（命題 3.8）；但若限定輸入與目標共享相同的首 token 線性關係，則在每個連通分量上仍可用有限凍結區塊達成萬用內插（推論 3.10）。限制在於：深度上界未給出，萬用內插的頭寬度門檻（推測 m≥⌈d/r⌉）仍為開放問題，且實驗顯示邊界處對條件數敏感。此工作的重要性在於把「深度與參數重用」如何產生表達力這個問題形式化，為迴圈式 Transformer 的理論基礎與 scaling law 研究提供素材，也延續了 Agrachev 與 Letrouit 關於等變系統通用可控性的開放方向。

llm_evaluation.rationale: Video/VLM spatial reasoning sits at the edge of my core interests, but it engages relevant themes (agent tool use, reasoning-failure diagnosis, VLM evaluation, training-free prompting-style augmentation). The work is a controlled diagnostic study plus a composable geometric operator library (CROSS), evaluated through two interfaces (context augmentation for Qwen3-VL-32B-Thinking and tool calls for the SpatialClaw agent) on five benchmarks. Methodological strengths: matched GT-vs-predicted context arms with a shared schema/coordinate contract, a four-mode failure taxonomy with explicit matching rules and counts (Appendix A.5), ablations on VSI-Bench (Table 11), frozen-operator cross-benchmark transfer (DSI-Bench +3.5), and candid limitations (Appendix E). Weaknesses: single-run point estimates with sampling decoding and no significance tests, gate/router hyperparameters tuned on a dev split of the diagnostic data (reported scores include dev scenes), unmatched cross-system baselines differing in backbone and frame budget, gains partially driven by routing to video-only fallback rather than operator outputs (Appendix D.1), and no code/artifact availability claim beyond described settings. Overall solid, honest engineering research with moderate personal relevance.

primary_link.title: From Reasoning Failures to Composable Video Spatial Intelligence

radar.summary: Spatial reasoning benchmarks evaluate vision-language models across diverse tasks, but task-level scores do not reveal which underlying capabilities account for success or failure. Each task requires recovering spatial evidence, representing geometry, and reasoning over it. We disentangle these capabilities by comparing predicted and ground-truth spatial context under a shared schema and coordinate contract. This comparison reveals four recurring sources of error: inaccurate perception, missing
radar.summary_zh: 空間推理基準雖能評估視覺語言模型，但任務層級的分數無法揭示成功或失敗究竟源自哪些底層能力。本文以共享的座標契約與空間情境結構，對照預測情境與 ground-truth 情境，歸納出四類反覆出現的錯誤：感知不精確、空間情境缺漏必要資訊、選錯量測方式（例如以中心距取代最近表面間隙），以及參考座標系或狀態更新錯誤（左右反轉、初始姿態重複使用）。據此，作者提出 CROSS，一套免訓練的可組合幾何運算子與空間技能庫，運算子各自負責單一計算，再依任務組合成技能，並可透過閘控與過濾機制，將可用證據提供給不寫程式的 VLM，或作為可呼叫工具供 SpatialClaw 代理使用。實證涵蓋五個基準：在 ReVSI 平均由 55.9% 提升至 60.2%，在 DSI-Bench 上 SpatialClaw 由 62.8% 提升至 66.3%，VSI-Bench 與 STI-Bench 亦見小幅增益。限制在於預測情境仍受單眼尺度與旋轉漂移影響、閘控屬啟發式、運算子未涵蓋加速度與外觀順序，且各系統骨幹與影格預算不一致，分數僅供描述性參考。整體意義在於：單靠更準確的空間證據並不足以保證可靠推理，把「恢復了什麼證據」與「如何計算」明確分離，是通往可重用空間推理系統的實務路徑。

primary_link.title: InterEvolve: Test-Time Evolution of Reward Programs for Humanoid Loco-Manipulation

radar.summary: We study test-time evolution for humanoid loco-manipulation: solving tasks that a controller was never trained for by repurposing its existing skills, improving from its own attempts, and retaining what it learns, without retraining. Our key insight is that a broad controller already holds much of the competence a new task needs, and that this competence becomes accessible through an interface between planning and control that is expressive enough to specify contact-rich, multi-stage interaction
radar.summary_zh: 這篇論文研究「測試時間演化」：不重新訓練控制器，而是重新利用既有技能來解決從未訓練過的任務。核心洞見是廣泛訓練過的控制器其實已具備新任務所需的大部分能力，關鍵在於規劃與控制之間要有足夠表達力、又能被執行與量測的介面。作者提出 InterEvolve，由兩部分組成：一是物件感知的前向—後向（FB）行為基礎模型，在凍結的身體先驗上加上可訓練的物件殘差，讓新的獎勵在測試時轉化為全身移動操作行為；二是把任務寫成「獎勵程式」，即帶完成條件與可調常數的分階段獎勵。LLM 代理在上下文中修訂程式結構，數值最佳化器（CMA-ES）調整常數，每個候選都在平行模擬場景中驗證。實驗顯示，人手設計的獎勵未能釋放 FB 模型既有的移動操作能力，而演化出的程式則能釋放，甚至產生新策略；在八類目標導向任務上，成功率由最佳校準固定程式約 34.6% 提升到 86.5%，並可泛化到新目標、新起始條件與其他箱型物件，且演化出的技能能在實體 Unitree G1 上以機載自我中心視覺自主執行。限制在於程式搜尋受制於馬達技能庫、獎勵推論狀態庫與可量測量，無法誘發控制器從未學過的行為，且每輪搜尋需耗費大量模擬 GPU 時間與 LLM 延遲，無法即時重新規劃。

Relevant mainly to multimodal AI safety, guardrail evaluation, and reinforcement learning fine-tuning rather than core LLM or Japanese NLP topics. Novelty is a sensible but incremental synthesis of Tversky loss, EMA-based feedback control, and GRPO. Rigor is solid: matched-initialization comparisons of EM/GRPO-static vs adaptive rewards (Table 2), a Qwen3-VL-8B replication (Table 6), step-size analysis (Appendix E), cross-dataset transfer (Appendix G), cross-taxonomy/low-resource transfer (Appendix L), multi-label-only subset (Appendix H), and a post-hoc threshold-tuning comparison (Appendix K) that addresses a key confound. primary_link.title: Controllable Multi-label Video Safety Detection via Adaptive Tversky Policy Optimization

Although recent Vision-Language Models (VLMs) show strong video understanding capabilities, existing harmful video detection systems face two key limitations: they typically reduce safety detection to binary classification, overlooking the inherently multi-label nature of unsafe videos, and they rely on static training objectives that do no
radar.summary_zh: 這篇論文處理影片社群平台上的有害內容偵測問題。作者指出既有系統有兩項限制：多半把安全偵測簡化為二元分類，忽略不安全影片往往同時帶有多個類別（例如暴力與辱罵並存）；此外訓練目標固定，無法因應不同審核流程調整精確率與召回率的取捨。為此，他們提出 ATPO（Adaptive Tversky Policy Optimization），建構於 GRPO 之上，並設計自適應 Tversky 獎勵（ATR）。ATR 把 Tversky 係數中控制偽陽性與偽陰性懲罰的參數，改為由回饋控制器動態調整：系統以指數移動平均追蹤各類別的 FN 與 FP 數量，與使用者指定的目標 FN/FP 比值比較後更新係數，提供全域（G-ATR）與類別感知（C-ATR）兩種版本。實驗在 SafeWatch-Bench 與 XD-Violence 上進行，以 Qwen2.5-VL-7B 與 Qwen3-VL-8B 為骨幹，在多標籤 Jaccard、Micro-F1、Macro-F1 與二元 F1 上均優於大型通用 VLM、影片推理模型與專門的 guardrail 模型；SafeWatch-Bench-Real 的 Jaccard 由 40.66 提升至 75.44。控制實驗顯示 G-ATR 可單調地推移精確率與召回率，C-ATR 則能針對特定類別（如錯假訊息偏精確、極端內容偏召回）調整。限制在於類別邊界依文化與法規而異、目標比值需逐案調校，且未提供誤差棒與多次訓練的統計顯著性。此工作對內容審核管線的部署具實務意義。

primary_link.title: Managing Context and Communication in Distributed Agentic UAV Swarms

radar.summary: Unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) swarms increasingly rely on language-model agents to provide adaptive mission-level reasoning in uncertain environments. Fully distributed control, in which each UAV hosts an independent Small Language Model (SLM), removes reliance on a centralized coordinator but introduces an information-management problem: long-running interaction histories can degrade the reasoning context, while indiscriminate information dissemination increases communication and inference over
radar.summary_zh: 這篇論文探討全分散式無人機（UAV）蜂群控制中的資訊管理問題。作者指出，若讓每台無人機各自搭載一個獨立的 SLM（小型語言模型）代理，雖可去除對集中式協調者的依賴，卻會帶來兩項難題：長時間累積的互動歷史會使推理上下文劣化（即所謂 context rot），而無差別地散布資訊則會增加通訊與推論負擔。方法上，作者提出一套事件驅動的 reason–act–observe 生命週期架構，將執行期知識表示為具結構化的「原子筆記」，並區分為核心記憶、本地筆記佇列與依鄰居區分的筆記佇列，佇列皆以 token 預算上限控制成長。資訊散布則由「興趣感知 gossip 引擎」負責：對每個一跳鄰居，以語意新穎度與時間衰減遞減性做確定性評估，再依門檻決定丟棄、壓縮或完整轉送，避免為每則訊息、每個鄰居額外呼叫 SLM。實驗以 10 台 UAV 在模擬搜救任務中比較三種策略，涵蓋 5、10、20 名移動生還者。結果顯示，所提方法在全部 20 次重複中皆完成任務，而無限制 flooding 僅完成 70–85%，把轉送決策交給 SLM 的策略則在所有情境皆無法完成任務，且多在初始同步階段即失敗。相較於 flooding，所提方法約可將推論 token 消耗減半，傳輸資料由每趟約 6–7 MB 降至 0.5 MB 以下，生還者計數誤差亦較低。限制在於：實驗為模擬環境、單一任務型態、固定門檻需離線校準，且人物辨識與分割假設由外部電腦視覺模型處理。此工作的重要性在於指出代理式蜂群控制若要可行，結構化記憶與選擇性散布是關鍵，而非一味增加模型推論或無限制共享資訊。
radar.title: Managing Context and Communication in Distributed Agentic UAV Swarms
radar.title_zh: 分散式代理式無人機蜂群的上下文與通訊管理

Table 3 (§6.1): backbone LoRA ablation - at 0.9B unfreezing improves media modalities +1.10 to +5.66 but drops text -3.13; at 2.3B it degrades all modalities
Table 2 (§5.1/§6.2): dense vs. original captions yield +7.01 mean across speech/audio/image/video on the 0.9B ablation checkpoint
Fig. 6 / §6.3: combined text+media mining beats no mining by ~+2.6 mean; visual documents insensitive within 0.6 nDCG@10 (46.42-46.98)
Table 12 (§6.3): three-seed stability on 10-epoch no-mining config, text 49.57 identical by construction; visual-doc SD 1.76
§C.1: identifier-level train/test overlap audit for MSR-VTT, ActivityNet, MSCOCO finds zero shared items
Limitations: no factuality filtering of captions, no controlled caption-perturbation study, single captioner bias risk, English-only benchmark coverage
llm_evaluation.rationale: Omni-modal embedding/retrieval work anchored to frozen LLM backbones (Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B, Qwen3-VL-Embedding-2B): relevant to LLM, multimodal, and dense-retrieval/RAG topics but not core language/reasoning/agent research. The contribution is an engineering composition (dense-caption self-distillation through a shared frozen backbone, Matryoshka SigLIP, online hybrid mining, phased LoRA) which the authors themselves state is not a new alignment primitive (§1). Rigor is solid: ablations for frozen vs. LoRA backbone (Table 3), dense vs. original captions (Table 2), mining configurations (Fig. 6), three-seed sensitivity (Table 12), train/test overlap audit (§C.1), per-task results across 4 benchmarks. Evidence is quantitative but the headline text score is invariant by construction (§6.1), ablation checkpoints differ from released ones, and only English benchmarks and a single checkpoint per variant are used. Generalizability limited by English-only evaluation, machine-generated caption supervision, small training corpus (227k rows, §4), and no any-to-any cross-modal benchmark. Reproducibility supported by claimed release of models/code/data/harness plus full hyperparameters (Table 14) and caption prompts (§B), though the project page is unverifiable here.

primary_link.title: Omni-Embed-Mini: Binding Modalities Without Forgetting via Dense Distillation

radar.summary: Extending a text embedding model to new modalities typically degrades text retrieval quality, and existing omni-modal embedders compensate with multi-billion parameters. We present Omni-Embed-Mini, a 0.9B-parameter model that maps text, speech, audio, images, video, and visually-rich documents into a single shared cosine space without updating any text-side parameter. Our key insight is that the teacher signal requires no separate embedding model: each media sample is paired with a dense cascade
radar.summary_zh: 這篇論文處理「多模態擴張困境」：把文字嵌入模型延伸到新模態時，通常會造成文字檢索品質下降（災難性遺忘），而現有全模態嵌入器多以數十億參數來補償。作者的關鍵洞見是讓文字分支完全不動，成為「不可移動的錨點」：每個媒體樣本搭配一段稠密串接式caption，教師目標就是同一個凍結骨幹對該caption的EOS池化嵌入，因此教師與學生共享位元相同的權重與幾何空間，不需額外投影頭，也不需獨立的嵌入教師模型。方法結合Matryoshka SigLIP對比損失、線上混合式難負例挖掘，以及先訓練投影器、再於20%步數後注入encoder LoRA的分階段策略。主要結果：0.9B版本在MTEB-v2 BEIR-8維持49.57 nDCG@10，文字權重與骨幹逐位元相同，訓練在數學上不可能使文字檢索退步，同時涵蓋語音、音訊、圖像、影片與視覺豐富文件共五種新模態，並比所有比較的開放全模態嵌入器小約2.7至9.5倍；2.3B版本改用原生視覺語言骨幹，整體模態平均51.39，勝過封閉的gemini-embedding-2的49.51。消融顯示稠密caption是資料側最關鍵成分（影片+14.06），骨幹解凍在0.9B會以文字-3.13換取媒體提升、在2.3B則全面變差。限制在於caption由模型生成且未做事實性過濾，語音與音訊仍是最弱模態，影片受限於8幀平均池化協議，且目前缺乏統一的任意對任意跨模態檢索基準。

links.title: When Do Intrinsic Rewards Lead to Exploration?

evidence: Section 2.2, Eq. (1)–(2): deficiency-based finitary process preorder defined and used to compare policies

Section 3 and Table 1: exact optima of pseudo-count, Shannon/Square prediction, empowerment, MOP, state-visitation entropy, DIAYN shown Pareto-suboptimal with stated deficiencies (e.g. 1/2, 1/3, [1/4,1/2])
Theorem 4.1 / Proposition B.3 (Section 4, Appendix B.3): strict monotonicity of convex posterior-score gains on finite full-support world classes
Theorem 5.1 (Section 5, Appendix B.1): countable rich target family and bounded strictly monotone native score J_w
Section 6, Table 2: native mean beats Brier on 4-step audit in 18/22 classes but the reward-matched control comparison gives 6 wins, 1 tie, 15 losses
Section 7 and Appendix K.6: earlier 16-target benchmark failed its prespecified screen (0 wins, 5 ties, 5 losses vs Brier)
Reproducibility statement: companion code/data artifact with response laws, seeds, numerical certificates, Lean proof sources
llm_evaluation.rationale: Reinforcement-learning exploration theory (intrinsic rewards, policies, exploration/exploitation) with no LLM, NLP, or Japanese content, so preference relevance is low despite genuine overlap with the RL category. Quality is high: a formal finitary process preorder built on Blackwell/Le Cam deficiency, stated theorems (4.1, 5.1, B.1–B.5, C.1, D.1, I.1) with proofs, explicit counterexamples for count-based, prediction-error, empowerment, MOP, state-entropy, DIAYN, Hellinger/Absolute and compression objectives, plus positive guarantees under finite/compact world classes. Claims are carefully scoped: the paper itself reports a prior 16-target benchmark failing its prespecified screen (Section 7, Appendix K.6) and disclaims universal empirical superiority. The finite planning study (Section 6, Appendix K) is modest (22 synthetic world classes, exact planning, no training) and post-hoc designed, limiting generalizability to practical LLM/agent settings. Reproducibility is strong: companion artifact with response laws, seeds, numerical certificates, Lean proofs (Reproducibility statement, Appendix K.6).

primary_link.title: When Do Intrinsic Rewards Lead to Exploration?

radar.summary: Intrinsic rewards are designed to guide exploration in reinforcement learning by assigning value to an agent's experience, for example through prediction error or learning progress. However, maximizing these rewards need not produce the most informative experience available. We propose a formal criterion for exploration that compares policies by the counterfactual information they acquire: how well their histories can substitute for experience under alternative policies. We construct a single, s
radar.summary_zh: 本文追問一個根本問題：最大化內在獎勵是否真能取得最具資訊價值的經驗。作者以統計實驗比較理論（Blackwell 支配、Le Cam deficiency）為基礎，提出「有限歷程前序」：若某策略蒐集的歷史，經隨機解碼後可重現另一策略的歷史分布，則前者支配後者；無法被反向重現者即為嚴格受支配。他們設計一個簡單的警報環境，證明計數式 pseudo-count、預測誤差（Shannon、Square）、empowerment、MOP、狀態造訪熵、DIAYN 等目標的極大化策略，在取得反事實資訊上皆為 Pareto 次優，且部分極大化策略可被完全探索策略嚴格支配。作者進一步證明：在有限世界類別且先驗全支撐下，累積資訊量、Brier 等連續嚴格凸後驗分數具嚴格單調性；並對任意世界類別建構一組可數的 native 目標，定義有界分數 J_w，保證每個嚴格探索改進都會被獎勵。限制包括：完整探索未必可行、此分數無通用可計算評估器、後續的 22 類有限規劃實驗亦未證實普遍優越性。
radar.title: When Do Intrinsic Rewards Lead to Exploration?
radar.title_zh: 內在獎勵何時能帶來探索？

links.title: Continual Reinforcement Learning with Neuroevolution

evidence: Section 4 'Evaluation metrics'/'Environments and task sequences': 6 environments (CartPole, Acrobot, MountainCar, DeepSea, MiniGrid, Brax HalfCheetah, Kinetix), 20-task and two-task settings, 10 trials with 95% bootstrap CIs and Mann-Whitney U with Holm correction
Section 5: ES circled as best LA-F in 8 of 18 settings, no RL method in any; GA highest learning accuracy in 10 of 18 settings; ES highest zero-shot transfer in 10 of 14 settings
Section 5 'ES sits in the widest neighborhood...': shared neighborhood correlates with LA-F; Appendix H.5 reports Spearman rho 0.75-0.77 across radii and permutation test p=5e-5
Section 5 / Figure 5: GA+Novty re-finds DeepSea action map after 57% of switches vs 11% for GA; Appendix C.3 extends to 7 settings with Mann-Whitney U p<0.05

Relevance to LLM/NLP preferences is low (pure RL/neuroevolution; LLM fine-tuning only cited), so weighted preference fit is modest despite good research quality.

primary_link.title: Continual Reinforcement Learning with Neuroevolution

radar.summary: Despite many studies about causes and remedies of plasticity loss in Reinforcement Learning (RL) under continual task changes, no RL method has yet consistently achieved a good balance between adaptation and forgetting. Here we turn to an alternative optimization paradigm, neuroevolution (NE): algorithms that search directly in weight space through mutation and selection over a population of neural networks. Across a wide array of environments and environmental changes, with policies ranging fro
radar.summary_zh: 這篇論文探討持續增強學習（continual RL）中長久未解的問題：當任務持續變動時，RL 方法難以在「保留舊技能」（穩定性）與「習得新技能」（可塑性）之間取得平衡。作者改採神經演化（neuroevolution, NE）這條替代路線，直接以突變與選擇在權重空間中搜尋，並在涵蓋數百到百萬參數策略的多種環境與變動型態下，將演化策略（ES）與遺傳演算法（GA）和 PPO、三種持續 RL 變體（TRAC-PPO、ReDo-PPO、C-CHAIN）以及族群式 RL（PBT-PPO）相比。結果顯示 GA 最具可塑性，而 ES 最穩定地取得良好的權衡；ES 找到最寬的「鄰域」，且相鄰任務鄰域的重疊程度可預測各方法的權衡表現。以 novelty search 獎勵行為多樣性可讓族群更可塑性，但代價是遺忘更多。此外，RL 中常見的可塑性流失徵狀（休眠神經元累積、權重漂移）並未出現在 NE，暗示這些現象源自梯度式最佳化而非非平穩性本身。限制在於 NE 樣本效率較低，且在解需精細微調的任務（如 HalfCheetah）上不及 RL。此研究把參數空間探索定位為平衡穩定性與可塑性的機制，對持續學習具啟發意義。
radar.title: Continual Reinforcement Learning with Neuroevolution
radar.title_zh: 以神經演化進行持續增強學習

links.title: Prune First, Decide Fast: Scalable Semantic Query Processing with JEVDB

evidence: Abstract: claims 72x-89x SemBench latency speedups, up to 18.7x cost reduction, 95.7%-97.5% F1 on Shelob with 87.4% pruning
Section 4.1: JEVDB-Flash uses jev-1.13.0 at fixed 0.5 threshold; SemBench baseline numbers are published Gemini 2.5 Flash results while Shelob baselines run gpt-6-luna — model comparability confound
Section 4.1: JEVDB-Flash executes each SemBench query once with 20 workers while baselines are means of five runs
Section 3.2.1: SBF defined with one-sided lossless probe contract; accuracy depends on soundness of registered necessary conditions and extractors
Section 4.3/Table 4: all 15 Shelob runs complete for JEVDB; only 14 of 45 baseline runs finish within 1200s; no baseline completes at M tier
Section 4.1: source code and benchmarks are 'previewed' at jevdb.org; core Jev model is a proprietary TypeSafe AI backend
Section 4.3: condition index built over 20,558 documents at 15s and $0.54, excluded from per-query costs
Section 3.3.3: tier escalation thresholds calibrated on ~400 items per predicate against an LLM judge with eps=0.05 recall/precision tolerances
llm_evaluation.rationale: A database-systems paper centered on LLM inference cost/latency for semantic SQL operators, mapping filters/joins/classification/ranking to non-generative typed decision primitives with Yannakakis semijoin reduction and Semantic Bloom Filters. Moderate preference fit: LLM inference, efficiency, and serving dominate, but there is no core LLM methodology (training, alignment, reasoning, prompting science). Novelty is real (SBF contract, typed operator mapping, three-tier escalation) though built on existing join-reduction and cascade ideas. Rigor is weakened by clear model confounds (JEVDB runs Jev/gpt-6-luna vs baselines on Gemini 2.5 Flash or gpt-6-luna), single-run SemBench numbers vs five-run baseline means, and no ablation isolating SBF vs Yannakakis vs escalation contributions. Evidence is quantitatively rich but partly undermined by these protocol asymmetries. Reproducibility hinges on a proprietary decision model and a website 'preview' code claim.

primary_link.title: Prune First, Decide Fast: Scalable Semantic Query Processing with JEVDB

radar.summary: Semantic database systems extend SQL with foundation-model inference over unstructured data, but current engines rely heavily on autoregressive LLMs for discrete relational decisions, creating high latency and monetary cost. We present JEVDB, a scalable semantic database system that uses fast, typed decision models for semantic filters, joins, classification, and ranking, while selectively escalating uncertain cases to generative LLMs. To reduce semantic-join work, JEVDB combines exact Yannakaki
radar.summary_zh: 語意資料庫以基礎模型推論擴充標準 SQL，讓使用者能對非結構化文本宣告式查詢，但自迴歸 LLM 的延遲與費用比傳統關聯運算子高出數個數量級；提示批次、模型串接與嵌入代理模型等既有緩解手段，都未觸及核心病灶。作者指出問題根源是「生成式阻抗失配」：語意查詢引擎竟用生成式文本解碼器去評估非生成、離散的關聯述詞（布林、列舉、分數）。本文提出 JEVDB，將語意運算子直接映射到單次前向傳遞的型別化決策原語 Noul、Choice、Score，免除自迴歸解碼與語法解析，並在關聯結構上做 Yannakakis 式半連結縮減、於潛在語意邊界以語意 Bloom 濾網（SBF）保守篩選，再用三層執行階層僅將不確定案例升級至前沿 LLM。在 SemBench 上，JEVDB-Flash 21 題全部最快、19 題最省，整體延遲約快 72 至 89 倍、成本最多降 18.7 倍，14 題品質最佳或並列最佳。在 TPC-DS 衍生的 Shelob 上，候選對最多 54 萬、基線全數逾時，JEVDB 仍完成全部查詢，平均 F1 達 95.7% 至 97.5%，推論前即剪除 87.4% 候選。限制在於 SBF 條件若僅經驗驗證則非無損、圖索引有一次性成本、無法處理多模態輸入，且未與生成式引擎做同等品質下的全面對照。此工作的重要性在於把資料庫最佳化與非生成式決策模型結合，為語意查詢的可擴展性提供架構層級的解方。

primary_link.title: Typological Alignment of Stack-Based Language Models on Mildly Context-Sensitive Artificial Languages

Such typological commonality is often attributed to learning biases. Computational simulations, recently with language models (LMs), have facilitated the exploration of this theory. In this paper, we extend existing analyses of the relationship between LMs' learning biases and typological commonality on both data and model sides, focusi
radar.summary_zh: 這篇論文延伸語言模型（LM）學習偏誤與語言類型學共通性之間關係的研究，聚焦兩個過去較少觸及的面向：跨序列依存（cross-serial dependency, CSD）——自然語言句法複雜度的上限，以及具備堆疊記憶的語言模型（stack-based LM, SLM）。作者以廣義範疇文法（GCG）為基礎，建構 32 種僅在語序參數上不同的人造語言，並新增與格標記、使役動詞、賓語與與格關係子句等類別，設計出 Rel、Conj-1、Conj-2、Nested 等針對 CSD 的泛化測試集。模型方面比較 RNN、LSTM、Transformer 三種基底架構，分別搭配無堆疊、疊加式堆疊（SUP）與非確定性堆疊（ND），共六種 SLM 變體，並以困惑度（PPL）與 WALS 語序頻率計算 Spearman 相關，另以迴歸模型檢驗架構與堆疊的交互作用。結果顯示，理論上表達力最強的非確定性堆疊在更貼近真實語言的人造語言上並未帶來明顯泛化優勢；反倒是工作記憶受限的 RNN 搭配疊加式堆疊在所有測試集上穩定優於基底模型，且其學習偏誤與實際語序分布最為對齊。迴歸分析中，語序頻率與疊加式堆疊的交互項具顯著負係數，支持疊加式堆疊能強化模型的類型學對齊偏誤。作者以「少即是多」假說解讀，認為有限的認知資源可作為正則化，引導模型收斂到更符合自然語言傾向的語序。限制在於資料全為人造、排除詞彙與結構歧義，非確定性堆疊的訓練不穩定與變異數偏高也尚未釐清，且結論主要來自實證評估，仍待理論層面的補強。此研究對以 LM 模擬語言習得偏誤、以及堆疊架構是否真能帶來階層泛化，提供了審慎的實證參照。

llm_evaluation.rationale: LVLM-based chain-of-thought prompting (CoADTP) for video anomaly detection with temporal rationale propagation and a parameter-free cross-modal re-ranking stage; strong relevance to CoT/reasoning and LLM prompting methodology, though the application domain (surveillance VAD) is narrower than the core preferences. Methodological novelty is a sensible but incremental composition of CoT prompting + retrieval re-ranking. Rigor is decent (prompt-sensitivity study, component ablations in Table 9, backbone ablation Table 10, parameter ablations Table 8, controlled error-propagation study Appendix E), but the authors re-annotate the test sets themselves and then emphasize gains under their own labels, a 350-ID subset is used for BERTScore, some CoADTP rows regress (e.g., Video-R1 clip BLEU 0.572 to 0.439 in Table 4), and headline 'semantically faithful' claims exceed what BERTScore establishes. primary_link.title: Cog-VADU: A Training-Free Cognitive Reasoning Framework for Video Anomaly Detection and Understanding

radar.summary: Video Anomaly Detection (VAD) aims to temporally localize abnormal events in videos. Most existing approaches rely on dataset-specific training and curated annotations, limiting generalization in open-set scenarios. Recent zero-shot methods based on Large Vision- Language Models (LVLMs) alleviate this dependency but often lack temporal continuity and structured reasoning. We propose Cog-VADU, a fully training-free framework that reformulates VAD as a sequential cognitive reasoning task. Cog-VADU
radar.summary_zh: 此研究針對影片異常偵測（VAD）長期依賴資料集專屬訓練與人工標註、難以泛化至開放場域的問題，提出 Cog-VADU：一套完全免訓練（training-free）的認知推理框架，將 VAD 重新表述為跨影片片段的序列式推理任務。方法以冷凍的大型視覺語言模型（LVLM）為基礎，核心為「異常偵測思維鏈提示」（CoADTP），引導模型依序進行場景觀察、描述、推理與嚴重度評估、類別判定與評分，並把前一片段的結構化理由與分數回饋至下一片段，形成隱式時序記憶；另設計跨模態重排序階段，用 ImageBind 嵌入空間中的 FAISS 檢索，結合全域語意對齊與時序加權的視覺相似度，以 softmax 加權聚合修正原始分數。實驗在 UCF-Crime、XD-Violence、VANE-Bench 與 HIVAU-70k 上進行，於 XD-Violence 達 90.15% AUC，優於免訓練的 LAVAD；作者亦指出原標註存在「觸發偏誤」，僅標註因果鏈的起始事件，故重新標註兩個資料集（異常幀分別增加 39.1% 與 22.5%）。限制在於多步推理增加推論成本，且類別詞彙不完整時會出現可診斷的標籤退化，需人工監督查核。

evidence: Abstract/Section 4.1: LoopCD-Logits raises Ouro-2.6B-Thinking AIME 2024 pass@1 61.88% -> 73.33%; LoopCD-Hidden raises Huginn HumanEval pass@1 22.56% -> 31.71% (Table 1, Table 3(b)).
Section 4.3 and Table A9 (Appendix D.2): half-depth guided runs use 0.52-0.78 of full-pass forward FLOPs, i.e., 22.5%-48.2% FLOP reduction across six settings.
Table 2 (Section 4.2): all four model families improve seven-benchmark multiple-choice mean under LoopCD-Logits (+0.29 to +1.59).
Section 5.2, Figure 8(c) and Table A12 (Appendix F.1): gains concentrate on the least confident fifth (+6.4 to +13.3 points) with only 5.8%-14.9% of answers flipped.
Appendix B.1: paired comparisons share checkpoint, prompt, shot count, stopping rule, and evaluator; recurrent depths matched.
Table A5 (Appendix C.1): GSM8K results are mixed (declines up to -1.29 on Huginn R=32), disclosed against the stronger claims in the abstract.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Highly relevant to LLMs, transformer/looped architectures, reasoning (AIME, HumanEval), inference efficiency and contrastive decoding. LoopCD's core idea — reusing looped-recurrence intermediate states as the weak reference for contrastive decoding, training-free — is a genuinely novel twist on contrastive decoding/autoguidance. Rigor is strong: four model families (Ouro, Huginn, Parcae, Looped-Qwen3), matched paired baselines (same checkpoint/prompt/depth, Appendix B.1), multiple benchmarks, both fixed and adaptive guidance, plus mechanism analyses (weak-to-strong trajectory, orthogonal re-ranking decomposition, confidence-fifth stratification) and honest negative results (GSM8K mixed in Table A5; Looped-Qwen3 pass@1 drops in Table A6). Limitations are partly acknowledged (narrow strength window for generation, coda-depth dependence of hidden form, FLOPs ≠ wall-clock). Evidence is quantitative and traceable to tables/figures. However, results are confined to looped/recurrent transformer families (not standard dense LLMs), and no code release or exact seeds is stated, only hyperparameters and protocols (Tables A2-A4, A8), limiting reproducibility. Some abstract/conclusion phrasing (e.g., 'consistent gains', 'every... suite mean') slightly overstates mixed rows disclosed in appendices.

primary_link.title: Decoding Looped Transformers Better for (Almost) Free

top5.summary: Looped Transformers achieve parameter efficiency by repeatedly executing a shared block across recurrent loops. Each loop yields an intermediate representation decodable for the same next token, yet standard decoding discards earlier states. Because earlier loops embody less computation, recurrence inherently supplies aligned weak-and-strong prediction pairs without auxiliary models or external training. We introduce LoopCD, a training-free contrastive decoding framework that guides token select
top5.summary_zh: 循環式 Transformer（looped Transformer）以共用區塊反覆迭代來換取參數效率，但標準解碼只採用最後一次迭代的狀態，前面幾輪所產生的中間表徵全被丟棄。這篇論文指出：由於每一輪都在同一表徵空間中增加計算，遞迴軌跡本身就自然產生「對齊的弱預測與強預測配對」，不需輔助模型或額外訓練。作者提出 LoopCD，一種免訓練的對比解碼框架，用早期遞迴狀態引導最終預測：LoopCD-Logits 在 logit 空間對比，需多一次輸出前向；LoopCD-Hidden 則在隱藏狀態空間先融合再輸出，幾乎零額外成本。在 Ouro、Huginn、Parcae、Looped-Qwen3 四個家族上，LoopCD 於完整深度皆帶來一致增益，例如 Ouro-2.6B-Thinking 的 AIME 2024 pass@1 由 61.88% 提升至 73.33%，Huginn 的 HumanEval pass@1 由 22.56% 升至 31.71%。更關鍵的是，這些增益讓遞迴圈數可減半，仍能匹配或超越未引導的完整深度基線，前向 FLOPs 可省下 22.5% 至 48.2%。分析顯示增益主要來自對「接近的決策」重新排序，且集中在模型最不確定的題目上；限制在於生成任務對引導強度較敏感、需較小值以免誤差累積，且 Huginn 因雜訊初始化需避開早期隱藏狀態。

links.title: Counting Moves, Weighing Voices: Bayesian Dialectical Argumentation for Calibrated Multi-LLM Councils under Persistent Adversaries

evidence: Abstract/Section 1: claims best calibration among zero-cost council aggregation methods and robustness under persistent adversarial coalitions, with ECE and accuracy figures

Section 3, Eqs. (1)-(4) and Prop. 1: closed-form posterior over typed-move endorsements; log-odds weighted majority with negative weights for sub-chance agents; confusion-matrix generalization as tempered composite likelihood
Section 4, Properties 1-5: scoped calibration, K=2 ceiling/collapse artifacts, confidence invariance, prior sensitivity, identifiability conditions
Section 5: datasets (MedClaim/StrategyClaim/TruthfulClaim n=500, PubMedQA n=300, MMLU n=500), 3 seeds, 4,500 binary trials, baselines, nested leak-free CV on Brier

Section 6, Tables 1-2: clean binary BDA per-agent ECE_ew 0.016 vs majority 0.160, accuracy +1.7 pts (95% CI [+0.010,+0.024]); 'What BDA does not win' admits recalibrated ArgLLMs leads Brier/accuracy at cost

Section 7 and Appendix F: dose-response (per-agent rises to 0.923 at p_wrong=1 vs majority 0.163), live coalition with 87-100% anti-correct compliance, permutation control, sleeper axis, policy-shift, row-drift monitoring, contagion tables
Appendix D: four documented evaluation pitfalls fixed, single results_v5.json with independent verifier, cost ledger (~$220), verbatim prompts in Appendix I
Appendix H: small sub-8B council transfer and heterogeneity boundary (near-chance reliabilities remove accuracy edge while calibration fix persists)
llm_evaluation.rationale: Highly relevant to LLM multi-agent councils, adversarial robustness/safety, evaluation, and aggregation of deliberation. BDA reframes typed deliberation moves as Dawid-Skene-style annotator observations with per-agent reliabilities yielding calibrated posteriors and negative (inverting) weights for sub-chance agents. The work combines formal results (Prop. 1/2 weighted-majority equivalence with inversion; Props. 1-5 incl. K=2 ceiling and K>2 dissolution, confidence invariance, prior sensitivity, identifiability scope), clean and adversarial evaluations on five datasets with 4,500-trial binary pool plus PubMedQA/MMLU, and a broad baseline set (plurality, MoA/Self-MoA, ArgLLMs, logistic stacking, gated vote, unsupervised DS-EM). Notably, it reports findings against itself (recalibrated ArgLLMs beats BDA on clean Brier; isotonic recalibration erases the calibration edge; positional K>2 stacking wins), includes ablations (granularity, estimator, rounds, temperature vs confusion matrix), threat-model sweeps (dose-response, live stealth coalition, rotation, sleeper, policy shift), and per-arm fair role-matched attacks. Reproducibility is exceptional: single verified numbers file, drift guard, verbatim prompts, cost ledger (~$220, $0/task aggregation), cached traces. Limitations (supervision requirement, persistence/identifiability assumptions, composite-likelihood approximation at K>2 with challenges, untested abstention) are explicitly stated. Generalizability is somewhat limited to 3-seat councils over fixed candidate sets with labeled calibration, though the formulation is argued to extend to broader multi-agent decision processes.

primary_link.title: Counting Moves, Weighing Voices: Bayesian Dialectical Argumentation for Calibrated Multi-LLM Councils under Persistent Adversaries

top5.summary: A multi-LLM \emph{council} lets several large language models (LLMs) deliberate on a question and return an answer together with a confidence estimate. As these systems become increasingly used for reasoning, that confidence should represent a calibrated \emph{probability of being correct}, and the decision should remain robust when some agents are persistently unreliable. Existing \emph{council aggregation} methods fail on both fronts: their confidence estimates measure decisiveness rather than
top5.summary_zh: 多個大型語言模型組成的「議會」會共同審議問題並給出答案與信心值，但既有聚合方法有兩大缺陷：信心值衡量的是「果決程度」而非「答對機率」，且無法辨識並折損持續不可靠的成員。本文提出貝氏辯證論證法（BDA），把議會中帶型別的動作（誰提議、質疑、讓步）視為古典標註者模型的觀測，為每個成員配一個潛在可靠度，並以標記校準資料擬合共軛先驗；後驗有閉式解、不需額外呼叫模型。理論上，最可能答案等價於對數勝算加權多數決，可靠度低於隨機的席位會取得負權重，其背書反而成為反向證據，且在 K=2 時具貝氏最優性。實驗涵蓋三組二元查核資料集（4,500 次試驗）、PubMedQA 與 MMLU，BDA 在零成本聚合方法中取得最佳校準（ECE 0.016），並比多數決提升約 1.7 個百分點準確率；在持續對抗聯盟下，混淆矩陣版本於二元與 PubMedQA 領先，且攻擊下準確率可高於乾淨情境。限制包括：需要約 25 個標記、對抗者須在校準窗內且持續為惡、輪替式與中等劑量輪替攻擊會破壞可辨識性、對抗者若為「潛伏者」則會被誤信。

Section A.12 and Table 21: oracle hill-climbing flagged in 4.4% of runs; excluding them barely changes pooled gap_closed (0.923 to 0.922)
Section 5 and Fig. 4: reference-based verification rises only 19% to 22% across prompted levels, but roughly triples with the oracle tool
Table 4 and Reproducibility statement: benchmark, 18,240 trajectories, and derived analyses released with code at the stated GitHub URL
Limitations: only four tasks across two scientific domains; system-level verification claim demonstrated on one behavioral dimension only
llm_evaluation.rationale: Directly on-topic for LLM agent evaluation: studies agentic coding systems operating specialist models via a full factorial sweep over five configuration axes (information, reasoning, verification, budget, backbone). Rigor is strong: 432 cells x 5 runs per task (8,640 main runs plus ablations totaling 18,240 trajectories), variance decomposition with a two-part hurdle model, bootstrap rank stability, partial eta-squared linear models, matched-configuration checks for selection effects, and margin sensitivity analyses. Ablations cover model family, open- vs closed-weight, and a system-level oracle tool, with hill-climbing contamination checked and quantified. Claims are quantitative and mostly qualified (e.g., acknowledging selection effects in the budget drop). Generalizability is the main weakness: four tasks in two domains, and the headline claim about system- vs prompt-level behavior is demonstrated only on verification, as stated in the Limitations. Reproducibility is good via released benchmark and trajectories. Novelty is solid but incremental relative to prior agent-evaluation work (Kapoor, Rabanser), which the authors acknowledge.

primary_link.title: Agents Are Systems, Not Models: Rethinking Agentic Evaluation

top5.summary: Agent evaluations increasingly go beyond a single success rate, reporting metrics such as cost, consistency, and robustness. Yet they typically treat the agent itself as fixed. In practice, an agent is a configurable system: users decide what to tell it, how long to let it run, and which model to use, and each of these choices can change how well and how consistently it performs. We study these choices on a new benchmark of four scientific tasks, where a coding agent must find and correctly oper
top5.summary_zh: 這篇論文主張，代理（agent）不應被視為固定的模型，而是一個可配置的系統，由骨幹模型與執行迴圈（harness）組成。作者在四個橫跨天文物理與基因體學的科學任務上，建立一個 AI4S 基準，要求代理自行尋找並正確操作已發表的專門模型，並系統性變化五個配置軸：任務資訊、推理、自我驗證、時間預算與骨幹模型。主實驗涵蓋每任務 432 個配置、每格重複 5 次，共 8,640 次執行，並釋出超過 18,000 條軌跡。主要發現有四：其一，結果高度嘈雜，在真實嘗試中約 54% 的分數變異來自同一配置的重複執行，而非配置差異，單次執行分數並不可靠；其二，提供給代理的資訊影響最大，勝過骨幹模型與時間預算，同時降低成本與執行時間並改善校準；其三，各軸彼此交互作用，增加預算只在資訊充足或模型夠強時才提升分數，否則可能反而下降；其四，某些行為如自我驗證幾乎無法透過提示改變，但系統層級提供的驗證工具能使參考式驗證比例增加約三倍。作者亦發現代理極少拒絕較弱的專門模型，在 gap_negative 任務中有 99.8% 的執行仍使用該模型。限制在於僅涵蓋四個任務、兩個領域，且系統層級設計的結論只在驗證一個維度上獲得驗證。此研究的重要性在於呼籲將完成率、變異、成本與校準一併納入代理評估，並以系統設計而非單純提示來形塑代理行為。

links.title: Old Ideas, Novel Problems: The Instability of LLM-Based Novelty Evaluation

evidence: Abstract & Section 5: small prompt changes (e.g., P3 vs P4) swing pairwise verdicts on >50% of identical pairs, shifting strict accuracy by 52.6 points for gpt-5.4 on Human+Generated
Table 1 (Section 3.2): benchmark statistics — 154 validated novel ICLR ideas (D+), 145 lower-novelty ICLR / 154 LLM-generated (D-)
Section 4.4 & Appendix C.1: two-sided paired non-parametric bootstrap with 100,000 resamples, BCa 95% CIs for all reported changes
Section 5.1 & Figure 5: strong agentic RAG judge (gpt-5.6-sol, xhigh reasoning, unlimited web search) reaches 0.78 macro-F1, 11 points behind claude-opus-4-6 with a simple five-abstract pipeline
Section 5.2 & Table 5 (Appendix B.3): cheapest prompted configuration outperforms both dedicated novelty judges by 8-29 macro-F1 points at up to 32x lower cost
Appendix A.3: one expert blind-validated 30 Human+Generated pairs (28 judge-error cases), agreeing with labels on all 30 over ~5 hours
Appendix C.2, Table 6: tie rates roughly double on Human+Generated vs Human-Only for several judges, up to 57.8% for claude-sonnet-4-5
Appendix A/B: full extraction, generation, judge, and retrieval prompts released; Project Page, Code, and Data links given in the header
llm_evaluation.rationale: Directly addresses LLM-as-judge evaluation of research idea novelty, a core LLM/evaluation topic relevant to automated ideation and agent pipelines. Provides the first systematic controlled study of novelty-judge design choices across six judge backbones, pointwise/pairwise protocols, prompt variants, retrieval, reasoning budget, idea format, and generator source, with BCa bootstrap significance testing (Appendix C.1) and detailed quantitative tables (Table 5, Table 6). Novel contributions include an automated review-mining label pipeline and the finding that minor prompt edits shift pairwise accuracy by >50 points. Rigor is strong but not flawless: the Human+Generated setup rests on a weak-labeling assumption sanity-checked by only one expert on 30 pairs (Appendix A.3), the human pools come from a single venue (ICLR 2026) with ~154 ideas per side, and the qualitative retrieval analysis covers 10 cases (Appendix C.3). Generalizability is good for LLM-judge robustness broadly, though the specific benchmark is scientific-novelty domain-bound. Full prompts, code, and data release (Appendix A/B) support reproducibility, though proprietary judge models limit exact reruns.

primary_link.title: Old Ideas, Novel Problems: The Instability of LLM-Based Novelty Evaluation

top5.summary:
Automated ideation systems are often evaluated on the novelty of the ideas they produce, and that judgment is increasingly delegated to large language models. Such judges are typically built ad hoc and validated, if at all, on human-authored papers rather than on the generated ideas they are meant to score. So, how do novelty judges perform?
  Not well. We present a systematic controlled study of novelty evaluation design choices. We first build an evaluation set automatically, mining OpenReview
top5.summary_zh: 這篇論文系統性檢視「用大型語言模型（LLM）當評審來判斷研究想法新穎性」這件事到底可不可靠。作者指出，自動化構想系統常以新穎性作為核心評估指標，但實務上每個系統都自製臨時評審，驗證資料多半是人寫論文，而非評審真正要打分的人工智慧生成想法，彼此之間也缺乏統一基準。為了做受控實驗，他們設計一條自動化資料管線：從 OpenReview 的 ICLR 2026 同儕審查文字中，用 LLM 擷取評審明確肯定或否定原創性的片段，只保留多數評審一致、且落在其領域前段或後段的投稿，再搭配一個刻意不先進的生成模型所產出的想法，構成 Human-Only 與 Human+Generated 兩套基準，可重跑於未來會議。實驗橫跨六個評審骨幹、逐點與成對判斷、提示措辭、檢索、推理預算、想法格式等單一設計變項。結果顯示評審極為脆弱：僅僅告訴評審「有人認為其中一個想法新穎」就能翻轉超過一半相同配對的判決，成對準確率擺盪超過 50 分，甚至低於隨機；同一改動對某模型有幫助、對另一模型卻有害。檢索與更高的推理預算幫助有限，兩個專門打造的新穎性評估器在最便宜的基本提示設定下反而落後。限制在於弱標籤假設與單一會議資料，且部分結論依賴生成器的選擇。其意義在於：過去大量以 LLM 評審衡量 AI 生成想法新穎性的研究，其結論穩健性值得重新商榷。

links.title: The Innocent Courier: Covert Exfiltration Through Legitimate LLM Web Fetching

evidence: Sect. 4.1 and Fig. 1: LLMLeak encodes the secret in a URL inside an attacker-crafted error, and the LLM's fetch tool request (DNS/HTTP) completes exfiltration without prompt injection.
Sect. 5.2.1 and Table 2: average S_conf 79.70% across 11 open models, from 99.9% (Llama-3.3-70B) down to 30.0% (Qwen3-Coder-30B), with n=2000 per model.
Sect. 5.3 and Table 3: failure-point funnel shows drop mainly at S_call (32.2%-100.0%), with S_reach to S_data divergence <=0.4% and recovery r>=0.93 per model.
Sect. 5.4 and Tables 4-5: directive vs informational framing drops average S_conf from 79.7% to 54.6% (Delta -25.0 pp), indicating framing drives fetch initiation.

Sect. 5.5 Table 6 and Sect. 5.6 Table 7: 97.9% of reaching requests carry fully correct payloads; matched-pair ablations show framing dominates (e.g., -45.3 pp for Granite-3.3-8B) over URL structure or exception type.

Sect. 5.7-5.8 and Tables 8, 12: CJK encoding halves capacity limits but lowers S_conf to 66.0% average (Delta -13.7 pp); longer payloads degrade exact recovery with near-miss bands growing at 63 chars.
Sect. 5.9 and Table 9: of 17,528 confirmed leaks only 19 (0.1%) were flagged as warnings; judge (gpt-oss-120b) validated on all 19 flags plus 200 sampled negatives (95% precision, <2% miss rate).
Sect. 5.10 and Table 10: case study on 7 proprietary chatbots (n=280) shows susceptibility in all models, e.g., Grok 4.5 Fast 100%, ChatGPT 5.6 Sol 80-100%, Gemini Flash-Lite 0-5%.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Directly targets LLM/tool-use security: a covert exfiltration channel via legitimate web-fetching tools that bypasses prompt-injection defenses, relevant to LLM, agents/tool use, AI safety, and red-teaming/evaluation preferences. The attack idea (secrets embedded in URLs in genuine stack traces, no injected instructions) is a genuinely novel threat model distinct from prior indirect-prompt-injection exfiltration. Rigor is strong: 11 open-weight models with n=2000 trials each, a five-stage failure funnel, framing/URL/error-type ablations, payload-length and Latin/CJK encoding studies, plus LLM-judge stealth evaluation with manual validation. Limitations: the covert-channel setting requires prior client-side malware and user cooperation (paste/screenshot), the proprietary-model case study is only n=280 with high variance, stealth is partly judge-assessed, no concrete defense is implemented or evaluated, and no explicit code/data release is claimed, so reproduction is moderately difficult.

primary_link.title: The Innocent Courier: Covert Exfiltration Through Legitimate LLM Web Fetching

top5.summary: With the increasing capabilities of Large-Language-Models (LLMs) and LLM-based agents, users are increasingly using them to solve everyday problems, such as answering e-mails or providing programming support. Existing work has extensively investigated security and privacy risks, such as prompt injections and the disclosure of sensitive data to chatbot providers. While various solutions were developed to address these risks, including input structuring to prevent prompt injections or deploying lo
top5.summary_zh: 這篇論文提出 LLMLeak，一種繞過既有提示注入防禦的資料外洩手法。問題背景在於：現有的第三方洩密攻擊多半仰賴直接或間接提示注入，去操縱模型產生惡意行為，因此可被結構化輸入、指令與資料分離等防禦攔阻。作者觀察到，具備網頁抓取工具的 LLM 本身就會主動與外部伺服器通訊，這條合法路徑可被濫用為隱蔽通道。其方法為：本機惡意軟體在無法直接連網的情況下，先取得機密（例如 API key），再產生一個真實的例外與堆疊追蹤，把機密編碼進對外參照的 URL（如子網域或路徑），使用者複製該錯誤訊息去詢問 LLM，模型為了排錯而呼叫抓取工具，攻擊者控制的 DNS 或 HTTP 伺服器便由連線請求本身還原機密。由於不需要提示注入、也不依賴隱藏字元或同形異義字，攻擊可跨螢幕截圖與氣隙情境。實驗涵蓋十一個開放權重模型，共兩千次嘗試，平均 S_conf 為 79.7%，最佳模型達 99.9%；僅 0.1% 的成功外洩伴隨明確警告。作者另測試 CJK 編碼以提升通道容量（平均 66.0%），並對七個商用聊天機器人做案例研究，平均成功率約 48%。限制包括模型規模與推理風格差異造成變異大、長 payload 易出現單字元錯誤、部分模型傾向本地修復或改用 curl 委派而未觸發請求；此外，真實網站的擬真度會影響模型是否起疑。此研究的重要意義在於指出：本地部署或保密合約雖可防範洩漏給 LLM 營運商，卻無法阻止機密經由合法的工具呼叫流向無關第三方，因此防禦必須納入模型對外存取了哪些資源。
